jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1539555&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelors degree with a major in Marketing Additional Requirements Strong interest in Sales & Marketing Career-oriented and willing to build a long-term career Freshers are encouraged to apply Responsibilities & Context ORTRIO Limited, a subsidiary of AKSID Corporation Limited, is the exclusive distribution partner for a leading manufacturer of specialty water treatment chemicals in Bangladesh. We are seeking a mid-level Marketing & Sales Representative to drive new customer acquisition and revenue growth across industrial sectors. This role is ideal for a technically proficient sales professional eager to excel in a high-growth, B2B technical sales environment. Key Responsibilities New Business Development: Identify and acquire new customers across targeted industries including textiles, food & beverage, pharmaceuticals, power, and manufacturing. Build a strong sales pipeline and expand the market for water treatment chemicals. Client Relationship Management: Develop strong relationships with plant managers, engineers, procurement teams, and other key decision-makers. Conduct regular site visits to understand customer requirements. Technical Sales & Consulting: Provide technical guidance on water treatment solutions, including boiler, cooling tower, RO, and wastewater applications. Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, and trials. Sales Target Achievement: Meet and exceed assigned sales targets through effective territory management, account planning, negotiation, and customer conversion while maintaining company profitability guidelines. Market Intelligence: Track market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs, providing relevant insights to management. Reporting & Coordination: Maintain sales records, prepare forecasts and reports, and coordinate with technical, marketing, logistics, and customer service teams to ensure effective customer support. Working Conditions Work Environment: Based at AKSIDs Head Office in Dhaka, with a significant amount of time spent in the field. Expect a field-oriented role, visiting industrial facilities, production plants, and client offices regularly. Travel Requirements: Frequent travel within Bangladesh (up to 60-70% of the time) to meet clients on-site. This includes travel to industrial hubs outside Dhaka. A valid driving license and willingness to travel by car and occasionally by air/rail to distant client sites are required. Reporting Line: You will report to the Managing Director at Ortrio. Regular meetings and reporting will be required to discuss pipeline status, market issues, and strategy. Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams including technical service engineers from Metito, marketing team, and customer service/logistics to ensure timely product delivery and support. Schedule: Full-time position (weekday business hours), with flexibility needed to accommodate client schedules. Occasionally, you may need to attend industry events or client meetings in evenings or weekends as per business needs. Requirements Additional Requirements Required qualifications and experience Direct, hands-on experience dealing with Dhaka-based manufacturers, workshops, importers, or wholesale markets. Candidates must be able to describe specific sourcing work they personally carried out. Sufficient technical literacy to read and write product specifications and assess build quality, materials, and durability. A background in engineering, industrial design, product development, or a technical trade is an asset but is not required if practical sourcing experience is strong. Currently based in Dhaka, with the mobility and willingness to spend a substantial share of working time in markets and workshops across the city. Fluency in both English and Bangla. Ability to work independently with limited supervision, plan ones own fieldwork, and deliver on schedule. Competence in maintaining structured records in spreadsheets and writing clear, organised reports. Not required but any experience with connected or remotely managed devices (e.g., IoT controllers, pay-as-you-go solar, vehicle telematics) would be useful. Assets Experience sourcing cooling, refrigeration, solar, or battery-powered equipment. Prior work in or around informal markets, street vending, or urban informal enterprise. Experience supporting research projects and working to research-driven standards of documentation and consistency. Responsibilities & Context 1. Background IFPRI, in partnership with the Shakti Foundation, one of Bangladeshs largest microfinance institutions, is developing and evaluating an asset-based loan product that will help street food vendors in Dhaka acquire mobile cooling solutions. As part of our research, the product will be offered to a sample of vendors during an initial launch and rigorously evaluated through a randomized controlled trial. A central design feature of the product is that vendors will be offered a menu of mobile cooling solutions at a range of price points, so that each vendor can select what fits the scale of their business and the goods they sell. This can include products that serve to cool both the food being sold, the vendor themselves, or both, as well as ventilation solutions for vendors who cook on site or at home. This is likely to include insulated/ventilated cart modifications, evaporative cooling units, battery-powered coolers, or other lithium battery based solution packages. This can include products that serve to cool both the food being sold, the vendor themselves, or both, as well as ventilation solutions for vendors who cook on site  or at home. Maintain professional communication and protect the company’s brand while dealing with customers and business partners. Maintain confidentiality of customer databases, pricing information, commercial information and other company-sensitive information. raw_source_fields.age: 20 to 30 years Only Male Good communication and coordination skills. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Hard working, willingness to go market for product sourcing and buying. Responsibilities & Context HBF was founded in 2013 in Gazipur and is a company for fiber products that are manufactured by hand or semi-automatically. Our products are customized and niche products for high quality goods. We are seeking a detail-oriented, hard-working, and responsible Assistant Officer, Accounts & Purchase to join our Accounts team. If you are passionate about accounting and looking to build a strong career in this field, we want to hear from you! Accounts & HR Responsibilities: Maintain & prepare all kind of voucher and posting to the books of accounts. Prepare and maintain different sorts of bill, voucher & requisition slips. To maintain the company accounting activities. Keep record of all office expenses, payroll entries, invoices and other accounting documents. Able to cash management. Provide day to day administrative support. Able to Prepare Daily Receive & Payment Statements. Give support to worker recruitment, documentation, absent list etc. Purchase Responsibilities: Research and identify potential vendors, suppliers, and market trends. Negotiate pricing, delivery terms, and contract conditions with suppliers. Monitor stock levels to prevent shortages or excess inventory. Inspect delivered goods and resolve issues with defective products or delayed shipments. Maintain updated databases of supplier information, invoices, and purchase logs. Perform any other task given by the Management.
raw_source_fields.gender: Only males are allowed to apply.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540117&fc.source_content:
Requirements Additional Requirements Qualifications & Experience: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Accounting and Information Systems from the reputed university. Partly qualified Chartered Accountants (Professional Level passed) and preferred Associate Chartered Accountant (ACA) qualification from The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Bangladesh (ICAB)· Work experience in reputed Chartered Accountancy firm· 5+ years of relevant professional and industry experience in Treasury Operations, Finance & Accounts, or related areas. Other Skills Strong attention to detail. Strong stakeholder management skills. Good knowledge of Operations, Treasury, Finance & Accounts, and related financial processes. Responsibilities & Context Maintain strong controls over fund availability and daily settlements, including assisted partners Bank settlements, while managing risks arising from core-system downtime. Ensure daily and monthly reconciliation of Treasury Operations activities and reporting in Oracle in compliance with established processes and Bangladesh Bank guidelines. Lead treasury operational onboarding and feasibility assessments for existing and new service modality from Treasury perspective. Review and update Treasury operational processes and Oracle modules and develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) in line with ISO standards. Facilitate internal and external audits, support ISO 27001 compliance, and manage ad hoc regulatory reporting and responses to Bangladesh Bank. Review service agreements, legal drafts, and Notes for Approval (NFA) in coordination with Legal, Commercial, Product & Technology, and other relevant teams. Coordinate with Business Finance, Commercial, Product & Technology, and Regulatory & External Affairs on operational issues, financial services, assisted partner settlements, reporting, regulatory requirements, and new product implementation. Coordinate with banks on operational issues, UAT for new products and services, dispute settlement, and fund settlement. Coordinate with MNOs and middleware partners on daily funding modality and assisted partner settlement-related matters as per agreed process. Support regulatory inspections, responses, reporting to Bangladesh Bank, and proposal submissions as required. Facilitate Treasury-related activities for external audits in line with management expectations. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Treasury Operation Regulatory Compliance Oracle ERP SOP Development Internal Control Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

Requirements Education Experience 1 to 2 years Additional Requirements Age 18 to 25 years Only Female The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Airline, Travel Agency, Immigration/Visa Processing, and Transport Service Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Skills & Expertise: Sales & Marketing, Digital Marketing, Facebook marketing, Content Creation Responsibilities & Context Responsibilities & Context: কোম্পানির ট্রাভেল, ভিসা প্রসেসিং, ওয়ার্ক পারমিট ও স্টুডেন্ট ভিসা সংক্রান্ত সেবার মার্কেটিং কার্যক্রমে সহযোগিতা করা। Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp ও অন্যান্য ডিজিটাল প্ল্যাটফর্মে মার্কেটিং কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা ও নিয়মিত কনটেন্ট প্রচার করা। সম্ভাব্য ক্লায়েন্টদেরসাথে যোগাযোগ করে কোম্পানির বিভিন্ন সার্ভিস সম্পর্কে তথ্য প্রদান করা। সোশ্যাল মিডিয়া থেকে আসা ইনবক্স, কমেন্ট ও কাস্টমার কুয়েরি দ্রুত ও পেশাদারভাবে পরিচালনা করা। নতুন ক্লায়েন্ট/লিড সংগ্রহ করা এবং সংগৃহীত লিডগুলো নিয়মিত ফলো-আপ করা। ডিজিটাল মার্কেটিং ক্যাম্পেইন, বিজ্ঞাপন ও প্রচারণার পরিকল্পনা ও বাস্তবায়নে সহযোগিতা করা। মার্কেটিং কনটেন্ট, পোস্ট, ব্যানার ও ভিডিও তৈরির কাজে টিমকে প্রয়োজনীয় সহযোগিতা করা। বাজারের ট্রেন্ড, প্রতিযোগী প্রতিষ্ঠান ও গ্রাহকদের চাহিদা সম্পর্কে তথ্য সংগ্রহ ও বিশ্লেষণ করা। দৈনিক/সাপ্তাহিক মার্কেটিং কার্যক্রম ও লিডের রিপোর্ট প্রস্তুত করা। বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধির জন্য নতুন মার্কেটিং আইডিয়া ও কৌশল প্রস্তাব করা। কোম্পানির ব্র্যান্ড ইমেজ ও কাস্টমার সার্ভিসের মান বজায় রেখে কাজ করা। প্রয়োজনে অন্যান্য মার্কেটিং ও অফিসিয়াল কাজে টিমকে সহযোগিতা করা। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Sales & Marketing Facebook marketing Visa Processing Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only females are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka (Naya Paltan)

Skills & Expertise: Sales & Marketing, Digital Marketing, Facebook marketing, Content Creation Responsibilities & Context Responsibilities & Context: কোম্পানির ট্রাভেল, ভিসা প্রসেসিং, ওয়ার্ক পারমিট ও স্টুডেন্ট ভিসা সংক্রান্ত সেবার মার্কেটিং কার্যক্রমে সহযোগিতা করা। Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp ও অন্যান্য ডিজিটাল প্ল্যাটফর্মে মার্কেটিং কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা ও নিয়মিত কনটেন্ট প্রচার করা। সম্ভাব্য ক্লায়েন্টদেরসাথে যোগাযোগ করে কোম্পানির বিভিন্ন সার্ভিস সম্পর্কে তথ্য প্রদান করা। সোশ্যাল মিডিয়া থেকে আসা ইনবক্স, কমেন্ট ও কাস্টমার কুয়েরি দ্রুত ও পেশাদারভাবে পরিচালনা করা। নতুন ক্লায়েন্ট/লিড সংগ্রহ করা এবং সংগৃহীত লিডগুলো নিয়মিত ফলো-আপ করা। ডিজিটাল মার্কেটিং ক্যাম্পেইন, বিজ্ঞাপন ও প্রচারণার পরিকল্পনা ও বাস্তবায়নে সহযোগিতা করা। মার্কেটিং কনটেন্ট, পোস্ট, ব্যানার ও ভিডিও তৈরির কাজে টিমকে প্রয়োজনীয় সহযোগিতা করা। বাজারের ট্রেন্ড, প্রতিযোগী প্রতিষ্ঠান ও গ্রাহকদের চাহিদা সম্পর্কে তথ্য সংগ্রহ ও বিশ্লেষণ করা। দৈনিক/সাপ্তাহিক মার্কেটিং কার্যক্রম ও লিডের রিপোর্ট প্রস্তুত করা। বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধির জন্য নতুন মার্কেটিং আইডিয়া ও কৌশল প্রস্তাব করা। কোম্পানির ব্র্যান্ড ইমেজ ও কাস্টমার সার্ভিসের মান বজায় রেখে কাজ করা। প্রয়োজনে অন্যান্য মার্কেটিং ও অফিসিয়াল কাজে টিমকে সহযোগিতা করা। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Sales & Marketing Facebook marketing Visa Processing Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only females are allowed to apply. raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Marketing Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Marketing
raw_source_fields.age: 26 to 45 years Responsibilities & Context Job Responsibilities – Senior Executive (Marketing & Sales) Develop and execute sales and marketing plans to achieve assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual targets. Generate new leads through digital marketing, referrals, networking, corporate contacts, and other sales channels. Follow up with prospective clients and convert qualified leads into property bookings and sales. Present and explain project details, including location, floor plans, specifications, pricing, payment schedules, and facilities. Conduct client meetings, site visits, property presentations, and project demonstrations. Maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers to support repeat business and referrals. Prepare quotations, sales proposals, booking documents, and other necessary sales-related paperwork. Negotiate with clients within approved company policies and coordinate with management for special pricing or payment arrangements. Coordinate with Accounts, Legal, Customer Service, Construction, and Project teams to ensure smooth completion of sales transactions. Maintain accurate records of leads, client communications, follow-ups, bookings, collections, and sales status. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, property prices, customer preferences, and emerging business opportunities. Assist in planning and implementing promotional campaigns, exhibitions, property fairs, corporate presentations, and other marketing activities. Support digital marketing activities, including social media promotions, online campaigns, lead generation, and customer engagement. Prepare regular sales reports, lead conversion reports, collection updates, and market feedback for management. Ensure timely follow-up on customer payments and coordinate with the Accounts Department regarding outstanding installments. Handle customer queries professionally and resolve sales-related issues in coordination with the concerned departments. Participate in sales meetings, training sessions, project briefings, and business development activities. Build and maintain a professional network with individuals, corporate organizations, brokers, property consultants, and other potential business partners. Ensure all sales activities comply with company policies, approved pricing, and applicable procedures. Perform any other sales, marketing, and business-development responsibilities assigned by the management.

Requirements Additional Requirements Age At least 18 years Essential requirements: Education: • Desirable finance, business or administration related diploma. Experience: • Essential previous working experience of at least two years in relevant jobs. • Desirable experience in MSF or other NGOs in developing countries. Languages: • Mission language and local language essential Knowledge: • Essential computer literacy (word, excel, internet) Competencies: • Results and Quality Orientation L2 • Team work and Cooperation L2 • Behavioural Flexibility L2 • Commitment to MSF Principles L2 • Stress Management L3 Responsibilities & Context Main Purpose: Execute administrative and finance related tasks and follow up of project accountancy to support the Project Finance Manager following MSF standard and procedures, in order to ensure legal compliance and keep a strict control over monetary resources to achieve project objectives. Accountabilities: • Implementing cash management procedures in order to ensure the highest control and security, assisting the Project Fin Manager in the prevision of monthly treasury and planning in order to en-sure the coverage of daily needs, advances on salaries, payroll, etc. • Processing the payment to suppliers and keep strict on all documentation involved, informing the administration manager of any sort of disparity • Carrying out all accounting tasks and activities, classifying, preparing and filing of all accounting pieces in accounting software, in order to ensure strict control of all expenditures and the reliability of statements and documentation. • Making all administrative information available to the staff (posting, meetings, etc.), supporting the Accountancy Manager (ACMA) in translating documents into local language and assisting in meetings upon request. • Any other administrative task delegated by the Accountancy Manager (ACMA) MSF Section/Context Specific Accountabilities: MSF Cox’s Bazar office is considered as sub office to Dhaka Intersection Support Team (IST), therefore the Finance Assistant will be considered as part of IST finance team member, and for any reason the Finance coordinator can request the Fin Assistant to join IST at Dhaka any time (support, cover gap, etc). • To help the Finance coordinator on the execution of the IST objective by supporting with the proper advise on finance when needed. • Cash Management: To handle 5 (Five) cash box and entry book in cash register UF. • Processing payment of big volume of local purchase for OCA, OCB & OCP mission and workshop Payment. • Encode all the transection into UF. • VAT & TAX challan summary report for different FD’s and organize softcopy of the challan in the finance share folder (PD, PIT & Suppliers). • Challans share to Supplier’s as per need. • Employee & Supplier/Vendor TDS Certificate Download • Organize monthly IST BKK and send to Dhaka IST • To Scan OCA BKK (Heavy duty scanner availability) • To prépare monthly 6 (six) bank reconciliation for IST accounts • Monthly checking IMS PD tracker, uploading in UF & share with all the IST IMS • Prepare monthly medical Tracking sheet & share to Medical • Book adjusting entries in UF for IMS cost reimbursement. • Monthly VAT & TDS deposit information update in the Compliance Overview tracker. • Prepare monthly IST VAT return report with issuing Mushok 6.6 • Monthly workshop related expense report share to IST Workshop Manager. • Bank Signatory add documents preparation for CXB IST • Collaboration with OC’s when they need or ask for. • Help to other work as per need, budget preparation (FD6 & MSF internal), VAT return submission in NBR site, financial statement preparation. • To perform any other task delegated by Finco, and to be flexible to support on some HR tasks. Support to HR & Admin Team: • Support IST HR/Admin team with accommodation and housekeeping arrangements • Monthly IR submission for Food, Hygiene & Stationery Items for CXB IST Office, Warehouse, House, Ukhiya Workshop. • Check the inventory align with Supply Sup. And physical check the stock in present and make Forecast of Monthly Consuption for quarterly basis and submit (Food, Hygiene & Stationery Items for CXB IST Office, Warehouse, House, Ukhiya Workshop) • Distribute ID Cards and Ribbon to colleagues (as per need). • Making all administrative information available to the staff (posting, meetings, leave form, etc.) • Sending staff files (signed contracts, signed JDs, leave form, etc) to HR Assistant/HRM to encode them in Homere. • Additional HR/ Admin tasks delegated by the IST HRCo/Dep HRCo. Compensation & Other Benefits Contract and Benefit: • Fixed term contract for 06 months . Salary according to level 6 (Six) of the internal MSF salary grid (BDT 85,500 Gross). Salary is non-negotiable. Income tax deduction from salary based on current income tax rule. • 2 annual leave days per month worked. • Weekly 2 holidays. • Medical Reimbursement for employee and direct dependents based on Health Care Policy- Locally Recruited Staff. Others: There will be no provisions for relocation. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Coxs Bazar

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Additional Requirements Age 22 to 26 years Only Male Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who is: Highly organised and responsible Good with Excel/Google Sheets and numbers Strong at planning and follow-up Comfortable managing factory workers and suppliers Able to solve problems independently Comfortable dealing with logistics companies and government offices Experienced in manufacturing, supply chain, procurement or export Experience with wood products, furniture, homeware or Amazon/FBA is a plus. The Role You will work primarily from our Khulna factory and report directly to the UK-based management team. Because the business is still being established, this is an opportunity to help build the systems and processes from the ground up , rather than simply maintain an existing operation. The aim is to create a reliable operation where production, inventory, quality, purchasing and export are organised and predictable as the business grows. Responsibilities & Context About Stonewell Supply We currently have a wood manufacturing factory in Khulna, Bangladesh , and are in the process of formally establishing and developing the wider Stonewell Supply business. We are a UK-based company developing wooden homeware products for international markets, initially selling through Amazon UK. We are looking for a Supply Chain to help us build and organise the systems needed to grow the business. Responsibilities & Context EFG is a UK-based food service and wholesale company expanding its tele-sales and administrative operations in Bangladesh. We are setting up our Dhaka office and looking for energetic, English-speaking tele-sales executives to join our growing international sales team. Job Responsibilities Communicate fluently with UK-based customers to take food service and wholesale orders. Handle inbound and outbound calls professionally in English and sometimes Sylheti Bangla accent. Input customer orders accurately into the system and ensure timely processing. Promote online (web) ordering and help customers with account support. Manage customers within term & limit. Coordinate with UK and Bangladesh operations teams to ensure smooth service. Achieve weekly and monthly sales targets. Maintain accurate records of calls, sales, and customer details. Must Be Well-Mannered Skills & Expertise Fluent in English SYLHET Native Language Other Relevant Skills Order processing Promote Sales Telesales Compensation & Other Benefits Attractive fixed salary (based on experience). Commission: As per company policy Professional training & UK process exposure. Growth opportunity into senior telesales or team leader roles. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka (Uttara)

Responsibilities & Context
EFG is a UK-based food service and wholesale company expanding its tele-sales and administrative operations in Bangladesh. We are setting up our Dhaka office and looking for energetic, English-speaking tele-sales executives to join our growing international sales team.
Job Responsibilities
Communicate fluently with UK-based customers to take food service and wholesale orders.
Handle inbound and outbound calls professionally in English and sometimes Sylheti Bangla accent.
Input customer orders accurately into the system and ensure timely processing.
Promote online (web) ordering and help customers with account support.
Manage customers within term & limit.
Coordinate with UK and Bangladesh operations teams to ensure smooth service.
Achieve weekly and monthly sales targets.
Maintain accurate records of calls, sales, and customer details.
Must Be Well-Mannered
Other Relevant Skills
Compensation & Other Benefits
Attractive fixed salary (based on experience).
Commission: As per company policy
Professional training & UK process exposure.
Growth opportunity into senior telesales or team leader roles.

Work at office

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540127&fc.source_content: Requirements Additional Requirements Required Skills and Abilities Conduct research, including use of commercial computer-based research services. Communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, to a diverse audience. Plan, organize and prioritize work. Assign and supervise the work of others. Demonstrate the highest level of ethical behavior. Remain flexible in order to adapt to changes in work environment. Study and apply new information, and take initiative. Excellent time-management, problem-prevention and problem-solving skills. Work accurately with close attention to detail. Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information. Work effectively, professionally and tactfully with diverse workforce, team leaders, senior staff, and outside companies and public agencies. Possess a work ethic that includes neatness, punctuality and accuracy. Exhibit a professional, businesslike appearance and demeanor. Basic computer skills, including e-mail, word processing and spreadsheets. Excellent interpersonal skills to facilitate interaction with the workforce. Candidates having hospitality background are preferred Responsibilities & Context POSITION SUMMARY The Human Resources (“HR”) Manager has overall responsibility for the HR function as it relates to all Hotel Sarina Dhaka team members, including employee relations, compensation and benefits administration, development, implementation and administration of human resources programs and employment policies, personnel record-keeping, workers compensation and team member safety issues, training and workforce development, and compliance with HR laws and regulations of the government of Bangladesh. The HR Manager performs advanced professional work advising Hotel Sarina Dhaka team leaders and team members on the application of employment, benefits and workers compensation laws and regulations and employment policies in the contexts of hiring, discipline, employment termination, training, compensation, benefits, leave, equal opportunity and other human resources issues. The HR Manager must be open and available to discuss human resources matters with the entire workforce. The HR Manager reports to the General Manager, address employee safety issues, and oversee third party administrator and outside counsel in the handling of workers compensation matters. The HR Manager supervises the Organizational Development & Training function. The Human Resources Manager also performs such other functions as may be assigned by the Management / General Manager. RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES OF HUMAN RESOURCES MANAGER Maintain knowledge of and ensure compliance with employment-related laws and regulations of the government of Bangladesh Manage actions and proceedings brought against Hotel Sarina Dhaka arising in connection with employment, benefits and workers compensation issues, including preparation of all Polices Maintain all personnel files, records, Police Reports background investigation results, and other personnel records, and ensure Hotel Sarina Dhaka is in compliance with all laws and regulations and demonstrates “best practices” in regard to personnel information management. Provide leadership in effective conflict resolution for all personnel. Analyze benefits options and cost alternatives for providing employee benefits, recommend benefits program modifications and implement approved benefits modifications. Work with senior management to craft consistent, equitable and competitive compensation and incentives. Develop and implement human resources programs and policies and periodically update Team Member and Team Leader Handbooks. Serve as a resource for team leaders in handling employee issues and assist them in counseling employees, conducting evaluations, staff training, problem-solving and consensus-building. Serve as a resource for all team members by being available and accessible to discuss all human resources related issues. Oversee the Organizational Development & Training function and develop employee training programs. Maintain inter- and intradepartmental work flow by providing information to and cooperating with co-workers. Assist in hiring by providing job descriptions and advertisements, and in the case of hiring of senior team leaders, by screening and interviewing candidates. Work with the Management, and inform on matters involving benefits, employee safety and workers compensation issues. Oversee handling of employment-related inquiries, such as employment verification requests and unemployment compensation inquiries and proceedings. Chair/serve on various Hotel Sarina Dhaka committees, as well as outside human resources or industry-related groups. Develop, implement and participate in employee recognition programs. Enhance job performance by applying up-to-date professional and technical knowledge gained by attending seminars and conferences and reviewing professional publications. Perform other duties as assigned by the Management/ General Manager ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS Prepare and maintain accurate records, files and reports, including responsibility for maintaining personnel records. Organize and work independently on multiple assigned tasks/projects and complete assignments within specified deadlines. Communicate effectively verbally and in writing to all levels of staff and management, outside officials and agencies, and the public, expressing ideas and instructions clearly and concisely. Compile and analyze complex information, and research and develop solutions to complex issues. Work well under pressure. Accurately follow verbal and written directions from senior management. Advise on employment statutes, rules, regulations and policies affecting team members. Meet with and assist Hotel Sarina Dhaka team leaders in planning and directing activities, explaining and implementing decisions, and resolving significant issues involving team members. Recommend, develop, interpret and clarify personnel procedures and policies. Conduct research regarding employment issues, benefits, workers compensation and personnel procedures and, working with General Manager, apply the conclusions to personnel policies and practices. Assist in hiring, including developing job descriptions and job advertisements, and screening and interviewing candidates. Develop, implement and manage a centralized recruiting process. Demonstrate skills in consensus-building and mediation in order to constructively address employee conflicts. Demonstrate skills critical for managerial success including leadership, decisiveness, flexibility, sound business judgment, and highly developed personal, analytical and communication skills. WORK ENVIRONMENT Ability to work in an office setting. Position may require extended hours including evenings and weekends, travel to multiple work sites. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Computer Skills Human Resource Management Problem-solving skill Recruitment & Selection Time Management Employment Status Full Time Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh

পরিচালনা করা। HR ও কমপ্লায়েন্স ডকুমেন্টেশন প্রস্তুত ও সংরক্ষণ করা। সোশ্যাল কমপ্লায়েন্স ও এথিক্যাল ট্রেড অডিটের জন্য ফ্যাক্টরিকে প্রস্তুত ও সমন্বয় করা। SEDEX/SMETA, BSCI এবং অন্যান্য কাস্টমার/সোশ্যাল কমপ্লায়েন্স অডিট পরিচালনা ও মোকাবিলার বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতা থাকা। অডিটের পর কারেকটিভ ও প্রিভেন্টিভ অ্যাকশন (CAPA) সঠিকভাবে বাস্তবায়ন ও বজায় রাখা। নিয়মিত অভ্যন্তরীণ কমপ্লায়েন্স চেক করা এবং উন্নয়নের ক্ষেত্র Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Diagnostic Centre, Healthcare Startup, Hospital, Pharmaceutical/Medicine Companies Additional Requirements Age 22 to 35 years Candidates with experience as a Medical Representative (MR/MPO) will be given preference. Both "male and female" candidates are encouraged to apply. Job Location: Dhaka and all divisional cities across Bangladesh. Excellent verbal articulation, advanced negotiation tactics, and high-impact corporate presentation skills. Strong capacity to convince, build rapport, and handle objections when dealing with high-profile senior medical specialists, clinical administrators, and pharmacy managers. Proactive self-starter, target-driven mind, tech-savvy, and structurally capable of working independently in the field under pressure. Responsibilities & Context Job Responsibilities Regularly visit private and government hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centers, and individual doctors to establish strategic healthcare partnerships. Build professional institutional relationships and negotiate Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) and corporate partnership agreements with hospital authorities and medical practitioners. Collect, compile, and maintain highly accurate doctor professional information, core specializations, consultation fees, chamber schedules, and clinical service details. Smoothly onboard new partner hospitals and independent doctors onto the platform system to ensure a robust provider database. Coordinate proactively with partner hospitals and doctors regarding incoming patient appointments and daily service availability. Maintain consistent communication, trust, and outstanding long-term relationships with existing healthcare partners to prevent churn. Identify and capitalize on new strategic partnership opportunities in Dhaka City and gradually scale operations across all 64 districts of Bangladesh. Prepare and submit regular, structured reports detailing hospital visits, executive meetings, signed MoUs, newly onboarded partners, and pending follow-ups. Regularly visit retail and wholesale pharmacies to verify medicine availability, analyze market pricing lists, and onboard strategic pharmacy partners into our digital pharmacy support ecosystem. Willingness to travel extensively within country and when required internationally. Perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned by the management from time to time. Job Context: BookingGlobalDoctor.com is a premier, tech-driven enterprise healthcare platform and medical travel network operating via an integrated mobile application and website. We seamlessly connect nationwide patients with partner doctors, hospitals, diagnostic centers, and pharmacies. We are expanding our ground acquisition operations and looking for highly motivated, energetic, and result-oriented professionals to join our corporate growth team. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540445&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education B.Sc. in Textile Engineering / Fashion Designing / related discipline from a recognized institution. Candidates having knowledge of Seamless Knitting/Seamless Garments will be preferred. Experience At most 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Garments, Textile, Group of Companies Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 26 to 30 years Only Male Basic knowledge of inventory and store management. Basic knowledge of 5S and warehouse/store practices. Basic knowledge of ERP/software-based inventory management will be an advantage. Understanding of garments/textile production processes. Good numerical and analytical ability. Strong attention to detail.Self-driven and responsible. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Positive mindset and willingness to learn. Ability to work with different departments and under pressure. Experience: 0–6 months / Freshers are encouraged to apply. Internship or practical experience in store, inventory or garments/textile operations will be an advantage. Responsibilities & Context Assist in the day-to-day operation and management of the Seamless Store . Receive, check, arrange and issue raw materials, accessories and other store items according to approved requirements. Maintain proper inventory records, stock registers and system records . Support accurate stock receiving, issuing, transfer and reconciliation . Monitor stock levels and communicate shortages or excess inventory to the concerned authority. Ensure proper identification, tagging, storage and preservation of materials. Follow FIFO/FEFO principles wherever applicable. Assist in conducting regular physical stock counting and reconciliation. Maintain proper housekeeping and 5S practices within the store. Support reduction of material wastage, loss and inventory discrepancies. Coordinate with Production, Planning, Knitting, Technical, Procurement and Accounts departments regarding material requirements. Assist in maintaining proper documentation for material receiving and issuing. Ensure materials are stored safely and systematically to facilitate easy identification and retrieval. Support implementation of best practices for inventory and store management . Perform any other duties assigned by the management. Skills & Expertise Fabric Store Other Relevant Skills Inventory Management Stock Reconciliation FIFO Compensation & Other Benefits Gratuity Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Other Benefits: As per company policy Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration or related field. Reputed Public & Private University Preferred. (DU, JU, JNU, CU, RU, KU, NSU, IUB, AIUB, BRAC). MBA/EMBA from a reputed university will be preferred.
raw_source_fields.deadline: s while maintaining a professional attitude. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Airport Operation Export & Import Export Documentation Export/ Import through L/C
raw_source_fields.age: 25 to 35 years Skills & Expertise Air Export, Email Communications, Freight forwarding knowledge, freight forwarding sales, Supply Chain Management. Computer Skills: Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel), email communication, and specialized freight forwarding/logistics software. Responsibilities & Context Planet Freight Services Ltd. a concern of Topstar Group, established in 1997, has grown into a leading freight forwarding company by consistently delivering high-quality logistics services. The company continuously invests in employee training, modern technology, and updated business practices to meet the evolving demands of global trade. With an experienced workforce and advanced infrastructure, it provides reliable, efficient, and customer-focused omni-channel logistics solutions. Key Responsibilities Communicating with customers through various channels regarding air export shipments. Keep constant contact with assigned overseas agents, airlines, and shippers for smooth handling of the shipments. Follow up SOP for every customer and ensure timely execution of all air export shipments. Booking follow-up, contacting shipper / buying house for booking with all proper shipment information and providing the required documents to the shipper. Responding promptly to customer inquiries regarding flight schedules, rates, booking status, and shipment documentation. Reporting EDI/DSR on time and maintaining accurate shipment updates. Ensure customer satisfaction and provide professional customer support throughout the shipment process. Ensure follow-up with the vendor, airline, and relevant parties for customs status, shipping documents, and cargo readiness. Providing clearance to the Air Operation team for planning, mentioning booking no., agent detail, preferred airline, selling rate, flight details, and estimated arrival time through mail only. Coordinate with the Air Operation team regarding cargo handover, flight confirmation, documentation, and urgent consignments. Follow up on AWB, HAWB/MAWB and other required air export documentation to ensure timely shipment processing. Sometimes communicate over the phone for urgent consignments and shipment-related matters. Ability to meet deadlines while maintaining a professional attitude. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Airport Operation Export & Import Export Documentation Export/ Import through L/C

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540660&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Supply Chain Management, Accounting, Management Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Accounting, Management or a relevant discipline from a recognized university Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (FMCG), Agro based firms (incl. Agro Processing/Seed/GM) Additional Requirements Minimum 2–3 years of practical experience in Store Operations, preferably in a factory/FMCG/food manufacturing environment. Candidates with hands-on experience in raw materials, packaging materials and finished goods management will be preferred. Key Skills Good knowledge of inventory and store management. Practical knowledge of FIFO/FEFO, stock reconciliation and physical inventory counting. Good computer skills, particularly MS Excel and inventory/ERP software. Strong documentation, communication and coordination skills. Ability to work under pressure and maintain accuracy in stock-related activities. Responsibilities & Context Receive, inspect and properly record all incoming raw materials, packaging materials, finished goods and other store items. Ensure proper storage, identification, stacking and preservation of materials according to company procedures. Maintain accurate stock records, bin cards, stock registers and system entries. Issue materials against authorized requisitions and maintain proper documentation. Conduct regular physical stock verification and reconcile physical stock with system/record balances. Monitor stock levels and inform the concerned authority regarding shortages, excess stock, slow-moving and obsolete items. Ensure FIFO/FEFO practices where applicable, particularly for food/raw materials and other time-sensitive items. Coordinate with Production, Procurement, Quality Assurance, Accounts and other relevant departments for smooth store operations. Maintain proper housekeeping, safety, security and hygiene standards within the store. Prepare regular stock reports and support management during stock audits and inspections. Perform any other store-related duties assigned by management. Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Negotiable, based on qualifications and experience. Other benefits will be provided as per company policy. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Mymensingh
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540885&fc.source_content:
Requirements Additional Requirements স্পষ্টভাবে কথা বলা, মনোযোগ দিয়ে শোনা এবং গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরির দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে। Sales, Customer Service বা Account Management-এ অভিজ্ঞতা থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। ই-কমার্স, B2B সেলস বা চীন থেকে পণ্য সোর্সিং সম্পর্কে ধারণা থাকলে বাড়তি সুবিধা। WhatsApp Business, Excel/Google Sheets এবং কম্পিউটার ব্যবহারে দক্ষ হতে হবে। বাংলা ও বাংলিশে গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে লিখিত যোগাযোগ করতে পারতে হবে। দায়িত্বশীল, ধৈর্যশীল এবং নিয়মিত ফলোআপ ও লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অনুযায়ী কাজ করার মানসিকতা থাকতে হবে। গ্রাহকের অভিযোগ বুঝে সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয়ের মাধ্যমে সমাধান করতে আগ্রহী হতে হবে। অভিজ্ঞ প্রার্থীদের পাশাপাশি প্রয়োজনীয় দক্ষতাসম্পন্ন নতুনরাও আবেদন করতে পারবেন। Responsibilities & Context Wholesale Plus গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে দীর্ঘমেয়াদি ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরি, নিয়মিত ফলোআপ এবং রিপিট অর্ডার বাড়ানোর জন্য ৫ জন Key Account Manager (KAM) নিয়োগ দেবে। প্রধান দায়িত্বসমূহ: নির্ধারিত গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে ফোন ও WhatsApp-এ নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও ফলোআপ করা। গ্রাহকের ব্যবসা ও পণ্যের চাহিদা বুঝে সোর্সিং, কোটেশন ও অর্ডার করতে সহায়তা করা। পুরোনো ও নিষ্ক্রিয় গ্রাহকদের পুনরায় অর্ডারে আগ্রহী করা। সম্ভাব্য গ্রাহকদের অনুসন্ধান ফলোআপ করে অর্ডারে রূপান্তর করা। অর্ডার, পেমেন্ট ও ডেলিভারির আপডেট দেওয়া এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা। গ্রাহকের অভিযোগ ও সমস্যা সমাধানের অগ্রগতি অনুসরণ করা। প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ব্যবসায়িক ও কর্পোরেট গ্রাহকদের ভিজিট করা। গ্রাহকের তথ্য, যোগাযোগের বিবরণ ও পরবর্তী ফলোআপের তারিখ নির্ধারিত সিস্টেমে সংরক্ষণ করা। মাসিক বিক্রয় ও রিপিট অর্ডারের লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জনে কাজ করা। দৈনিক কাজ ও সাপ্তাহিক অগ্রগতির রিপোর্ট দেওয়া এবং গ্রাহকের মতামত জানানো। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Relationship Management/ Key Account Management Customer Relationship B2B and B2C sales and marketing Lead Generation Complaint Handling skill Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

Requirements Additional Requirements স্পষ্টভাবে কথা বলা, মনোযোগ দিয়ে শোনা এবং গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরির দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে। Sales, Customer Service বা Account Management-এ অভিজ্ঞতা থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। ই-কমার্স, B2B সেলস বা চীন থেকে পণ্য সোর্সিং সম্পর্কে ধারণা থাকলে বাড়তি সুবিধা। WhatsApp Business, Excel/Google Sheets এবং কম্পিউটার ব্যবহারে দক্ষ হতে হবে। বাংলা ও বাংলিশে গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে লিখিত যোগাযোগ করতে পারতে হবে। দায়িত্বশীল, ধৈর্যশীল এবং নিয়মিত ফলোআপ ও লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অনুযায়ী কাজ করার মানসিকতা থাকতে হবে। গ্রাহকের অভিযোগ বুঝে সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয়ের মাধ্যমে সমাধান করতে আগ্রহী হতে হবে। অভিজ্ঞ প্রার্থীদের পাশাপাশি প্রয়োজনীয় দক্ষতাসম্পন্ন নতুনরাও আবেদন করতে পারবেন। Responsibilities & Context Wholesale Plus গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে দীর্ঘমেয়াদি ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরি, নিয়মিত ফলোআপ এবং রিপিট অর্ডার বাড়ানোর জন্য ৫ জন Key Account Manager (KAM) নিয়োগ দেবে। প্রধান দায়িত্বসমূহ: নির্ধারিত গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে ফোন ও WhatsApp-এ নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও ফলোআপ করা। গ্রাহকের ব্যবসা ও পণ্যের চাহিদা বুঝে সোর্সিং, কোটেশন ও অর্ডার করতে সহায়তা করা। পুরোনো ও নিষ্ক্রিয় গ্রাহকদের পুনরায় অর্ডারে আগ্রহী করা। সম্ভাব্য গ্রাহকদের অনুসন্ধান ফলোআপ করে অর্ডারে রূপান্তর করা। অর্ডার, পেমেন্ট ও ডেলিভারির আপডেট দেওয়া এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা। গ্রাহকের অভিযোগ ও সমস্যা সমাধানের অগ্রগতি অনুসরণ করা। প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ব্যবসায়িক ও কর্পোরেট গ্রাহকদের ভিজিট করা। গ্রাহকের তথ্য, যোগাযোগের বিবরণ ও পরবর্তী ফলোআপের তারিখ নির্ধারিত সিস্টেমে সংরক্ষণ করা। মাসিক বিক্রয় ও রিপিট অর্ডারের লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জনে কাজ করা। দৈনিক কাজ ও সাপ্তাহিক অগ্রগতির রিপোর্ট দেওয়া এবং গ্রাহকের মতামত জানানো। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Relationship Management/ Key Account Management Customer Relationship B2B and B2C sales and marketing Lead Generation Complaint Handling skill Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

Requirements Education Masters in commerce background from any reputed university. Additional Requirements Age At most 45 years Minimum 1 years experience in the NGO sector Experience in Hospital management is preferable; Excellent organizational and multi-tasking ability, strong communication, report writing, presentation, and negotiation skills; Proficient in English (oral and written); Age limit could be consider as per candidate experiance. Responsibilities & Context Job Context: Dhaka Ahsania Mission (DAM) is a non-government development organization founded in 1958 by Khan Bahadur Ahsanullah, an eminent educationist, reformer, and Sufi with the aim of social and spiritual development of the entire human community. DAM has been contributing for the betterment of the disadvantaged population through operating 35 institutions and also 8 sectors of development. The Health and Nutrition Sector is one of the core sectors of DAM which has also been operating 7 institutions and 9 projects. DAM Health and Nutrition Sector is going to recruit a competent and self-motivated individual for the position of Accounts and Admin Officer for "Mayer Hashi General Hospital and Diagnostic Center" at Ashulia, Dhaka. Job Responsibility: Oversee day-to-day administrative operations, including scheduling, inventory management, and facility coordination, to ensure efficient hospital functioning. Assist central HR in the overall recruitment and employee HR relevant relevant process. Coordinate effectively with various departments to facilitate smooth and uninterrupted hospital operations. Supervise and manage support staff, including clerical, front desk, housekeeping, and other administrative personnel. Assist in the development, implementation, and periodic review of hospital policies, procedures, and compliance standards. Maintain accurate, confidential, and up-to-date patient records, administrative documentation, and institutional files. Monitor administrative workflows and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and service quality. Manage patient billing, invoicing, account reconciliation, and related financial documentation. Oversee payroll processing and ensure timely and accurate payments to employees, suppliers, and service providers. Prepare and maintain financial reports, budgets, cash-flow projections, and periodic financial forecasts. Monitor hospital expenditures, control operational costs, and implement appropriate cost-saving measures. Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, financial institutions, and relevant regulatory authorities as required. Ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations, accounting standards, tax requirements, and internal hospital policies. Maintain proper financial records and supporting documentation for audit, reporting, and management review purposes. Provide management with timely financial and administrative information to support effective planning and decision-making. Perform any other tasks time to time given by the authority. As a member of the organization, uphold and comply with DAM’s Safeguarding Policies and Code of Conduct, and take appropriate action to prevent, report, and respond to safeguarding concerns in accordance with established procedures. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Operational Management Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Ashulia)

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1539588&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or any relevant discipline. MBA/Masters degree in Marketing or Management will be an advantage. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Automobile Additional Requirements Age 25 to 35 years Only Male Typically 2–3 years of relevant experience in sales, preferably in the motorcycle, automobile, automotive parts, or related industry. Experience in dealer management, retail sales, territory management, and market development will be preferred. Responsibilities & Context The Territory Sales Manager (TSM) will be responsible for achieving motorcycle sales targets, developing and managing the dealer network, expanding market coverage, and increasing the companys market share within the assigned territory. The position requires extensive fieldwork, strong dealer relationships, market analysis, and effective execution of sales and promotional strategies. Key Responsibilities Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual motorcycle sales targets for the assigned territory. Manage, develop, and maintain strong relationships with authorized dealers and sub-dealers. Identify and appoint potential new dealers to expand market coverage. Monitor dealer-wise and model-wise sales performance and take corrective actions where required. Drive secondary/retail sales through dealers and ensure regular product availability. Conduct frequent market and dealer visits to monitor sales, stock, showroom activities, and customer demand. Develop new markets and identify opportunities for increasing motorcycle penetration. Monitor competitors pricing, products, offers, promotions, dealer activities, and market strategies. Implement company-approved sales campaigns, promotional activities, branding, and merchandising programs. Train and motivate dealer sales teams on product features, customer handling, and sales techniques. Monitor dealer inventory and coordinate with relevant teams to maintain optimum stock levels. Support dealers in resolving sales, service, documentation, and customer-related issues. Monitor customer feedback and ensure proper resolution of complaints in coordination with the service team. Follow up on motorcycle registration/documentation processes where applicable. Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly sales, stock, market, and competitor reports. Analyze territory sales data and prepare sales forecasts and action plans. Ensure compliance with company pricing, branding, sales, and operational policies. Monitor dealer showroom standards, product display, signage, and promotional materials. Maintain strong relationships with dealers, customers, and other relevant market stakeholders. Perform any other sales-related responsibilities assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Sales Sales & Marketing Other Relevant Skills Territory sales Sales Target Achievement Market Development Market Analysis Sales Forecasting Compensation & Other Benefits Tour allowance,Mobile bill,Performance bonus Salary Review: Yearly Lunch Facilities: Full Subsidize Festival Bonus: 2 Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Additional Requirements
Typically 2–3 years of relevant experience in sales, preferably in the motorcycle, automobile, automotive parts, or related industry.
Experience in dealer management, retail sales, territory management, and market development will be preferred.
Responsibilities & Context
The Territory Sales Manager (TSM) will be responsible for achieving motorcycle sales targets, developing and managing the dealer network, expanding market coverage, and increasing the company`s market share within the assigned territory. The position requires extensive fieldwork, strong dealer relationships, market analysis, and effective execution of sales and promotional strategies.
Key Responsibilities
Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual motorcycle sales targets for the assigned territory.
Manage, develop, and maintain strong relationships with authorized dealers and sub-dealers.
Identify and appoint potential new dealers to expand market coverage.
Monitor dealer-wise and model-wise sales performance and take corrective actions where required.
Drive secondary/retail sales through dealers and ensure regular product availability.
Conduct frequent market and dealer visits to monitor sales, stock, showroom activities, and customer demand.
Develop new markets and identify opportunities for increasing motorcycle penetration.
Monitor competitors` pricing, products, offers, promotions, dealer activities, and market strategies.
Implement company-approved sales campaigns, promotional activities, branding, and merchandising programs.
Train and motivate dealer sales teams on product features, customer handling, and sales techniques.
Monitor dealer inventory and coordinate with relevant teams to maintain optimum stock levels.
Support dealers in resolving sales, service, documentation, and customer-related issues.
Monitor customer feedback and ensure proper resolution of complaints in coordination with the service team.
Follow up on motorcycle registration/documentation processes where applicable.
Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly sales, stock, market, and competitor reports.
Analyze territory sales data and prepare sales forecasts and action plans.
Ensure compliance with company pricing, branding, sales, and operational policies.
Monitor dealer showroom standards, product display, signage, and promotional materials.
Maintain strong relationships with dealers, customers, and other relevant market stakeholders.
Perform any other sales-related responsibilities assigned by management.
Other Relevant Skills
Compensation & Other Benefits
Employment Status
Full Time
Gender
Only males are allowed to apply.
Job Location
Anywhere in Bangladesh

এই চাকরির জন্য বিজ্ঞাপনদাতা ব্যাক্তি/প্রতিষ্ঠান আপনার কাছ থেকে কোন অর্থ চাইলে কিংবা নিয়োগ প্রক্রিয়া চলাকালীন কোন প্রকার হয়রানিমূলক (শারীরিক/মানসিক) আচরণ করলে অতিসত্ত্বর আমাদেরকে জানান অথবা জবটি রিপোর্ট করুন। চাকরি পাওয়ার জন্য কোন ব্যাক্তি/প্রতিষ্ঠানকে অর্থ প্রদান করবেন না। চাকরিকালীন কোন প্রকার হয়রানির (শারীরিক/মানসিক) সম্ভাবনা থাকলে সেখানে জয়েন করবেন না। কোন প্রকার অর্থ লেনদেন বা নিয়োগদাতা কর্তৃক হয়রানির দায়িত্ব বিডিজবস বহন করবে না।

The role will focus on identifying and developing institutional customers, expanding the B2B customer base, generating sales opportunities, and achieving assigned sales targets. The product portfolio includes Sunlite Battery & Lighter, Sun Chips, Sun Drinking Water, Air Freshener, Pop’s, Pups, Body Spray, and other upcoming consumer products of the Group. The incumbent will establish and maintain strong relationships with corporate organizations, institutions, offices, factories, hotels, restaurants, educational institutions, hospitals, NGOs, government and non-government organizations, distributors, and other potential B2B customers. Candidates must be confident, assured and well-spoken. The employee must maintain good personal hygiene and have a smart appearance. Perform any other jobs as required by the management. Candidates with some experience working in corporate office environment will be given preference. Candidates who have motorcycle driving license will be given preference. raw_source_fields.education: Post Graduation from any reputed university with no Third Division/Class
raw_source_fields.vacancy: . A. Assistant Manager – Product Development & Campaign Management, Cards (SO-SEO) Develop and enhance credit card products and propositions based on customer needs, market trends and business objectives. Manage end-to-end product lifecycle, including developing business cases, coordinating product launches, executing upgrades and conducting periodic performance reviews. Plan, launch, and monitor card campaigns by managing data-driven customer segmentation, defining rewarding propositions and analyzing return on investment (ROI). Track and analyze the performance of existing products, active campaigns and competitor offerings to deliver actionable insights for portfolio optimization. Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, IT, Operations, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure the seamless rollout of products and campaigns. B. Assistant Manager – MIS (Cards) (SO-SEO) manage large-scale Card Business data to guarantee absolute accuracy, completeness, and timely availability for business reporting. Design and distribute daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports, executive dashboards, and KPIs tracking overall card business activities. Conduct rigorous variance analysis, portfolio health checks and product profitability assessments to identify revenue opportunities and operational bottlenecks. Monitor data integrity, reconcile information and maintain appropriate documentation and reporting controls. Support reporting automation, dashboard enhancement and timely delivery of management information to relevant stakeholders. C. Assistant Manager/Team Leader – Sales Governance (Officer-EO) Monitor Card Sales activities and processes to ensure compliance with approved policies, KYC, documentation and sales-governance requirements. Identify and monitor mis-selling, process deviations, exceptions, documentation gaps and other sales-control issues. Review sales MIS, campaign/product eligibility, incentive-related controls and governance trackers to identify irregularities and performance risks. Coordinate corrective and preventive actions with Sales, Operations, Compliance, Risk and other relevant functions and support audit requirements. Analyze customer complaints, post-issuance verification trends, and responsible-sales performance indicators to build comprehensive governance dashboards for senior leadership. Skills & Expertise Credit Control And Recovery Direct Sales MIS Monitoring Monitoring and Reporting Payroll and Banking Product Development Retail Banking Sales Specialized Leasing Operational (Monitoring/ collection)
raw_source_fields.age: not exceeding 40 years as of 01 October, 2026.

Responsibilities & Context
The Premier Bank PLC., one of Bangladesh’s leading private commercial banks, is looking for dynamic, customer-focused and experienced professionals to join its Retail Banking Division in the following positions.
A. Assistant Manager – Product Development & Campaign Management, Cards (SO-SEO)
Develop and enhance credit card products and propositions based on customer needs, market trends and business objectives.
Manage end-to-end product lifecycle, including developing business cases, coordinating product launches, executing upgrades and conducting periodic performance reviews.
Plan, launch, and monitor card campaigns by managing data-driven customer segmentation, defining rewarding propositions and analyzing return on investment (ROI).
Track and analyze the performance of existing products, active campaigns and competitor offerings to deliver actionable insights for portfolio optimization.
Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, IT, Operations, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure the seamless rollout of products and campaigns.
B. Assistant Manager – MIS (Cards) (SO-SEO)
manage large-scale Card Business data to guarantee absolute accuracy, completeness, and timely availability for business reporting.
Design and distribute daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports, executive dashboards, and KPIs tracking overall card business activities.
Conduct rigorous variance analysis, portfolio health checks and product profitability assessments to identify revenue opportunities and operational bottlenecks.
Monitor data integrity, reconcile information and maintain appropriate documentation and reporting controls.
Support reporting automation, dashboard enhancement and timely delivery of management information to relevant stakeholders.
C. Assistant Manager/Team Leader – Sales Governance (Officer-EO)
Monitor Card Sales activities and processes to ensure compliance with approved policies, KYC, documentation and sales-governance requirements.
Identify and monitor mis-selling, process deviations, exceptions, documentation gaps and other sales-control issues.
Review sales MIS, campaign/product eligibility, incentive-related controls and governance trackers to identify irregularities and performance risks.
Coordinate corrective and preventive actions with Sales, Operations, Compliance, Risk and other relevant functions and support audit requirements.
Analyze customer complaints, post-issuance verification trends, and responsible-sales performance indicators to build comprehensive governance dashboards for senior leadership.

Attractive compensation package including Group Insurance coverage
A professional and friendly working environment;
Clear career progression opportunities.

Effective communication and interpersonal skill Critical thinking and analysis The ability to write clear, concise, and grammatically correct English reports is crucial. Problem solving abilities Proficiency in IIA Standards, risks and controls frameworks (COSO etc.) Highest level of integrity Maintains objectivity in appearance and fact Ability to quickly learn new areas of business Flexibility to travel and visit various locations of the organizations partners, including call centers, distribution houses, among others. Responsibilities & Context Support the development of risk-based audit plans and roadmaps aligned with organizational goals, and assist in maintaining the audit universe, risk register, and other relevant tools to continuously assess, link, and prioritize critical business risks. Perform internal audit activities in accordance with IIA Standards, IIA Code of Ethics, Code of Conduct, organizational policies and procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements, while staying updated on audit methodologies, industry best practices, trends, and emerging issues that may impact the business. Demonstrate adherence to established policies and procedures and apply a systematic, disciplined, and value-adding approach to internal audit activities that meets the needs of the organization. Develop and document engagement plans, including objectives, scope, timelines, and resource requirements, considering the organization’s strategies, objectives, and risks relevant to each engagement. Independently perform and document assigned audit engagements by identifying, analyzing, evaluating, and documenting sufficient and appropriate information to achieve engagement objectives within approved timelines, budgets, and departmental standards. Develop, maintain, and update control assessment frameworks, models, criteria, and Risk & Control Matrices (RCMs) at the engagement level to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management, internal controls, processes, and systems. Maintain professional objectivity and independence throughout audit engagements; disclose any actual or perceived impairment of independence or objectivity, ensure balanced assessments based on relevant facts, and avoid undue influence from personal interests or other parties. Consider the possibility of significant errors, fraud, and non-compliance during assigned engagements and conduct appropriate examinations and verifications in line with professional standards and the level of diligence expected from a competent internal auditor. Ensure audit quality and timely delivery by assessing whether engagements adequately cover the approved scope and key risks, objectively evaluate governance, risk management, and controls, identify current business issues and their strategic or operational implications, and provide appropriate recommendations. Communicate audit results in an accurate, objective, clear, concise, constructive, complete, and timely manner, and work with auditees, process owners, and management to develop appropriate action plans and resolve identified control issues and risks. Conduct periodic follow-ups on audit recommendations and action plans, ensure timely implementation of agreed actions, and maintain the audit follow-up tracking system as required by the department. Escalate to the Head of Internal Audit (HIA), through the appropriate channel, where management or divisional heads accept a level of risk that may be unacceptable to the organization. Maintain a thorough and current understanding of the organization’s objectives, strategies, processes, systems, capabilities, employees, culture, industry practices, and business environment to ensure relevant and effective audit assessments. Consider the work of other assurance providers and assess whether reliance on their work is appropriate based on their scope and procedures, while coordinating with other control and monitoring functions to ensure effective use of audit resources. Build and maintain effective working relationships with process owners and business management to support improvements in internal controls, risk management, business processes, effectiveness, and efficiency. Assist the supervisor in functional, administrative, and other audit-related matters as and when required. Skills & Expertise Audit reporting Compliance Compliance and Integrity Critical and analytical thinking Data analysis Internal Control Problem solving and decision making Risk Assessment Target Oriented Other Relevant Skills Compliance code of conduct Internal Audit Risk Analysis

Requirements Education Minimum HSC / Bachelor's / Master's degree or equivalent. Candidates from any academic background may apply if they meet the required experience and skill criteria. Additional Requirements Experience Requirements Minimum 1 year of professional experience in Call Center or Sales is mandatory. Candidates with experience in Lead Management, Tele Sales, Customer Support, CRM, Appointment Booking, or Patient Support will receive preference. Required Skills & Competencies Excellent communication skills, especially in Bangla. Smart, confident, and professional communication style. Good listening and interpersonal skills. Ability to understand and respond to clients' concerns patiently. Basic computer knowledge and proficiency in smartphone applications. Ability to work with CRM/software-based systems. Strong sales and follow-up skills. Target-oriented and performance-driven mindset. Strong teamwork and time-management skills. Responsible, disciplined, and professional attitude. Willingness to work in a Deeni and Islamic values-based environment . Candidates must maintain Islamic etiquette and professional behavior while communicating with clients. What We Are Looking For We are looking for individuals who are: Patient and responsible. Excellent communicators. Good listeners who genuinely understand people's concerns. Confident and smart in handling clients. Target-oriented and motivated to achieve sales goals. Capable of working effectively as part of a team. Respectful, professional, and committed to Islamic values. Responsibilities & Context Lead Call Center Executive – Call Center & Sales SukunLife Shariah-Compliant Ruqyah, Counseling & Islamic Healing Services SukunLife is a Shariah-compliant service organization providing Ruqyah, Counseling, and Islamic Healing services . As part of our continued expansion, we are looking for dedicated, responsible, and smart individuals to join our Lead Call Center & Sales Team . We welcome applications from candidates who are interested in working in a Deeni and Islamic values-based environment , have strong communication skills, and can listen to clients' concerns with patience, empathy, and professionalism. Position Information Position: Lead Call Center Executive Department: Lead Call Center & Sales Workplace: Dhanmondi 14 Road, 8/A/6/1, Near Sobhanbag Jame Mosque, Dhaka Working Hours: 10 Hours per Day Key Responsibilities Communicate with patients/clients through phone calls, WhatsApp, Messenger, and other communication channels. Provide clear and accurate information about SukunLife's services. Understand clients' needs and guide them toward appropriate services. Follow up with existing and potential clients to improve service conversion and customer satisfaction. Forward relevant or sensitive cases to senior team members when necessary. Maintain polite, respectful, patient, and Islamic manners in all communications. Achieve assigned individual and team sales/lead conversion targets. Coordinate with the team to ensure smooth and effective client service. Why Join SukunLife? At SukunLife, you will have the opportunity to work in a meaningful and service-oriented environment where professionalism, compassion, and Islamic values are prioritized. We believe in developing our team members through proper training, performance-based growth, and continuous learning. Basic Salary: BDT 14,000-22,000, depending on qualifications and experience. Performance-based incentives. Salary increment after 3 months, subject to performance and company policy. Further increment after 6 months. Annual salary increments thereafter based on performance and company policy. Professional training and development opportunities. Career growth and promotion opportunities. Respectful and supportive Islamic work environment. Scheduled leave and other applicable benefits. Requirements Education Bachelors or Masters degree in Textile Engineering, Textile Chemistry or a relevant discipline from a recognized university. Additional Requirements 3–10 years of relevant experience in sales and business development within the textile chemical industry. Candidates with proven experience in selling textile dyes, auxiliaries, specialty chemicals or other textile processing chemicals will be preferred. Strong knowledge of textile chemicals, including pretreatment, dyeing, printing and finishing applications. Proven experience in selling textile chemicals to textile mills, dyeing, washing and finishing industries. Established relationships with textile manufacturers and key industry stakeholders will be an advantage. Strong business development, negotiation and customer relationship management skills. Good understanding of market dynamics, competitor activities, pricing and sales strategies within the textile chemical sector. Ability to identify customer needs and coordinate technical solutions with principals and internal teams. Proficiency in MS Office and CRM systems, with the ability to prepare sales reports and forecasts. Responsibilities & Context Drive sales and business development of textile chemicals, including pretreatment, dyeing, printing, finishing and other specialty chemicals. Develop new business opportunities by identifying potential customers, including textile mills, dyeing, washing, printing and finishing factories. Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers while expanding the companys customer portfolio within the textile industry. Promote and sell textile chemical products by understanding customer requirements and recommending suitable products and solutions. Conduct regular customer visits, technical discussions and product presentations to identify business opportunities and strengthen customer engagement. Coordinate with international principals and suppliers to provide technical support, product information and customized solutions to customers. Arrange product trials, laboratory evaluations and industrial trials in collaboration with customers and technical teams to facilitate product approvals and business conversion Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve assigned sales targets, improve market penetration and ensure sustainable business growth. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing strategies and emerging technologies in the textile chemical industry. Manage customer accounts, negotiate commercial terms, prepare quotations and follow up on sales orders and payments. Maintain up-to-date CRM reports, highlighting potential opportunities and pipeline developments. Responsibilities & Context MH DHANMONDI LTD. is looking for a motivated and technically capable Generator Sells & Business Development (Assistant Engineer Electric) to join our team in Bangladesh. Visit clients, consultants, contractors, industries, and project sites to understand technical requirements. Conduct site surveys, load assessments, and technical inspections for power projects. Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and internal technical teams. Support installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and maintenance activities at project sites. Follow up on quotations, tenders, ongoing projects, and new business opportunities. Prepare customer visit reports, project updates, and other technical/commercial reports. Travel to different locations across Bangladesh for client meetings, site surveys, project execution, commissioning, and business development . Perform any other technical, sales, or project-related responsibilities assigned by the management. Professional career development opportunities in Power Generation, Generator Sales, Substation, Commissioning, and Technical Sales.
