Requirements Education Diploma in Electrical in Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Electronics Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Electronics Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Direct Selling/Marketing Service Company, Electronic Equipment/Home Appliances, Escalator/Elevator/Lift, Industrial Machineries (Generator, Diesel Engine etc.), Solar Energy Additional Requirements Age 26 to 35 years Only Male Must have a valid driving license and personal motorcycle/bike. Candidates with Electrical Licensing Board (ELB) Supervisor/Electrician certification will be given preference. Good understanding of electrical power systems and basic electrical engineering principles. Basic knowledge of electrical drawings, SLD, load calculation, control panels, and power equipment. Good communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Good command of Bangla and English, both written and spoken. Proficiency in MS Office will be an advantage. Must be willing to travel and work at project sites across Bangladesh. Proactive, responsible, and willing to learn. Candidates interested in both technical engineering and sales activities are encouraged to apply. People with no experience in Sells & Marketing are discouraged to apply. Responsibilities & Context MH DHANMONDI LTD. is looking for a motivated and technically capable Generator Sells & Business Development (Assistant Engineer Electric) to join our team in Bangladesh. The position is suitable for fresh Diploma/BSc Electrical Engineers as well as candidates with 2–3 years of relevant experience in power generation, substation, technical sales, or commissioning. Job Responsibilities Support technical sales and business development activities for power and electrical solutions. Visit clients, consultants, contractors, industries, and project sites to understand technical requirements. Conduct site surveys, load assessments, and technical inspections for power projects. Assist in sales, installation, testing, commissioning, and after-sales support of: Substations and Power Distribution Systems Diesel/Gas Generator Sets Solar Power Systems and related equipment Synchronization, ATS/AMF, control and protection systems ACB, MCCB, switchgear, electrical panels and related equipment Prepare and review technical quotations, BOQ, SLD, specifications, tender documents, and proposals . Assist in system design, equipment selection, load calculations, and technical solutions according to project requirements. Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and internal technical teams. Support installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and maintenance activities at project sites. Follow up on quotations, tenders, ongoing projects, and new business opportunities. Prepare customer visit reports, project updates, and other technical/commercial reports. Travel to different locations across Bangladesh for client meetings, site surveys, project execution, commissioning, and business development . Perform any other technical, sales, or project-related responsibilities assigned by the management. Skills & Expertise Business Development Communication Diesel Generator Sales & Marketing Sales Development Solar Energy Other Relevant Skills BOQ Client Relationship Electrical Installation and Maintenance Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Review: Yearly Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize Festival Bonus: 2 Attractive salary package based on qualifications, experience, and company policy. Sales commission/bonus based on individual and business performance. Travel Allowance (TA) & Daily Allowance (DA) for official travel and project/site visits. Yearly performance-based salary increments and promotion opportunities. 3-6 months probationary period , depending on individual performance. Professional career development opportunities in Power Generation, Generator Sales, Substation, Commissioning, and Technical Sales. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka (Dhanmondi)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Masters Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Diploma in relevant discipline from a recognized university/institute (Computer Science/Engineering, IT, Graphic Design, Marketing, or a related field with proven relevant experience). Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Trading or Export/Import Additional Requirements Age At least 23 years Experience: 1–3 years in Website Development, Graphic Design, and LinkedIn Lead Generation. (Freshers with strong portfolios are also encouraged to apply for Executive role). Graphic Design: Proficient in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva, with experience in poster, brochure, and print design. Video editing skills (Premiere Pro / CapCut) are a plus. Website Development: Hands-on experience with WordPress / Wix / Shopify, responsive design, basic HTML/CSS, and SEO fundamentals. LinkedIn Lead Generation: Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, lead research, outreach/follow-up, and CRM or lead tracking. Strong practical and interpersonal skills; must be able to submit a portfolio of design, website, and lead generation work. Ability Good written communication skills in both Bengali and English Responsibilities & Context Job Summary FVL – Fatiha Venture LTD. is a leading import and distribution company. We are looking for a creative, energetic, and tech-savvy professional to join our team as an Executive/Senior Executive (IT & Digital Marketing). In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining our website, creating engaging print and digital designs (posters, brochures and more), and generating quality business leads through LinkedIn. Key Responsibilities (Job Responsibilities) Graphic & Print Design: Design attractive posters, brochures, banners, flyers, leaflets, and other promotional materials using Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva. Create social media graphics, LinkedIn post creatives, website assets, and digital advertisement designs. Ensure all designs align with the brand’s identity and visual guidelines. Prepare company brochure, company profile, catalogue, banner, poster, and leaflet for print and digital campaigns/programs, ensuring print-ready quality. Website Development & Maintenance: Design, develop, and launch responsive websites and landing pages using WordPress, Wix, Shopify, or similar platforms. Maintain and update the company website, including content, banners, product pages, plugins, and themes. Ensure website speed, mobile responsiveness, security, and basic SEO best practices. Manage domain, hosting, SSL, regular backups, and system updates. Track website performance (Google Analytics / Search Console) and implement improvements. LinkedIn Lead Generation & Outreach: Research and identify potential clients, distributors, and B2B prospects using LinkedIn (Sales Navigator) and other tools. Build targeted lead lists, send connection requests and personalized outreach messages, and follow up consistently. Manage and grow the company LinkedIn page; plan, schedule, and publish regular posts to build brand presence. Maintain a lead database/CRM, track outreach performance (response rate, qualified leads), and report to management regularly. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Adobe Photoshop Digital Marketing (Social Media Marketing) Graphic Design Linkedin marketing Social Media Management Compensation & Other Benefits Salary: Negotiable (Based on experience & capability). Mobile allowance Festive bonus, and other benefits as per company policy. Friendly work environment and career growth opportunities. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Aftabnagar)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets and willingness to work with POS/ERP systems. Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines. Willingness to conduct market visits when required. Strong attention to detail, particularly in product data, pricing, and inventory management. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Experience: 1–3 years of relevant experience in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Inventory, E-commerce Operations, Vendor Management, or a related field. Freshers with strong knowledge and interest in supply chain and e-commerce operations may also be considered. Key Skills Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Vendor Management, Inventory Management, Purchasing, E-commerce Operations, Product Management, Market Research, Negotiation, POS/ERP, Data Management, Pricing & Promotion, Supplier Coordination Responsibilities & Context Job Responsibilities: Manage suppliers and maintain strong, professional relationships with existing and potential vendors. Review and compare multiple supplier quotations and order sheets to identify the most competitive options. Conduct market and brand research to identify high-demand, top-selling, and potential “hero” products for onboarding. Identify slow-moving and dead stock and take necessary initiatives to improve inventory turnover. Monitor near-expiry products and coordinate timely clearance or promotional activities. Maintain regular communication and coordination with suppliers regarding orders, pricing, availability, delivery, and other business matters. Schedule and coordinate meetings with suppliers and relevant internal teams. Conduct physical market visits to gather market insights, monitor competitors, and identify new product opportunities. Perform daily operational activities and maintain accurate product and inventory data in the POS system. Coordinate with the product upload team to ensure accurate and timely product listings. Maintain regular communication with the warehouse team regarding stock availability, receiving, dispatch, and inventory-related issues. Assist in inventory control, procurement, purchasing, and replenishment activities. Verify and audit product names, images, descriptions, specifications, and other product information. Monitor and manage product pricing, promotional pricing, discounts, and offers. Coordinate products and offers for various sales campaigns and promotional activities. Generate content ideas based on products, campaigns, and promotional requirements and coordinate with content creators for execution. Assist in preparing and reviewing product-related captions and promotional content. Plan and prepare themes, product selections, talking points, and scripts for live selling sessions. Prepare and monitor supplier payment schedules and coordinate with relevant teams regarding vendor payments and outstanding dues. Maintain proper records and reports related to suppliers, purchasing, inventory, pricing, and product activities. Perform other operational and ad-hoc responsibilities as assigned by the management. raw_source_fields.age: 28 to 35 years Responsibilities & Context The Credit Recovery Officer will be responsible for monitoring outstanding dues, contacting clients for payment collection, and maintaining proper records of receivables. Contact clients via phone, email, and in person to follow up on pending dues. Negotiate and arrange suitable payment plans when necessary. Communicate with clients to obtain necessary documentation and provide updates on their credit status. Maintain accurate records of all collection activities and payment transactions. Prepare and submit regular reports on credit recovery progress to the management. Coordinate with the sales and accounts team to resolve billing disputes or discrepancies. Taking the challenge to meet the credit recovery target and report to the Management; Ensure documentation of all collection related reports, work plans, and office correspondent. Generate reports on credit recovery performance and provide insights for process improvements. Stay updated on industry regulations and best practices related to credit management and recovery. Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and periodic departmental reports. Maintain and regularly update the departmental customer database. Monitor and maintain the departmental target and achievement records. Conduct physical collection from customers as required. Perform computer-based reporting, data entry, and record maintenance efficiently. Skills & Expertise Communication and interpersonal skill Good vocal tone is desired Professionalism Reporting and Documentation Work Under Pressure Other Relevant Skills Client Relationship Credit Administration Credit Control And Recovery

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1541995&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Masters Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (FMCG), Advertising Agency, Electronic Equipment/Home Appliances Additional Requirements Age At least 27 years Only Male Responsibilities & Context Must be fluent in English, both speaking and writing, to effectively communicate with foreign suppliers, shipping lines, and other international stakeholders. Ensure the timely preparation of all import documents to facilitate the smooth execution of import procedures and compliance with regulations. Possess sound knowledge of Letter of Credit (L/C) processes, amendments, and terms and conditions, liaising with banks and other organizations regarding L/C and payment issues. Collaborate with internal departments and suppliers to ensure the quality and timely delivery of raw materials and accessories through import processes. Experienced in operating an ERP system for group import raw materials, ensuring accurate data management and reporting. Communicate with parties in contracts to ensure mutual understanding of terms, particularly regarding financial aspects, and stay updated on market trends, material prices, and product developments. Follow up on the Procurement to Payment process in line with the Procurement Policy, maintaining and updating all Supply Chain Management (SCM) reports for relevant departments. Perform any other tasks assigned by management to support the smooth operation of the supply chain function. Skills & Expertise Content Creation Creative Design Other Relevant Skills Purchase Sourcing Supply Chain Management Technical Training Compensation & Other Benefits Mobile bill,Provident fund Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. raw_source_fields.age: 20 to 30 years Only Male Strong Communication, Presentation, and negotiation skills. Analytical and problem solving skills. Proven track record of achieving sales targets. Excellent customer service and relationship-building abilities. Knowledge of sales techniques and market trends. Responsibilities & Context A Sales Officer is responsible for generating revenue by promoting and selling products and services, which involves identifying, building customer relationships, presenting products and closing deals. Key duties include achieving sales targets, maintaining accurate records, preparing sales reports, and collaborating with other teams like marketing. Core responsibilities: Sales and revenue: Achieve and exceed sales targets by identifying and pursuing new business opportunities through prospecting and cold calling. Customer relations: Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and new clients by understanding their needs and providing excellent customer service. Presentations and negotiation: Present and demonstrate products or services and negotiate pricing and contract terms to close sales. Market analysis: Conduct market research to identify trends, understand competitor activities, and develop effective sales strategies. Reporting and tracking: Maintain accurate records of sales activities, client information, sales performance and prepare regular reports for management. Collaboration: Work with internal teams, such as marketing and logistics, to ensure customer satisfaction and timely delivery of products or services. Skills & Expertise Analytical Skill career oriented Positive attitude Presentation skill Quick learner and hard working Other Relevant Skills Market Analysis Sales

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1542501&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education BBA/MBA/M.Com in Accounting, Finance or related discipline. Fresh graduates or candidates with 1 year of relevant experience may apply. Experience Additional Requirements Age At least 25 years Basic understanding of accounting, inventory control and audit procedures. Good numerical and analytical skills with strong attention to detail. Working knowledge of MS Excel. ERP/Oracle experience will be an added advantage. Candidates should be honest, responsible and willing to perform regular physical inventory checks. Responsibilities & Context We are looking for energetic, detail-oriented professionals to join our Finance Team in the role of Executive – Finance Audit & Controls . Conduct regular physical inventory counts and stock verification across stores, warehouses and production-related inventory locations. Reconcile physical inventory with ERP/system records and investigate shortages, excesses and variances. Perform surprise stock counts and other inventory control checks. Review inventory movement, consumption, adjustments, transfers, wastage and supporting documentation. Review vouchers, bills, invoices, payments and other financial transactions for accuracy and compliance. Verify proper approvals and supporting documents. Check procurement and other finance-related transactions. Identify discrepancies, unusual transactions and internal control gaps. Prepare clear checking/audit observations and follow up on corrective actions. Support periodic internal control reviews and physical verification of assets where required. Ensure compliance with company policies and financial control procedures. Skills & Expertise Accounts and audit Accounts and Finance Data analysis Microsoft Office Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Cumilla (Cumilla Adarsha Sadar)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1541468&fc.title: Senior Relationship Officer/Relationship Officer for Liability Marketing

raw_source_fields.experience: in Liability Marketing or Deposit Mobilization from any reputed Commercial Bank will be considered as added advantage. Strong sales, business development and negotiation skills Sound knowledge of CASA, FDR, deposit pricing and liability products Ability to build relationships with senior corporate and institutional decision-makers Target-oriented, with pipeline and portfolio management ability Good understanding of banking operations, KYC and AML/CFT requirements Excellent communication and presentation skills Proficiency in MS Office and MIS tools Ability to work independently and collaboratively Responsibilities & Context Senior Relationship Officer/Relationship Officer-Liability Marketing Unit (LMU) will be responsible for achieving assigned deposit mobilization targets, with primary focus on CASA, through acquiring new customers, and growing existing relationships across corporate, institutional, government, SME and high-net-worth segments. The role involves building and maintaining a strong customer base, promoting the bank’s liability products, and ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulatory guidelines. This is a target based position requiring strong communication, negotiation skills and a result oriented mindset to contribute to the bank’s overall business growth. Job Responsibilities: Deposit Mobilization: Achieve assigned CASA and overall deposit targets, prioritizing low-cost CASA while generating quality FDR and other deposits where appropriate. Customer Acquisition: Identify, approach and onboard New-to-Bank customers from corporate, multinational, government, institutional, SME and HNI segments. Relationship Management: Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers, conduct regular client visits, understand customer needs and offer suitable liability solutions. Pipeline & Sales Planning: Maintain an updated prospect database and sales pipeline, prepare monthly/quarterly/annual sales plans, follow up on leads, and track proposals through to fund placement. CASA Growth & Retention: Promote transactional banking to build sustainable operating balances, monitor portfolio inflows/outflows and maturities, and take proactive steps to retain deposits and deepen wallet share. Compliance : Ensure all activities comply with Bank policies, Bangladesh Bank regulations and AML/CFT requirements, including proper KYC, accurate documentation, approved pricing, and prompt escalation of suspicious activity. Coordination & Reporting: Work with Branches and other units for smooth onboarding and service, maintain records of sales activities, submit timely reports, and perform other duties as assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Compliance Customer Acquisition Relationship Management Sales Planning

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1542742&fc.title: Sales Audit Officer, Hygiene Business

raw_source_fields.age: At most 35 years Strong knowledge of FMCG sales processes, distributor operations, trade promotions, and ERP/SAP systems with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; Power BI knowledge will be an added advantage. Excellent analytical, communication, and report-writing skills with high integrity, attention to detail, and willingness to travel extensively for field and distributor audits. Responsibilities & Context Conduct regular field and system audits to ensure compliance with sales policies, SOPs, and company guidelines across the sales network. Audit distributor operations, including inventory, stock reconciliation, cash collections, credit management, and trade claims to ensure accuracy and control. Verify sales transactions, promotional activities, trade schemes, and incentive claims to detect discrepancies, non-compliance, or fraudulent practices. Monitor field sales execution, including route compliance, market coverage, merchandising standards, and outlet visitation quality. Analyze sales and audit data to identify operational risks, unusual trends, control gaps, and opportunities for process improvement. Prepare comprehensive audit reports with findings, root-cause analysis, and actionable recommendations, and monitor the implementation of corrective actions. Conduct surprise market and distributor audits while collaborating with Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, and Internal Audit to strengthen governance and internal controls. Drive continuous improvement by recommending enhancements to sales processes, audit controls, compliance practices, and operational efficiency. Skills & Expertise Analytical Skill Presentation skill Sales Audit

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1542922&fc.title: Marketing Executive (Market Research & Development Strategy)

raw_source_fields.age: At least 18 years Responsibilities & Context Job Summary The selected candidates will work on researching real estate market trends, analyzing customer preferences, evaluating competitors and identifying new opportunities for property development. This role is ideal for fresh marketing graduates who are eager to apply their academic knowledge to real-world business challenges and contribute innovative ideas to the company's growth. Key Responsibilities Conduct market surveys and research to understand real estate market trends, customer preferences and emerging opportunities. Collect and analyze information on property prices, apartment sizes, project features, customer demand and competitor activities. Visit real estate projects, residential and commercial areas to gather firsthand market intelligence. Conduct customer surveys and interviews with prospective buyers, property owners, brokers and other relevant stakeholders. Analyse competitors' projects, pricing strategies, amenities, promotional activities and market positioning. Identify potential locations, customer segments and emerging trends for new residential and commercial development projects. Generate innovative ideas for new property development concepts, product offerings and market positioning. Prepare market research reports, presentations and recommendations for management. Maintain databases of market information, competitor projects and customer feedback. Collaborate with management and other departments to support strategic planning and business development initiatives.

Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Management, or a related field. MBA/PGD in HRM will be an advantage. Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (FMCG), Retail Store Additional Requirements Only Male Must be proactive, energetic, responsible, and well-organized. Willingness to visit factory/production facilities regularly as required. Willingness to handle HR, administration, procurement, and factory coordination responsibilities. Must have good interpersonal and communication skills. Candidates who can join immediately or within a short notice period will get preference. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Experience Requirements 1–3 years of relevant experience in HR & Administration. Candidates with experience in HR operations, recruitment, attendance management, employee documentation, payroll support, administrative procurement, factory coordination, and general administration will be preferred. Experience in manufacturing, FMCG, retail, or factory-based organizations will be an advantage. Required Skills & Competencies Good knowledge of HR & Administrative functions. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Good command of MS Office, particularly MS Excel and MS Word. Ability to maintain accurate records and documentation. Good organizational and time-management skills. Strong coordination and negotiation skills. Basic understanding of procurement and vendor management. Ability to handle confidential information professionally. Strong problem-solving and multitasking abilities. Strong sense of responsibility, discipline, and professionalism. Ability to work independently as well as in a team. Ability to communicate effectively with factory workers, employees, management, vendors, and external parties. Responsibilities & Context Department: Human Resources & Administration Job Summary: We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and well-organized HR & Admin Executive to manage day-to-day HR, administrative, procurement, and factory coordination activities. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, strong interpersonal ability, practical knowledge of HR operations, and the ability to handle multiple administrative responsibilities efficiently. Key Responsibilities HR Responsibilities Assist in end-to-end recruitment activities, including job posting, CV screening, interview scheduling, candidate coordination, and onboarding. Maintain and update employee personal files, HR records, attendance, leave, and other employee-related documents. Prepare and maintain appointment letters, confirmation letters, increment letters, transfer letters, warning letters, and other HR documents. Monitor daily attendance, late attendance, leave, overtime, and employee movement. Assist in monthly payroll preparation and provide necessary HR-related data. Ensure proper implementation of company HR policies, rules, procedures, and guidelines. Handle employee queries and provide necessary support regarding HR-related matters. Assist in employee onboarding, orientation, and induction programs. Maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information. Support management in maintaining a positive and disciplined workplace environment. Prepare regular HR reports and employee-related reports as required by management. Administration & Factory Coordination Manage day-to-day administrative activities to ensure smooth and efficient office operations. Regularly visit factory/production facilities to monitor HR and administrative activities and ensure proper coordination between the head office and factory. Coordinate with factory management and employees regarding attendance, manpower, employee issues, administrative requirements, and operational matters. Ensure availability and proper management of stationery, office supplies, equipment, and other administrative materials. Manage office and factory-related documentation and maintain proper records. Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, service providers, and external parties for administrative requirements. Assist in maintaining proper workplace facilities and ensuring necessary administrative support for employees. Support management in organizing meetings, events, employee engagement activities, training programs, and other organizational activities. Handle any other day-to-day administrative tasks assigned by management. Administrative Purchase & Procurement Handle administrative purchasing and procurement activities for office and factory requirements. Source and communicate with suppliers/vendors for necessary products and services. Collect and compare quotations, prices, product quality, and delivery schedules. Coordinate purchase orders, deliveries, and follow-up with suppliers. Maintain proper purchase records, bills, invoices, quotations, and supporting documents. Ensure timely procurement of office stationery, supplies, equipment, and other administrative requirements. Develop and maintain good relationships with suppliers and service providers. Ensure purchases are made within approved budgets and company policies. Skills & Expertise Employee Management Factory HR Administration General Administration HR Operation Payroll Administration Procurement Recruitment & Selection Other Relevant Skills Employee Management Factory HR Administration General Administration HR Operation Payroll Administration Procurement Recruitment & Selection Compensation & Other Benefits Compensation & Benefits Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications. Festival Bonus. Other benefits as per company policy. Career growth and professional development opportunities. Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka

Responsibilities & Context
Department: Human Resources & Administration
Job Summary:
We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and well-organized HR & Admin Executive to manage day-to-day HR, administrative, procurement, and factory coordination activities. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, strong interpersonal ability, practical knowledge of HR operations, and the ability to handle multiple administrative responsibilities efficiently.
Key Responsibilities
HR Responsibilities
Assist in end-to-end recruitment activities, including job posting, CV screening, interview scheduling, candidate coordination, and onboarding.
Maintain and update employee personal files, HR records, attendance, leave, and other employee-related documents.
Prepare and maintain appointment letters, confirmation letters, increment letters, transfer letters, warning letters, and other HR documents.
Monitor daily attendance, late attendance, leave, overtime, and employee movement.
Assist in monthly payroll preparation and provide necessary HR-related data.
Ensure proper implementation of company HR policies, rules, procedures, and guidelines.
Handle employee queries and provide necessary support regarding HR-related matters.
Assist in employee onboarding, orientation, and induction programs.
Maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information.
Support management in maintaining a positive and disciplined workplace environment.
Prepare regular HR reports and employee-related reports as required by management.
Administration & Factory Coordination
Manage day-to-day administrative activities to ensure smooth and efficient office operations.
Regularly visit factory/production facilities to monitor HR and administrative activities and ensure proper coordination between the head office and factory.
Coordinate with factory management and employees regarding attendance, manpower, employee issues, administrative requirements, and operational matters.
Ensure availability and proper management of stationery, office supplies, equipment, and other administrative materials.
Manage office and factory-related documentation and maintain proper records.
Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, service providers, and external parties for administrative requirements.
Assist in maintaining proper workplace facilities and ensuring necessary administrative support for employees.
Support management in organizing meetings, events, employee engagement activities, training programs, and other organizational activities.
Handle any other day-to-day administrative tasks assigned by management.
Administrative Purchase & Procurement
Handle administrative purchasing and procurement activities for office and factory requirements.
Source and communicate with suppliers/vendors for necessary products and services.
Collect and compare quotations, prices, product quality, and delivery schedules.

Requirements Education Candidates must have one of the following qualifications: B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering; OR Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration (BBA/MBA) or Business Studies. Note: Candidates should have a good academic record from a public university or a reputed private university. Additional Requirements Intermediate-level spoken English. Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook. Strong sense of responsibility and ability to work independently. Quick learning ability and willingness to develop professionally. Good communication, coordination, and organizational skills. Positive attitude and willingness to work in a team. Fresh graduates are welcome. Candidates with minimal work experience may also apply Full training will be provided. Responsibilities & Context Job Overview EFAAZ Corporation is looking for motivated and responsible candidates for the position of Sales Engineer / Sales Executive in Cumilla. Candidates with no prior work experience or minimal experience are encouraged to apply. Full training will be provided according to company requirements. Prepare and manage tender documentation. Search for suitable suppliers, products, and services. Conduct cost analysis and prepare price calculations. Prepare, execute, and administer contracts. Coordinate logistics, shipments, and delivery schedules. Communicate with customs brokers and certification agencies. Maintain proper documentation and records. Coordinate with internal teams, suppliers, and relevant stakeholders to ensure smooth business operations. Compensation & Other Benefits Salary is negotiable based on qualifications and suitability. Full-time employment with a five-day working week. Training and opportunities for professional development. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Cumilla
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Requirements Education Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Computer Engineering Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) in Marketing Diploma in Engineering in Computer Engineering Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): ISP, IT Enabled Service, Telecommunication Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age At least 22 years Experience in marketing of ISP services. Strong knowledge of sales and marketing strategies Ability to create marketing plans and execute them efficiently. Excellent communication and negotiation skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities Responsibilities & Context APCL is looking for some dynamic and results-driven ISP Marketing Executive to promote our internet and connectivity solutions, generate new business opportunities, and strengthen our market presence. The ideal candidate should have experience in ISP marketing, excellent communication and networking skills, and the ability to develop effective marketing strategies. Job Description: Promote the company's broadband, corporate internet, and networking solutions. Generate new leads through field visits, referrals, digital channels, and networking. Conduct market research to identify potential customers and business opportunities. Build and maintain relationships with residential, SME, and corporate clients. Assist the sales team in preparing proposals and service presentations. Plan and execute marketing campaigns, promotional events, and brand activation programs. Coordinate with the design team to develop marketing materials, brochures, and social media content. Monitor competitors' products, pricing, and marketing activities. Support customer retention initiatives and follow up on customer feedback. Prepare weekly and monthly marketing activity reports. Work closely with the technical team to ensure smooth service implementation. Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Bachelor’s degree in any relevant subject. Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Travel Agency Additional Requirements 1–3 years of experience in Recruitment / Talent Acquisition / Candidate Sourcing. Strong practical experience in candidate hiring will be preferred. Experience using BDjobs and LinkedIn for recruitment is highly preferred. Excellent communication and convincing skills. Good telephone communication skills. Strong CV screening and candidate sourcing ability. Smart, confident and target-oriented. Good follow-up skills. Able to handle multiple vacancies and candidates at the same time. We are especially interested in candidates who have previous experience in: Recruitment | Talent Acquisition | Candidate Sourcing | BDjobs Recruitment | LinkedIn Recruitment | Mass Hiring | Interview Coordination Responsibilities & Context Department: Recruitment Office Time: 10.0 AM – 6:00 PM Job Overview SKYLINK AIRWAYS is looking for an experienced and target-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist who will be responsible only for candidate recruitment and hiring. The selected candidate will focus on finding suitable candidates for the companys vacancies, conducting initial screening, arranging interviews and ensuring selected candidates join the company. Key Responsibilities Search and source candidates for available vacancies. Post job circulars on BDjobs, LinkedIn, Facebook and other recruitment platforms. Search suitable candidates through CV databases and online/offline/Field platforms. Review and shortlist CVs according to job requirements. Call candidates and conduct initial screening. Explain job responsibilities, salary and interview details to candidates. Schedule and coordinate candidate interviews. Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process. Follow up with selected candidates until their joining. Maintain a proper candidate database and recruitment tracker. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential candidates. Meet assigned monthly recruitment targets. Submit regular recruitment updates to management. The primary responsibility will be: Candidate Sourcing → CV Screening → Calling → Interview → Selection → Joining Recruitment Target The candidate will be responsible for achieving assigned monthly hiring targets and maintaining a continuous pipeline of suitable candidates. Submit regular recruitment updates to management.

Candidate Sourcing → CV Screening → Calling → Interview → Selection → Joining
Recruitment Target
The candidate will be responsible for achieving assigned monthly hiring targets and maintaining a continuous pipeline of suitable candidates.

Requirements Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Business-to-Business (B2B) Software and Services Startup Additional Requirements Age At least 30 years Only Male Experience working with business owners, executives, government organisations, regulatory bodies, legal or compliance matters, or multiple businesses would be useful. We do not expect one person to already know everything. What matters is having broad knowledge, being able to understand new subjects quickly and knowing how to find the information or people needed to get something done. Requirements We are looking for someone who can think independently and deal with a wide range of work. You should have: Very good knowledge of Bangladesh A good understanding of business in Bangladesh Knowledge of Bangladeshi government departments, systems and administrative processes Knowledge or experience across several industries Good research and problem-solving skills Strong written and spoken Bangla and English Good organisation and attention to detail Confidence speaking with businesses, professionals and government organisations Good computer and internet research skills The ability to manage several matters at once Good judgement The ability to work without constant supervision The ability to learn about unfamiliar subjects quickly Discretion when dealing with private or commercially sensitive information Responsibilities & Context We are looking for an experienced and intelligent person to assist with the management of several businesses and projects. This role goes beyond the normal responsibilities of a Personal Assistant or secretary. There will be administrative work, but a large part of the job will involve dealing with business matters, researching issues, speaking with different organisations and helping resolve problems. You may be given a task or problem without detailed instructions and expected to work out how to handle it. This could involve researching the issue, finding the correct person or organisation to contact, making enquiries, following up and reporting back. A good understanding of Bangladesh is important. You should be familiar with the business environment, different industries, government departments, regulations and administrative processes. The Role You will sometimes be given an objective rather than step-by-step instructions. You will be expected to understand what needs to be done, research it where necessary, speak to the relevant people and follow the matter through. The work can vary significantly depending on what the businesses need at the time. You should be comfortable taking on work that may not fall under a typical secretary or Personal Assistant job description. We are looking for someone who can gradually take responsibility for more matters and become closely involved in the day-to-day running of several businesses. Location and Travel You may be based anywhere, provided you are reliable and available when required. Knowledge of Bangladesh is essential. You must also be willing to travel to Dhaka when necessary. Responsibilities Assist with several businesses and projects at the same time Manage meetings, correspondence, documents, appointments and deadlines Communicate with companies, executives, consultants, lawyers, government offices and other organisations Research companies, industries, regulations and government procedures Make enquiries and deal with government departments and other organisations when required Find the correct people or departments to contact regarding particular issues Follow up on applications, enquiries and outstanding matters Coordinate between businesses, employees and outside organisations Prepare reports and summaries when required Organise meetings, appointments and travel Keep track of important matters and make sure they are followed up Handle confidential business information and documents Help resolve problems as they arise Take on responsibilities outside normal PA work when required Travel to Dhaka for meetings or business matters when necessary Skills & Expertise Government Liaison Operation Project Management Other Relevant Skills Business Administration Operations Management Government Liaison Business Research Stakeholder Communication Compensation & Other Benefits Salary: The salary is ৳100,000 to ৳200,000 per month, depending on experience and ability. The exact amount will depend on your background, knowledge, experience and the level of responsibility you are able to handle. There is room for increased responsibility and progression for someone who performs well in the role. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh

You should have:
Responsibilities & Context
We are looking for an experienced and intelligent person to assist with the management of several businesses and projects.
This role goes beyond the normal responsibilities of a Personal Assistant or secretary. There will be administrative work, but a large part of the job will involve dealing with business matters, researching issues, speaking with different organisations and helping resolve problems.
You may be given a task or problem without detailed instructions and expected to work out how to handle it. This could involve researching the issue, finding the correct person or organisation to contact, making enquiries, following up and reporting back.
A good understanding of Bangladesh is important. You should be familiar with the business environment, different industries, government departments, regulations and administrative processes.
The Role
You will sometimes be given an objective rather than step-by-step instructions. You will be expected to understand what needs to be done, research it where necessary, speak to the relevant people and follow the matter through.
The work can vary significantly depending on what the businesses need at the time. You should be comfortable taking on work that may not fall under a typical secretary or Personal Assistant job description.
We are looking for someone who can gradually take responsibility for more matters and become closely involved in the day-to-day running of several businesses.
Location and Travel
You may be based anywhere, provided you are reliable and available when required.
Knowledge of Bangladesh is essential.
You must also be willing to travel to Dhaka when necessary.
Responsibilities
Assist with several businesses and projects at the same time
Manage meetings, correspondence, documents, appointments and deadlines
Communicate with companies, executives, consultants, lawyers, government offices and other organisations
Research companies, industries, regulations and government procedures
Make enquiries and deal with government departments and other organisations when required
Find the correct people or departments to contact regarding particular issues
Follow up on applications, enquiries and outstanding matters
Coordinate between businesses, employees and outside organisations
Prepare reports and summaries when required
Organise meetings, appointments and travel
Keep track of important matters and make sure they are followed up
Handle confidential business information and documents
Help resolve problems as they arise
Take on responsibilities outside normal PA work when required
Travel to Dhaka for meetings or business matters when necessary

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1543284&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education BBA or MBA in Human Resource Management. Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Hospital, Diagnostic Centre, Manpower Recruitment, Travel Agency, Group of Companies Additional Requirements Age At least 21 years Only Male Manage calendars, coordinate meeting & Prepare Meeting Minutes. English typing speed of at least 40 words per minute (WPM) and Bijoy Bangla typing speed of at least 30 WPM. Hands-on experience in Admin and HR. Have to expert at IT and modern software related knowledge. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Sound knowledge of HR policies, procedures, and the Bangladesh Labor Act & Labor Rules. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) and HR-related software. Experience in CV sorting, screening, and shortlisting through BDJobs. Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and perform effectively under pressure. Smart, energetic, self-motivated, and a strong team player with a positive attitude. Responsibilities & Context JSK Group , a rapidly expanding and diversified business conglomerate with interests in Hospital & Diagnostic Services, Passenger Transport, Capital Market Brokerage House, Sara Express and Overseas Recruitment & Training, is looking for a smart, dynamic, and energetic Executive-Admin & HR . The selected candidate will be responsible for handling Admin & HR operations, recruitment, employee relations, and HR documentation across multiple business units under JSK Group . Job Responsibilities: Answer phone calls, sort emails, and greet office visitors. Order office supplies and maintain office equipment. Process basic invoices, track expenses, and reconcile budgets. Handle end-to-end recruitment process — job posting, candidate sourcing, interviewing, and onboarding. Maintain accurate employee records, personal files, and attendance database. Support in payroll preparation, leave management, and benefits administration. Conduct orientation programs for new employees and ensure smooth joining formalities. Assist in performance appraisal and employee evaluation processes. Handle employee queries, grievances, and ensure a healthy work environment. Support HR audits, training programs, and compliance with labor laws and company policy. Coordinate with different units (Hospital, Diagnostic, Transport, Brokerage, Training Center) to fulfill manpower needs. Prepare periodic HR reports for management review. Skills & Expertise HR and Administration Compensation & Other Benefits As per company policy. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka (Motijheel)

Porcelanosa Bangladesh is looking for a proactive, organized, and detail-oriented Executive/Sr. Executive, HR & Administration to support the effective management of human resources and administrative operations. Requirements Education Higher Secondary Educational Requirements : Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Computer Science, Information Technology, or any related discipline. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Software Company Additional Requirements Experience Requirements : Minimum 2-3 years of hands-on experience in Corporate Sales, IT Sales, Software Sales, ERP Sales, SaaS Sales, or Business Development. Experience in selling Accounting Software, ERP, HRM, CRM, Custom Software, or other IT solutions will be given preference. Candidates with an existing corporate client network will receive additional preference. Required Skills & Competencies Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Strong negotiation and relationship-building abilities. Ability to understand business requirements and recommend appropriate technology solutions. Sound knowledge of ERP, HRM, Accounting Software, CRM, Web Applications, Mobile Applications, and Custom Software concepts. Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and achieve sales targets. Strong follow-up, reporting, and documentation skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and CRM software. Positive attitude, professional appearance, and willingness to travel for regular corporate client visits. Responsibilities & Context About F. A. Creative Firm Limited F. A. Creative Firm Limited is a growing Software Development and Digital Solutions Company committed to helping businesses accelerate their digital transformation through innovative and customized technology solutions. We specialize in developing enterprise software and business automation systems for organizations of all sizes. Our Core Solutions Accounting Software HRM & Payroll Software CRM Solutions ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) Custom Software Development Web Applications Android & iOS Mobile Applications Online Newspaper Management System ePaper Solutions Online TV & Media Platforms Domain, Hosting & Business Email Solutions We are looking for an experienced, energetic, self-motivated, and target-driven Field Executive (Sales & Business Development) to identify new business opportunities, build strong corporate relationships, and generate software sales. Job Responsibilities Visit corporate offices and business organizations to promote the company's software products and digital solutions. Identify new business opportunities through corporate visits, networking, referrals, and market research. Arrange and conduct professional meetings with prospective clients. Understand clients' business processes and identify opportunities for business automation. Present and demonstrate ERP, HRM, Payroll, Accounting, CRM, Custom Software, Mobile Applications, Web Applications, Online Newspaper, ePaper, Online TV, and other IT solutions. Gather business requirements and coordinate with the Technical Project Manager for solution planning, project estimation, and proposal preparation. Prepare quotations and proposals in collaboration with the internal technical team. Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing and prospective corporate clients. Follow up with prospects until successful project confirmation and deal closing. Maintain accurate CRM records, daily visit reports, and sales activity reports. Achieve monthly sales targets, client meeting targets, and lead generation goals. Coordinate with internal departments to ensure smooth project handover after project confirmation. Skills & Expertise Business Development Software Sales Compensation & Other Benefits Negotiable Salary Attractive Sales Commission Performance Bonus Mobile Bill Travel Allowance (Official Field Visits) Yearly Salary Review 2 Festival Bonuses (As per Company Policy) Professional Training & Continuous Skill Development Clear Career Growth Based on Performance Opportunity to Work with Enterprise Software, ERP & Digital Transformation Projects Friendly, Professional & Collaborative Working Environment Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Chattogram (Agrabad)

Requirements Education Bachelor of Science (BSc) Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Computer Hardware/Network Companies, Garments, Multinational Companies, Software Company, Technical Infrastructure, Textile Additional Requirements Age 25 to 35 years IT end user support experience. Customer Service oriented. Effective communication with end users and colleagues in the IT area. Oriented to the fulfillment of policies, procedures as well as the follow-up of the assigned tasks. Experience as Service Desk, Helpdesk or Network Support. Experience in remote support of IT problems and escalation of incidents to other IT Areas. Experience in Service Desk Platforms (Service-Now or similar) Strong understanding of IT Networking services (Internet Services, DNS, TCP/IP, WAN LAN SERVICES). Responsibilities & Context The IT Support Sn Technician is responsible for providing advanced remote technical support to GILDAN users globally, focusing on complex and critical issues that require specialized knowledge and elevated access privileges. The Global position is responsible for the onboarding, testing, and deployment of new automation technologies across all regions, as well as the responsible of the administration of massive end-user accounts in different systems, and IT support tools that impacts users globally. With the Highest privileges on the systems will be responsible of the account administration. Major Responsibilities Oversee the management of software and tools required for the global administration of accounts, and ticketing systems across all regions. Ensure that solutions are standardized and scalable to meet global needs. Create and update documentation for known issues and solutions with a global audience in mind and provide training to Level 1 and Level 2 support teams worldwide to ensure consistent support practices across all locations. Identify and standardize IT lifecycle processes across all regions to ensure global consistency. Develop and maintain documentation for known issues and solutions with a global scope. Identify advanced automation technologies that are compatible with Gildan’s global operations and integrate them seamlessly into existing systems worldwide to optimize efficiency and scalability. Identify and address existing problems by analyzing patterns and behaviors in devices across all regions, conducting thorough root cause analysis of recurring issues to prevent future incidents and enhance system reliability on a global scale. Leverage the global ticketing database to predict upcoming issues and proactively reduce future problems worldwide, ensuring continuous improvement in IT support and system performance. Perform internal audits to Account management processes, deep technical expertise and forensic, with elevated access privileges. Guarantee the daily operation compliance and supervise any daily operations of account creation, audit creations, departures, and modifications, responsible for account management KPI compliance and participate and be responsible of any audit related to account management, assist in any continuous improvement for account management. Lead and participate in the planning, development, and execution of global IT support projects focused on enhancing IT services and infrastructure across all regions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams worldwide to implement new technologies, tools, and processes that boost the efficiency and capabilities of IT support on a global scale, ensuring consistency and alignment with Gildan’s global operations. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1543811&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education BBA/MBA in International Business, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Marketing or related discipline. Graduates/Postgraduates in English/EEE/CSE with strong business communication skills are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 20 to 40 years Experience Requirements 1–5 years relevant experience in International Sourcing, Foreign Communication, Procurement, Import/Export, International Business or Supply Chain. Fresh graduates with excellent English communication and strong commercial aptitude may also be considered for Executive. Additional Requirements Excellent English communication and business correspondence skills. Strong negotiation and supplier relationship management skills. Good understanding of international sourcing, procurement and import processes. Ability to communicate confidently with Chinese and overseas suppliers. Good analytical and MS Excel skills. Proactive, organized and result-oriented. Preferred / Advantage Experience in industrial machinery, textile/garments machinery, printing/digital printing/sublimation machinery, spare parts, China sourcing, machinery trading/import or B2B business will be preferred. Responsibilities & Context Job Context Hasan Trade is a leading industrial machinery importer and solution provider in Bangladesh, serving the Textile, Garments, Printing, Signage, Packaging, Manufacturing and related industries. We are looking for a dynamic, commercially minded and result-oriented professional to manage international sourcing and supplier coordination while supporting new product sourcing, market development and business growth initiatives. Key Responsibilities International Sourcing & Supplier Development Identify and develop overseas manufacturers, suppliers and potential business partners, particularly from China. Source industrial machinery, spare parts, printing equipment, inks, consumables and related products based on market and customer requirements. Communicate with overseas suppliers regarding product specifications, pricing, MOQ, lead time, payment terms and commercial matters. Evaluate and compare suppliers/products and negotiate competitive pricing and favorable terms. Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential overseas suppliers. Procurement & Import Coordination Coordinate procurement activities from requirement identification to order confirmation and shipment. Follow up PI, purchase orders, production, inspection, packing and shipment with overseas suppliers. Coordinate LC/TT payment and commercial/shipping documentation with Finance, Commercial and Logistics teams. Monitor shipment schedules and maintain proper supplier, order and shipment records. Business Development & Market Expansion Conduct market research to identify new products, technologies, brands and business opportunities. Explore potential international brands/manufacturers for new partnerships and product representation. Identify products and solutions with potential for introduction and expansion in Bangladesh. Support Sales & Marketing with product information, supplier capabilities, pricing and market intelligence. Assist Management in evaluating new products, brands and business opportunities. Cross-functional Coordination Coordinate with Sales & Marketing, Commercial, Logistics and Service teams for smooth business execution. Coordinate product-related technical queries, spare parts and after-sales requirements with overseas suppliers and the Service Department. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills International Sourcing Supply Chain Management Compensation & Other Benefits Attractive salary package (Negotiable based on experience and competency) Mobile allowance Festival bonuses Other benefits as per company policy & Practice Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Purana Paltan)

We are seeking an energetic, analytical, and performance-driven SCM professional to manage end-to-end local procurement and import supply chain operations for our Garments Accessories manufacturing facility. 1. Local Sourcing & Procurement Management:
Review and verify Local PRs based on technical specifications, stock positions, and required delivery dates.
Collect quotations, prepare Comparative Statements (CS), and negotiate price, quality, MOQ, lead time, and payment terms.

Handle local vendor claims, short supplies, rejections, replacements, and payment documentation.

Manage import procurement activities from requirement planning to final receipt at the factory warehouse.

Work closely with Commercial and Finance teams to ensure proper utilization of Bond facilities and entitlement allocations.

Coordinate with Planning, Production, Stores, QA, Maintenance, Accounts, and Commercial teams to align material arrivals with production schedules.
Monitor minimum/maximum stock levels, consumption rates, and pipeline stock to prevent stockouts or over-inventory.
Oversee material receiving, inspection clearance, and quantity verification with QA and Store departments.

Responsibilities & Context Job Purpose: The Officer – Admin is responsible for ensuring smooth and efficient administrative operations across the organization. This role focuses on managing office facilities, coordinating vendor services, maintaining company assets, and implementing effective administrative processes to support business operations. The position ensures that workplace systems are well-organized, efficient, and aligned with company standards. By coordinating with internal departments and external service providers, the Officer – Admin supports operational efficiency, effective resource use, and a safe, clean, and productive work environment. The role also supports continuous improvement in workplace management and administrative control to enhance the overall employee experience and contribute to organizational objectives. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily administrative activities to ensure smooth and efficient office operations. Monitor office supplies and inventory, ensuring timely procurement and adequate stock availability. Coordinate with external vendors and service providers for office maintenance, repairs, and other essential services. Maintain accurate records of company assets, office equipment, inventory, and administrative documentation. Provide administrative support to internal departments, including correspondence, scheduling, documentation, and other operational requirements. Ensure the office environment remains clean, safe, organized, and fully functional in accordance with company standards. Support the implementation of administrative policies, procedures, and process improvements to enhance workflow efficiency. Monitor the proper use, maintenance, and preservation of company assets and administrative resources. Serve as a key point of contact for internal departments and external stakeholders regarding administrative matters, ensuring effective communication and coordination. Identify administrative needs and operational challenges and recommend practical solutions to improve workplace efficiency and service quality. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1543788&fc.source_content: Requirements Education Bachelor in Engineering (BEngg) Masters in Engineering (MEngg) Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Garments, Manufacturing (FMCG), Manufacturing (Light Engineering and Heavy Industry) Responsibilities & Context Job Summary We are seeking an experienced and proactive Senior Executive / Executive -Supply Chain Management to support and oversee the overall Supply Chain function. The incumbent will be responsible for end-to-end supply chain operations, including local and international sourcing, procurement, inventory management, warehousing, logistics, and supplier relationship management. The role will act as the second-in-command of the department and ensure smooth business operations in the absence of the department head. Key Responsibilities: Support the Head of Supply Chain in managing the overall department. Develop and execute supply chain strategies to ensure uninterrupted business operations. Source raw materials, machinery, spare parts, and other operational requirements from both local and international suppliers. Identify, evaluate, and develop new overseas suppliers to ensure quality, competitive pricing, and reliable delivery. Conduct supplier negotiations, price analysis, contract management, and vendor performance evaluations. Coordinate import procurement activities, including purchase orders, shipping schedules, Incoterms, freight forwarding, customs clearance, and documentation. Ensure timely procurement of materials while optimizing cost, quality, and lead time. Manage inventory planning, warehouse operations, and stock control to minimize shortages and excess inventory. Oversee inbound and outbound logistics and transportation activities. Collaborate with Production, Commercial, Finance, Quality, and Engineering departments to meet operational requirements. Monitor supply chain KPIs and prepare analytical reports for management. Ensure compliance with procurement policies, regulatory requirements, and company procedures. Lead, mentor, and develop the Supply Chain team. Perform the responsibilities of the Head of Supply Chain Management in their absence. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Cross-functional Collaboration Customs Documentation Inventory Management Performance Management Supply Chain Management Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka, Jamalpur

Requirements Education Bachelor’s Degree from Recognized University in Management / HRM / Public Administration Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Architecture Firm, Engineering Firms, HVAC System, Interior Design Additional Requirements Only Male 2–3 years of similar professional experience. Experience from Real Estate / Engineering Firm / Construction / Industrial are priority. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PDF Edit, Powerpoint is Mandatory. Skills in English and Bangla typing are required Skills in Emailing, Office Letter, Agreement, Application, SOP, Notice writing. Knowledge of Bangladesh Labor Act. Excellency in organizational communication and interpersonal skill. Good command of both English and Bangla Responsibilities & Context Brownfield Engineering Limited (BFEL) is an established engineering and project execution company in Bangladesh, engaged in industrial, power, Real Estate, infrastructure and engineering projects. We work with leading local and international organizations and maintain a professional, disciplined and performance-driven working environment. We are looking for a smart, responsible and well-organized Executive – Administration who can effectively support our day-to-day corporate administration and coordinate with management, employees, vendors and external stakeholders. Coordinate with vendors, service providers, government offices, and external stakeholders. Arrange official travel, transportation, hotel bookings, and other logistical requirements. Monitor office support staff, drivers, security, and housekeeping activities, where applicable. Maintain confidentiality of company information documents, update / renewal of license, employee records, and management discussions. Organize company’s event, managing supplies and training session for employee development. Follow up on assigned tasks within deadline and perform other relevant HR & Admin duties as required by management. raw_source_fields.age: 25 to 45 years Responsibilities & Context চাকরির দায়িত্বসমূহ: কোম্পানির বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধি ও ব্যবসায়িক উন্নয়নের লক্ষ্যে মার্চেন্ডাইজিং কৌশল প্রণয়ন ও বাস্তবায়ন করা। পণ্য সংগ্রহ, সরবরাহকারীদের সঙ্গে সম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা, মূল্য নির্ধারণ, ক্রয় এবং পণ্যের পর্যাপ্ত মজুত নিশ্চিত করা। পণ্যের বৈচিত্র্য, মজুতের পরিমাণ, বিক্রয় কার্যক্রম এবং বাজারের চাহিদা পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। বিভিন্ন আউটলেট বা বিভাগে সময়মতো পণ্য ক্রয় ও সরবরাহ নিশ্চিত করা। প্রতিযোগিতামূলক মূল্য, উন্নত মানের পণ্য এবং অনুকূল ব্যবসায়িক শর্ত নিশ্চিত করতে সরবরাহকারীদের সঙ্গে আলোচনা ও দর-কষাকষি করা। বিক্রয়, ক্রয়, মজুত ব্যবস্থাপনা এবং স্টোর পরিচালনা বিভাগের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করে কাজ করা। লাভজনকতা বৃদ্ধির জন্য নতুন পণ্য, সরবরাহকারী এবং বাজারের সুযোগ চিহ্নিত করা। পণ্যের গুণগত মান বজায় রাখা এবং সঠিক মার্চেন্ডাইজিং কার্যক্রম নিশ্চিত করা। বিক্রয়, পণ্য মজুত, ক্রয় এবং বিভাগের কার্যক্রমের ওপর নিয়মিত প্রতিবেদন তৈরি করা। শিক্ষাগত যোগ্যতা: ন্যূনতম এইচএসসি (HSC) পাস। অভিজ্ঞতা: মার্চেন্ডাইজিং, রিটেইল ম্যানেজমেন্ট, সুপারশপ পরিচালনা, পণ্য ক্রয় অথবা সংশ্লিষ্ট ক্ষেত্রে ন্যূনতম ২ বছরের বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতা থাকতে হবে।

Requirements Education Passionate and energetic individuals having a graduation with business background. Additional Requirements Previous experience (6+ months) in a similar role will get preference, however fresh graduates are highly encouraged to apply. Geographical mobility and flexibility. Excellent in communication skills. Fluency in English is much expected. Good in interpersonal skills, having the ability to establish rapport and negotiate issues. Conversant with computer literacy - ability to navigate online platforms and work with Microsoft Office Applications. Responsibilities & Context Prime Responsibilities Bank Representatives are Eastern Bank employees who will be posted at the agent banking premises to ensure the following tasks on behalf of the bank. Agent banking premises are owned by the agents appointed by the bank under specific agreement between the bank and agents according to the central bank guidelines. Usually one bank representative is posted at each agent banking outlet to Overall monitor and supervision of Agent Outlet Acquire new business and strengthen customer relationship Implement sales strategies for Agent Banking Ensure authenticity of Data for MIS and record purpose Manage agent outlet effectively & efficiently to drive sustainable business Guide and monitor the agent staffs Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Customer Relationship Data analysis Monitoring Banking Compensation & Other Benefits Monthly gross salary of BDT. 31,000. Festival & performance bonus, hospitalization & maternity reimbursement, leave facility and other admissible benefits as per People Management Policy of EBL. Absorption process facility to become full time employee of the bank after 18 months of joining depending on performance and discipline. Will be able to work in a customer-centric, tech-driven as well as competitive environment. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Requirements Education Graduate/Postgraduate Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Age 25 to 45 years Must have a minimum of 2 years of practical experience in a similar position. Age requirements may be relaxed for highly experienced candidates. Female candidates are encouraged to apply; Motorcycle driving skills with a valid driving license. Demonstrable honesty, strong work ethic, and proactiveness. This position may require working extra hours during emergencies or urgent situations. Responsibilities & Context CSS is a humanitarian and socio-economic development organization that has been operating in Bangladesh since 1972. Within the Health Sector, CSS manages the Reverend Abdul Wadud Memorial Hospital (RAWMH), a 100-bed general hospital located in Tilok, Rupsha, Khulna. We are looking for an experienced “Administrator” who will be responsible for ensuring the smooth execution of all administrative tasks at Reverend Abdul Wadud Memorial Hospital. Job Responsibilities: Monitor the duties of nurses, including their duty rosters prepared by the Matron. Monitor the activities of security guards and ensure they have a proper understanding of their responsibilities. Ensure cleanliness inside the hospital as well as within the hospital campus, including the proper incineration of waste at regular intervals, safe disposal of ashes, and conducting periodic rounds of all hospital facilities. In case of any discrepancies or irregularities, take necessary actions in consultation with the supervisor. Ensure the maintenance of staff files by the responsible staff, including leave approvals, updating of the leave register, preparing and submitting leave reports to the head office, tracking staff records related to probation and performance, and timely dispatching of information to the head office. Maintain appropriate and adequate inventory of all medical and non-medical goods in the central store to ensure smooth service delivery at all hospital stations, by ensuring proper storekeeping through maintenance of stock registers, ledgers, and BIN cards by the Store In-Charge. Ensure that the six-monthly physical inventory report is prepared and maintained in the central store. Ensure proper maintenance of the hospital building and staff quarters. Supervise and ensure the proper functioning of the kitchen and laundry, the hygienic preparation of food, and the overall cleanliness of these areas, and resolve issues as needed. Supervise internal management by providing motivation and guidance to staff. Guide drivers in the maintenance of vehicles and ensure that all necessary documents are properly maintained. Carry out any other tasks assigned by the supervisor/higher authorities. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Administration Human Resource Management Staff Supervision Store/ inventory Vehicle Management Waste Management Compensation & Other Benefits After being permanent upon successful completion of the probation period (six months), other benefits will be provided as per the organizational policy i.e., provident fund, gratuity, festival bonus, yearly increment, staff insurance (kormi Bima), medical allowance (Kormi Sohayota Tohobil) etc. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Khulna

We are looking for an experienced “Administrator” who will be responsible for ensuring the smooth execution of all administrative tasks at Reverend Abdul Wadud Memorial Hospital.
Job Responsibilities:
Monitor the duties of nurses, including their duty rosters prepared by the Matron.
Monitor the activities of security guards and ensure they have a proper understanding of their responsibilities.
Ensure cleanliness inside the hospital as well as within the hospital campus, including the proper incineration of waste at regular intervals, safe disposal of ashes, and conducting periodic rounds of all hospital facilities. In case of any discrepancies or irregularities, take necessary actions in consultation with the supervisor.
Ensure the maintenance of staff files by the responsible staff, including leave approvals, updating of the leave register, preparing and submitting leave reports to the head office, tracking staff records related to probation and performance, and timely dispatching of information to the head office.
