Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, or a related discipline. Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Group of Companies, IT Enabled Service Additional Requirements Key Qualifications: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to convert data and research into practical business recommendations. Strong understanding of market research, competitor analysis, customer behavior, and business fundamentals. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets; knowledge of dashboards and reporting tools is an advantage. Practical knowledge of AI tools for research, analysis, reporting, and productivity. Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and coordination skills. Ability to prepare professional business reports, presentations, proposals, and analysis. Strong commercial awareness with the ability to identify business opportunities and understand their potential impact. Experience Requirements: 2+ years of relevant experience in Business Development, Market Research, Business Analysis, Sales, or related areas is preferred. Responsibilities & Context We are looking for a proactive and analytical Executive, Business Development (Digital Commerce and AI) to identify new business opportunities, support growth initiatives, and drive commercial performance. The role will focus on market research, business analysis, opportunity identification, partnership development, and cross-functional execution. Key Responsibilities: Research market trends, customer preferences, competitor activities, industry developments, and emerging business opportunities. Analyze sales, customer, product, and market data to identify growth opportunities and performance gaps. Identify and recommend new products, markets, customer segments, partnerships, and business initiatives. Generate and evaluate potential business leads, partnerships, and growth opportunities. Use AI tools and platforms to accelerate market research, competitor analysis, data analysis, business intelligence, content preparation, and reporting. Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve business processes, customer experience, digital commerce operations, and team productivity. Evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools, and business use cases and recommend practical applications for the organization. Support the development of business proposals, presentations, business cases, and partnership plans. Conduct market and competitor analysis to support business decisions and strategic initiatives. Monitor key business and growth metrics, including revenue, customer acquisition, conversion, customer retention, and campaign performance. Prepare regular reports and dashboards highlighting business performance, key findings, opportunities, and recommended actions. Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, E-commerce, Product, Finance, and other relevant teams to execute business development initiatives. Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to support partnership and business development activities. Evaluate the effectiveness of business and growth initiatives and recommend improvements. Maintain business development action plans and follow up with relevant teams to ensure timely execution. Verify the accuracy and reliability of business data, reports, research findings, and analysis. Monitor emerging technologies, consumer behavior, and market developments and assess their potential business impact. Support process and workflow improvements to improve business development efficiency and execution. Perform other business development and analytical tasks assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Business Development Market Research Business Analysis Competitor Analysis Market trend analysis Artificial intelligence (AI) Compensation & Other Benefits Festival Bonuses Competitive Salary Yearly Salary Review Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Gulshan)

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor/Honors Diploma Graduate/Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (Business Administration, English, or related fields preferred).

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1541725&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Diploma Graduate/Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (Business Administration, English, or related fields preferred). Experience At most 3 years Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age At least 20 years Experience: 0 to 3 years of experience in executive assistance, secretarial work, or general administration. Fresh graduates with excellent communication skills and a strong desire to learn are highly encouraged to apply. Language Proficiency: Fluent in both written and spoken English and Bengali (Essential). Knowledge of Japanese language (JLPT N5/N4 or basic conversation) or previous experience working with Japanese expatriates is a strong plus, but not mandatory. Technical Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and communication tools (Zoom, WhatsApp, Email). Soft Skills: High level of integrity, trust, and confidentiality. Strong interpersonal skills with a polite, helpful, and professional attitude. Adaptable, self-motivated, and comfortable working in a dynamic startup/pre-launch environment. Working Hours: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Saturday to Thursday) Workplace & Transition Plan: Phase 1 (Immediate to December 2026): Flexible hybrid model (Work from Home with regular meetings/desk-work at the temporary office/expatriate residence in Bashundhara R/A, Dhaka). Phase 2 (From January 2027): Relocation to our brand-new factory office at the Bangladesh Special Economic Zone (BSEZ) in Araihazar. Transportation support or allowance will be discussed and provided upon transition. Responsibilities & Context We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and reliable Executive Assistant & Admin Officer to join our team for the exciting launch of Bengal IRIS Takumi Ltd. (a subsidiary of IRIS Co., Ltd., Japan). In this role, you will work closely with our Japanese Managing Director, providing critical secretarial, administrative, and logistical support to ensure smooth daily operations during our pre-launch and transition phases. Support office administration, operational requirements, and interdepartmental coordination while assisting Management with assigned accounts-related tasks. Requirements Education Masters in Accounting/Finance from a reputed university Professional qualification on Supply Chain Management Background of Civil Engineering or Apparel Merchandising are encouraged to apply Relevant Certifications in Supply Chain Management are advantageous. Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Supply Chain Additional Requirements Key Qualifications: Good knowledge of local and international procurement processes. Understanding of commercial operations, import/shipment documentation, and inventory management. Strong negotiation, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel. Strong attention to detail, follow-up, and coordination skills. Experience Requirements: 3+ years of relevant experience in Procurement, Commercial, Supply Chain, or related fields. Experience in LC, import, international procurement, or commercial operations will be preferred. Fresh graduates with strong potential may also be considered. Responsibilities & Context We are looking for a capable Sr. Executive, Procurement & Commercial to manage and support local and international procurement and commercial activities. The role will coordinate with suppliers, process procurement and commercial documentation, follow up on orders and shipments, and coordinate invoices and payments. The position will work closely with internal departments to ensure timely procurement, smooth material flow, and effective resolution of supplier and commercial issues. Key Responsibilities: Source and coordinate with local and international suppliers to ensure competitive pricing, quality, and timely delivery. Collect and evaluate quotations, prepare comparative statements, negotiate prices, and support procurement decisions. Prepare and process Purchase Orders (PO), Work Orders (WO), and other procurement documents. Follow up on purchase orders, production, deliveries, shipments, and supplier commitments. Coordinate local and international procurement, including import, shipment, and commercial documentation. Coordinate LC opening, amendments, and related documentation with suppliers and Finance/Banking teams. Follow up on LC terms, shipment schedules, shipping documents, and supplier commitments. Coordinate with Merchandising, Finance, Logistics, Stores, and other departments for smooth procurement and material flow. Verify supplier invoices, bills, and supporting documents and coordinate payment processing with Finance. Maintain supplier records, procurement data, LC status, order/shipment status, and related reports. Monitor supplier performance and coordinate resolution of delivery, quality, pricing, and commercial issues. Support cost-saving initiatives through negotiation, alternative sourcing, and supplier comparison. Coordinate with Stores and relevant departments to ensure timely availability of required materials. Support inventory planning by monitoring procurement status and material requirements. Ensure procurement and commercial activities comply with company policies, approved procedures, and applicable requirements. Maintain professional relationships with suppliers and support supplier development. Prepare regular procurement and commercial reports for management. Follow Bank and applicable Regulatory/ Head Office policies on KYC, AML/CFT, confidentiality and fair selling; escalate suspected fraud and complaints. Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Accounting & Information System, Accounting, Cost & Management Accounting, Cost Accounting, Finance Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Immigration and Education Consultancy Service Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age At least 22 years Only Male Interested candidates who meet the mandatory requirements are requested to email their updated CV and a cover letter to career@okimmigration.ca, explaining their knowledge of double-entry accounting, proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude, and relevant IT or accounting experience, as well as how their skills would help OK Immigration clear its accounting backlog, standardize financial records, and develop a customized accounting solution during the four-month internship. Responsibilities & Context Position Overview OK Immigration is seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Accounting & IT Intern (Accounting Systems Development) for a four-month, full-time internship at our Chattogram office. This hands-on role is designed for an accounting student or recent graduate who wants to apply theoretical knowledge in a real business environment while helping us clear our accounting backlog, standardize records, and build a customized accounting solution using suitable digital applications. Mandatory Requirements · Sound knowledge of double-entry bookkeeping, including debits, credits, journal entries, general ledgers, trial balances, and basic financial statements. · Practical skills in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, financial calculations, and data organization. · Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Claude, and the ability to use them thoughtfully for research, spreadsheet support, and workflow development. · A combination of accounting knowledge and relevant IT proficiency is essential. · Strong attention to detail, analytical ability, confidentiality, and willingness to learn and implement new processes. Additional Qualifications — Preferred · Currently studying or recently completed a degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline. · Familiarity with QuickBooks, Xero, Tally, Zoho Books, or other accounting applications. · Experience with advanced spreadsheets, PivotTables, data validation, automation, cloud applications, or low-code/no-code tools. · Any practical experience in bookkeeping, account reconciliation, financial data entry, or reporting. Job Responsibilities Accounting & Backlog Clearance · Review and organize historical transactions and supporting documents to help clear pending bookkeeping work. · Post transactions using double-entry principles; maintain journals, ledgers, cashbooks, and basic accounting schedules. · Assist with reconciliation of bank transactions, receipts, expenses, payables, and receivables; flag discrepancies for review. Standardization & System Development · Help design a suitable chart of accounts and standardized templates for income, expenses, receivables, payables, and reporting. · Work with management to evaluate, configure, test, and document a customized accounting solution using relevant applications. · Help build accurate spreadsheet formulas, reports, checks, and practical procedures that the team can continue using. AI & Technology Support · Use ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and other suitable tools to support research, spreadsheet development, documentation, and workflow improvements. · Check all AI-generated formulas, classifications, and outputs before use; protect confidential financial information. · Explore simple automation opportunities to reduce repetitive data entry and improve consistency. Reporting & Team Support · Prepare basic financial summaries and progress updates on backlog clearance and system development. · Organize electronic records and perform other related accounting and systems-support tasks assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Accounting Accounts and Finance Accounting Software Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Chattogram (Chittagong GPO)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Responsibilities & Context
OK Immigration is seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Accounting & IT Intern (Accounting Systems Development) for a four-month, full-time internship at our Chattogram office. This hands-on role is designed for an accounting student or recent graduate who wants to apply theoretical knowledge in a real business environment while helping us clear our accounting backlog, standardize records, and build a customized accounting solution using suitable digital applications.
· Sound knowledge of double-entry bookkeeping, including debits, credits, journal entries, general ledgers, trial balances, and basic financial statements.
· Practical skills in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, financial calculations, and data organization.
· Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Claude, and the ability to use them thoughtfully for research, spreadsheet support, and workflow development.
· A combination of accounting knowledge and relevant IT proficiency is essential.
· Strong attention to detail, analytical ability, confidentiality, and willingness to learn and implement new processes.
· Currently studying or recently completed a degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
· Familiarity with QuickBooks, Xero, Tally, Zoho Books, or other accounting applications.
· Experience with advanced spreadsheets, PivotTables, data validation, automation, cloud applications, or low-code/no-code tools.
· Any practical experience in bookkeeping, account reconciliation, financial data entry, or reporting.
· Review and organize historical transactions and supporting documents to help clear pending bookkeeping work.
· Post transactions using double-entry principles; maintain journals, ledgers, cashbooks, and basic accounting schedules.
· Assist with reconciliation of bank transactions, receipts, expenses, payables, and receivables; flag discrepancies for review.
· Help design a suitable chart of accounts and standardized templates for income, expenses, receivables, payables, and reporting.
· Work with management to evaluate, configure, test, and document a customized accounting solution using relevant applications.
· Help build accurate spreadsheet formulas, reports, checks, and practical procedures that the team can continue using.
· Use ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and other suitable tools to support research, spreadsheet development, documentation, and workflow improvements.
· Check all AI-generated formulas, classifications, and outputs before use; protect confidential financial information.
· Explore simple automation opportunities to reduce repetitive data entry and improve consistency.
· Prepare basic financial summaries and progress updates on backlog clearance and system development.
· Organize electronic records and perform other related accounting and systems-support tasks assigned by management.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Gender
Only males are allowed to apply.
Job Location
Chattogram (Chittagong GPO)
Job Highlights
A four month, hands on internship combining accounting and technology. Apply double-entry bookkeeping, use AI and spreadsheets, clear accounting backlogs, and help develop a customized accounting system under management guidance.

Minimum of 1 year of relevant experience in HR and accounts. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Tally Prime software . Responsibilities & Context A+ Consultancy & Mega Solutions is as specialized company for complete infrastructure safety solution in Bangladesh provides a versatile range of products and services include the design, consultancy, supply, engineering, installation and maintenance. We are looking for dynamic personal who are ready to lead the team, achieve growth and enhance our specialization. Job Location: Gulshan- Badda Link Road, Dhaka. Job Description: We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented HR and Accounts Executive to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing HR functions and assisting with basic accounting tasks. This position is a fantastic opportunity for an individual looking to grow their career in human resources and accounting. Key Responsibilities: Daily Cash Inflow check and entry to TALLY SOFTWARE (Specially in TALLY Prime) Maintain petty cash, ledger book, registers & Prepare to invoices, expense forms and payment request Monitor and follow-up on outstanding receivables. Quarterly and annual financial reports Ensure bill, voucher checking, verifying and proper recording as per guideline Handle accounts including invoice process Prepare & maintain mushak TDS and VDS treasury challan. Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors BBA/ MBA, B.COM/M.COM, BBS/ MBS (Accounting/Finance) Responsibilities & Context চাকরির সারসংক্ষেপ: কর্মস্থল: Dhaka (Purana Paltan) চাকরির দায়িত্বসমূহ এবং কনটেক্সট: অফিস টাইম: রবিবার-বৃহস্পতিবার (৯.৩০-৭.০০) শনিবার ট্রেনিং (৯.৩০-৭.০০) Responsibilities: ব্যক্তি শ্রেণীর আয়কর রিটার্ণ প্রস্তুত করা (Individual Tax Return Preparation). অনলাইনে ব্যক্তি শ্রেণীর আয়কর রিটার্ণ প্রস্তুত করা (Online Individual Tax Return Preparation). কোম্পানির আয়কর রিটার্ণ প্রস্তুত করা (Company Tax Return Preparation). Corporate Tax Planning সংক্রান্ত কাজ। External Audit সংক্রান্ত কাজ। Management Audit, Internal Audit, Inventory Audit সংক্রান্ত কাজ। Preparation of Financial Statements. Value Added Tax (VAT) সংক্রান্ত কাজ। Registrar of Joint Stock Companies and Firms (RJSC) সংক্রান্ত কাজ। National Board of Revenue (NBR) সংক্রান্ত কাজ। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounting Software Financial Analysis Financial Reporting Internal Audit Tax Return Submission Vat management Compensation & Other Benefits বেতন: টাকা. ৮০০০ (মাসিক) কম্পেন্সেশন এবং অন্যান্য সুবিধাসমূহ: ব্যক্তি শ্রেণীর আয়কর রিটার্ন প্রস্তুত করা হাতে কলমে শিখানো হবে। অনলাইনে ব্যক্তি শ্রেণীর আয়কর রিটার্ন প্রস্তুত করা হাতে কলমে শিখানো হবে। কোম্পানি আয়কর রিটার্ন প্রস্তুত করা হাতে কলমে শিখানো হবে। Corporate Tax Planning হাতে কলমে শিখানো হবে। Value Added Tax (VAT) সংক্রান্ত কাজ হাতে কলমে শিখানো হবে। Registrar of Joint Stock Companies and Firms (RJSC) সংক্রান্ত কাজ হাতে কলমে শিখানো হবে। NBR সংক্রান্ত কাজ হাতে কলমে শিখানো হবে। External Audit সংক্রান্ত কাজ হাতে কলমে শিখানো হবে। Management Audit, Internal Audit, Inventory Audit সংক্রান্ত কাজ হাতে কলমে শিখানো হবে। Financial Statement Preparation হাতে কলমে শিখানো হবে। Tally ও Excel এর কাজ হাতে কলমে শিখানো হবে। অনভিজ্ঞদের বিশেষ ট্রেনিং এর মাধ্যমে তাদের কর্মদক্ষতা বাড়ানো হবে। প্রত্যেক শনিবার ৯.৩০ থেকে ৭.০০ পযন্ত ট্রেনিং এর সূযোগ (IAS, IFRS, ISA & Tax-VAT) বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতার ফলে ক্যারিয়ার ডেভেলপমেন্ট করা সহজ হবে। কমপক্ষে ৬ মাস কাজ করলে Experience Certificate প্রদান করা হবে। সাপ্তাহিক বন্ধ: শুক্রবার। Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Purana Paltan)

raw_source_fields.age: 22 to 40 years Only Female Responsibilities & Context সিমুড (CMUD): প্রতিষ্ঠান পরিচিতি সেন্টার ফর মেডিক্যাল আল্ট্রাসাউন্ড অ্যান্ড ডপলার লিমিটেড (সিমুড) বাংলাদেশের একটি সর্বাধুনিক আল্ট্রাসাউন্ড প্রশিক্ষণ কেন্দ্র। এটি দেশের একমাত্র আল্ট্রাসাউন্ড প্রশিক্ষণ কেন্দ্র, যা একটি সরকারি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের অধিভুক্ত। এখানে ন্যূনতম এমবিবিএস ডিগ্রিধারী চিকিৎসকগণ আল্ট্রাসাউন্ড বিষয়ক বিভিন্ন কোর্স সম্পন্ন করেন। দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্যসমূহ শিক্ষার্থী সেবা ও কাউন্সেলিং ভর্তি এবং অন্যান্য বিষয়ে শিক্ষার্থীদের পরামর্শ ও দিকনির্দেশনা প্রদান। একাডেমিক ব্যবস্থাপনা ক্লাস রুটিন প্রণয়ন করা এবং ফ্যাকাল্টি ও ট্রেইনারদের সাথে সমন্বয় করা। এসএমএস, হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ, ফোনকল ও অন্যান্য মাধ্যমে শিক্ষার্থীদের ক্লাসের তথ্য জানানো। রুটিন অনুযায়ী ইন্সট্রাক্টর, ফ্যাকাল্টি ও ট্রেইনারদের উপস্থিতি নিশ্চিত করা। ব্যবহারিক ক্লাসের জন্য প্র্যাকটিক্যাল রুম, রোগী ও টেকনিশিয়ানের ব্যবস্থা করা। ডিএমইউ (DMU) ও সিএমইউ (CMU) সহ বিভিন্ন কোর্সের পরীক্ষা পরিচালনা করা। প্রশাসনিক ব্যবস্থাপনা স্থায়ী কর্মচারীদের ছুটি ও অন্যান্য প্রশাসনিক বিষয় তত্ত্বাবধান করা। কাস্টমার রিলেশনশিপ অফিসার, টেকনিশিয়ান ও আল্ট্রাসাউন্ড স্টাফদের কার্যক্রম তত্ত্বাবধান ও সহায়তা করা। অফিস ও অবকাঠামো ব্যবস্থাপনা অফিসের সার্বিক নিরাপত্তা ও পরিচ্ছন্নতা নিশ্চিত করা। খাবার ও বিশ্রামকক্ষ রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ করা। আর্থিক ও কারিগরি সহায়তা এক্সেল ব্যবহার করে মাসিক আয়-ব্যয়ের হিসাব প্রস্তুত ও রিপোর্ট জমা দেওয়া। কর্পোরেট অনুষ্ঠান ও ক্লাসের জন্য পাওয়ারপয়েন্ট প্রেজেন্টেশন তৈরিতে সহায়তা করা। Skills & Expertise Administration Human Resource Management Other Relevant Skills organization and administrative skills. Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Master of Business Administration (MBA) Bachelor/Honors Masters Experience At least 1 year Additional Requirements Age 22 to 40 years Only Female Responsibilities & Context সিমুড (CMUD): প্রতিষ্ঠান পরিচিতি সেন্টার ফর মেডিক্যাল আল্ট্রাসাউন্ড অ্যান্ড ডপলার লিমিটেড (সিমুড) বাংলাদেশের একটি সর্বাধুনিক আল্ট্রাসাউন্ড প্রশিক্ষণ কেন্দ্র। এটি দেশের একমাত্র আল্ট্রাসাউন্ড প্রশিক্ষণ কেন্দ্র, যা একটি সরকারি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের অধিভুক্ত। এখানে ন্যূনতম এমবিবিএস ডিগ্রিধারী চিকিৎসকগণ আল্ট্রাসাউন্ড বিষয়ক বিভিন্ন কোর্স সম্পন্ন করেন। দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্যসমূহ শিক্ষার্থী সেবা ও কাউন্সেলিং ভর্তি এবং অন্যান্য বিষয়ে শিক্ষার্থীদের পরামর্শ ও দিকনির্দেশনা প্রদান। একাডেমিক ব্যবস্থাপনা ক্লাস রুটিন প্রণয়ন করা এবং ফ্যাকাল্টি ও ট্রেইনারদের সাথে সমন্বয় করা। এসএমএস, হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ, ফোনকল ও অন্যান্য মাধ্যমে শিক্ষার্থীদের ক্লাসের তথ্য জানানো। রুটিন অনুযায়ী ইন্সট্রাক্টর, ফ্যাকাল্টি ও ট্রেইনারদের উপস্থিতি নিশ্চিত করা। ব্যবহারিক ক্লাসের জন্য প্র্যাকটিক্যাল রুম, রোগী ও টেকনিশিয়ানের ব্যবস্থা করা। ডিএমইউ (DMU) ও সিএমইউ (CMU) সহ বিভিন্ন কোর্সের পরীক্ষা পরিচালনা করা। প্রশাসনিক ব্যবস্থাপনা স্থায়ী কর্মচারীদের ছুটি ও অন্যান্য প্রশাসনিক বিষয় তত্ত্বাবধান করা। কাস্টমার রিলেশনশিপ অফিসার, টেকনিশিয়ান ও আল্ট্রাসাউন্ড স্টাফদের কার্যক্রম তত্ত্বাবধান ও সহায়তা করা। অফিস ও অবকাঠামো ব্যবস্থাপনা অফিসের সার্বিক নিরাপত্তা ও পরিচ্ছন্নতা নিশ্চিত করা। খাবার ও বিশ্রামকক্ষ রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ করা। আর্থিক ও কারিগরি সহায়তা এক্সেল ব্যবহার করে মাসিক আয়-ব্যয়ের হিসাব প্রস্তুত ও রিপোর্ট জমা দেওয়া। কর্পোরেট অনুষ্ঠান ও ক্লাসের জন্য পাওয়ারপয়েন্ট প্রেজেন্টেশন তৈরিতে সহায়তা করা। Skills & Expertise Administration Human Resource Management Other Relevant Skills organization and administrative skills. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1544874&fc.source_content: Requirements Education Diploma in Engineering Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Minimum Bachelor’s Degree from a recognized university. Additional Requirements Age 18 to 34 years Only Female Good communication skills in Bangla and English. Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Word, Excel, email, and online documentation systems. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to communicate professionally with clients over phone calls and messages. Honest, punctual, responsible, and willing to learn. Previous experience in visa processing, travel agencies, or customer service will be an advantage. Fresh graduates with the right attitude are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Must be proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, email, and online application systems. Must have strong attention to detail when preparing and checking visa application documents. Must be capable of maintaining accurate passport entry and exit records. Responsibilities & Context Our mission: To make international travel more accessible through professional visa assistance and reliable client service. Our tagline: Crafting Your Global Journey. Key Responsibilities Prepare, organize, and verify visa application documents according to destination-specific requirements. Handle visa application forms, supporting documents, and submission procedures. Coordinate visa application submissions through the relevant embassies, visa application centres, and authorized channels. Keep clients updated regarding application progress, additional document requirements, and processing timelines. Track passports from entry into the office until submission, collection, and final delivery to clients. Maintain accurate passport entry and exit registers and update application tracking records. Communicate with clients over phone calls, WhatsApp, and other official communication channels. Coordinate with internal team members to ensure timely and accurate application processing. Maintain client confidentiality and handle passports and sensitive documents responsibly. Follow company procedures, embassy guidelines, and established service standards. Skills & Expertise MS Excel MS Office Other Relevant Skills Visa Processing Air Ticketing and Visa processing. visa file processing. Compensation & Other Benefits T/A,Tour allowance,Mobile bill Lunch Facilities: Full Subsidize Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Competitive and negotiable salary based on qualifications and experience. Lunch bill provided by the company. Monthly phone bill allowance. Annual salary review. Other benefits according to company policy. Practical learning opportunities in international visa processing and travel consultancy. Opportunity to develop documentation, client management, communication, and professional coordination skills. Career growth opportunities based on performance and company requirements. Why Join Visa Crafters BD? At Visa Crafters BD, you will gain hands-on experience in international visa processing and travel services while working with a growing online travel agency. You will have the opportunity to develop valuable professional skills, learn destination-specific visa procedures, and build a career in the travel and tourism industry. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only females are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka (Banani)

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline from a recognized university. Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply. Experience At most 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Call Center Additional Requirements Age 24 to 30 years Experience Requirements 0–2 years of experience in Contact Centre / Call Centre / Customer Service will be preferred. Experience in Banking or Financial service customer support will be an added advantage. Additional Requirements Excellent communication skills in Bangla and basic English . Good listening and problem-solving skills. Ability to work in rotational shifts Basic computer skills (MS Office, typing, data entry). Customer-focused attitude with strong interpersonal skills. Responsibilities & Context Dhaka Logistics Services & Solution is looking for smart, enthusiastic, and customer-focused individuals for the position of Customer Service Executive - Contact Centre . Selected candidates will work under Dhaka Logistics Services & Solution and will be deputed to Mutual Trust Bank PLC (MTBL) to provide quality customer support and handle inbound and outbound calls from customers regarding banking services. This role is ideal for candidates interested in building a career in banking customer service and contact center operations . Key Responsibilities Handle inbound and outbound calls from customers regarding Mutual Trust Bank PLC. banking products and services. Provide accurate information about Banking services, products, and procedures. Resolve customer queries, complaints, and service requests in a professional manner. Maintain proper records of customer interactions in the system. Ensure high standards of customer service and maintain call quality. Follow contact centre guidelines, service standards, and compliance requirements. Ability to work in under pressure and roster based Achieve service performance targets set by management. Skills & Expertise Call Center Operation Communication Customer Care Problem solving and decision making Product Listing Typing Skill - Bengali and English Other Relevant Skills Customer Service Call Center Operation Outbound and Inbound Calls Complaint Resolution Customer Relationship Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Additional Requirements Required Skills Good communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Basic knowledge of Canva, photo editing, and video editing. Confidence in video shooting, appearing on camera, and conducting live sessions. Practical knowledge of Facebook Ads Manager and campaign performance analysis. Active interest in Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube marketing. Ability to communicate professionally with clients and business partners. Responsibilities & Context WE ARE HIRING: SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER Foreign Guides | Study Abroad & IELTS Are you creative, confident, and passionate about social media, content creation, and digital marketing? Join Foreign Guides and help us grow our online presence, reach prospective students, and build valuable business partnerships. Educational Requirements Undergraduate students and Bachelor’s degree holders are welcome to apply. Freshers with practical skills and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply. Shoot and edit promotional photos and videos. Conduct Facebook Live sessions and appear in promotional videos. Run, monitor, and analyse Facebook Ads campaigns. Analyse advertising performance, including reach, impressions, clicks, CTR, cost per lead, and campaign results. Prepare performance reports and recommend improvements to increase campaign effectiveness. Communicate with prospective students and clients, manage enquiries, and follow up on leads. Conduct B2B outreach to universities, educational institutions, agencies, and potential business partners. Support partnership development, brand awareness, and marketing campaigns for study abroad and IELTS services. Skills & Expertise Advertising & Promotion Advertising Branding Digital Marketing (Social Media Marketing) Marketing Other Relevant Skills Social Media Management Content Creation Graphic Design Compensation & Other Benefits Salary: BDT 15,000-20,000 per month, depending on skills and experience. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Shantinagar)

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1545347&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related discipline. Candidates with strong relevant experience and proven sales leadership ability may also be considered. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Healthcare/Lifestyle product, E-commerce, F-commerce Additional Requirements Age 25 to 32 years Experience Requirements 2–3 years of relevant experience in telesales, telemarketing, call center sales, or a similar sales role. Previous experience leading, supervising, or managing a telesales team will be an advantage. Additional Requirements Strong verbal communication, persuasion, negotiation, and customer-handling skills. Good leadership, interpersonal, team-coordination, and employee-motivation abilities. Proven ability to work toward sales targets and improve conversion rates. Familiarity with CRM systems, call monitoring, lead management, and sales reporting. Good analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills; proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets is an advantage. Strong sense of responsibility, discipline, time management, and ability to work under pressure. Responsibilities & Context Company Name: Buzzblu-Hedaaya Position: Telesales Leader / Telesales Manager Job Category: Sales & Marketing Job Level: Team Leader / Mid-Level Management Job Location: Shonir Akhra, Dhaka, Bangladesh Job Context: Buzzblu-Hedaaya is looking for dynamic, target-oriented, and experienced candidates to lead and supervise its telesales operations. The selected candidates will help achieve sales targets, guide telesales executives, improve conversion rates, maintain sales quality, and ensure effective execution of sales strategies and daily operations. Key Responsibilities Lead, supervise, motivate, and support telesales executives to achieve assigned sales targets. Develop and implement telesales strategies and support sales campaigns to achieve daily, monthly, and quarterly targets. Distribute leads, assign daily tasks, monitor call productivity, and ensure timely customer follow-up. Monitor individual and team performance, including call volume, conversions, sales, revenue, lead quality, and customer engagement. Coach team members to improve sales techniques, negotiation, objection handling, and customer communication. Review sales calls and ensure compliance with approved scripts, pricing, company policies, and professional standards. Maintain accurate CRM records, customer information, lead status, and sales activity updates. Monitor attendance, punctuality, discipline, and compliance with operational procedures. Identify underperforming employees, provide feedback, and implement improvement plans where necessary. Assist with recruitment, onboarding, training, and performance evaluation of telesales employees. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance reports for management and recommend corrective actions. Coordinate with Marketing, HR, Finance, and other relevant departments to ensure smooth operations. Forecast sales performance, identify operational challenges, and recommend resource allocation or process improvements. Escalate customer complaints, policy violations, and operational issues to the appropriate authority. Maintain a positive, productive, accountable, and customer-focused team environment. Skills & Expertise Customer Support through Phone Manage workload and meet deadline Motivation skills Problem solving and decision making Team Leader (Sales) Team management Training & Development Working under pressure Other Relevant Skills Telesales sales strategy Lead management Customer Relationship Compensation & Other Benefits Performance bonus Salary: BDT 14,000-30,000 per month, depending on experience and qualifications Other Benefits: As per company policy Performance Incentives: As per company policy, where applicable Monthly salary: BDT 14,000-30,000, depending on experience, qualifications, and role suitability. Other benefits as per company policy. Performance-based incentives, where applicable, as per company policy. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Shonir Akhra)

raw_source_fields.education: Minimum Bachelors Degree or equivalent. Educational qualifications in Marketing, Media, Journalism, or a relevant discipline will be preferred.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1544743&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Minimum Bachelors Degree or equivalent. Educational qualifications in Marketing, Media, Journalism, or a relevant discipline will be preferred. Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Automobile, Motor Workshop Additional Requirements 1–3 years of experience in content creation, videography, or digital marketing will be preferred. Freshers with strong creative skills and relevant knowledge are encouraged to apply. Experience in the automobile industry or car sales business will be an added advantage. Strong interest in automobiles and willingness to learn about vehicle features and specifications. One Must be proficient in writing accurate and informative scripts covering various aspects of Auto Mobiles. One must be adept at speaking in Standard Bangali in a highly Engaging and appealing manner. Experience creating content for Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok. Excellent Bangla communication and presentation skills. Creativity, punctuality, and the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team. Responsibilities & Context Job Context Sanzida Car Selection Ltd. is a reputed automobile sales company offering a wide range of reconditioned vehicles from various brands. To strengthen our digital marketing, branding, and vehicle sales activities, we are looking for a creative, talented, and enthusiastic Content Creator. The selected candidate will be responsible for producing engaging automotive videos and photographs, creating social media content, and attracting potential customers through various digital platforms. Job Responsibilities You need to show cars to customers visiting the showroom and sell cars to them. Create engaging video content highlighting vehicle features, packages, engine capacity, mileage, and specifications. Produce Reels, YouTube Shorts, and promotional videos for Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, and other social media platforms. Create car reviews, vehicle walkaround videos, feature highlights, and showroom promotional content. Prepare video scripts, captions, titles and descriptions for social media content. Develop SEO-friendly titles, descriptions, and content publishing plans for YouTube and Facebook. Create engaging content to attract potential car buyers and support sales activities. Monitor content performance and suggest creative ideas to improve audience engagement and reach. Coordinate with the Digital Marketing and Sales teams to support promotional campaigns. Create promotional content highlighting new vehicle arrivals, special offers, down payment facilities, car loan options, and sales campaigns. Maintain consistent brand identity while producing and publishing high-quality content regularly. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Video Content Creator Search Engine Optimization (SEO) promotional activities Digital Marketing (Social Media Marketing) Compensation & Other Benefits Mobile bill allowance. Other benefits as per company policy. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Tejgaon)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Responsibilities & Context We are looking for 2 highly motivated and professional Appointment Setters with exceptional English-speaking skills to join our team as soon as possible. The ideal candidates must be able to communicate confidently, naturally, and professionally with international clients over the phone. This is a time-sensitive hiring process, and shortlisted candidates should be available for interviews immediately and ready to join as soon as possible. Key Responsibilities: Make outbound calls to prospective clients and communicate with them in fluent, professional English. Contact potential customers, introduce our services, and generate interest through engaging conversations. Qualify leads by understanding customer needs and determining their suitability for our services. Schedule appointments and meetings for the sales team with qualified prospects. Follow up with potential clients through phone calls and other communication channels as required. Maintain accurate records of calls, customer interactions, follow-ups, and scheduled appointments. Handle questions and objections professionally while maintaining a positive customer experience. Coordinate closely with the sales team to ensure smooth appointment handovers. Consistently work toward daily and weekly calling, lead-generation, and appointment-setting targets. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1545046&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Computer Science & Engineering, Computing & Information System, Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Business-to-Business (B2B) Software and Services Startup, Computer Hardware/Network Companies, Industrial Machineries (Generator, Diesel Engine etc.) Additional Requirements Age 22 to 32 years Only Male The applicants should have experience in the following area(s):Electrical Engineering, Electrical Maintenance, Computer engineering The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Bridge Toll Plazas, excel load control (WIM) stations. Responsibilities & Context Immediate Joining We are looking for an efficient IT support site engineer who has sound knowledge on installing & configuring both Electronic & Networking devices. Job Responsibilities: Regular maintenance of the IT systems used in the electronic toll collection(ETC). This includes troubleshooting and resolving any technical issues that arise in the toll collection systems, surveillance cameras, network connectivity, and other related technologies. Ensuring stable and secure network operations. This includes overseeing the installation and management of network devices, performing network upgrades, and ensuring reliable internet connectivity. Installing, updating, and managing the software used for toll collection, including ensuring that it integrates seamlessly with other systems like vehicle detection and classification systems. Providing technical support to staff at the toll plaza. This involves training employees on new systems, assisting them with technical difficulties, and ensuring they can effectively use the technology. Developing and implementing emergency plans for IT systems in case of system failures, power outages, or other emergencies that could impact operations. Should have experience in Maintaining and Troubleshooting core data center network, LAN, WAN devices & Firewall devices. Should have experience in installing and configuring CCTV Cameras Should have experience in Maintenance & repair of all types of electrical channels, lighting systems other electrical works which are needed to smooth operation. Safeguarding the data collected at the excel load control(WIM), which includes financial transactions and vehicle information. Implementing and managing data backup and recovery plans, and ensuring compliance with data protection regulations. Continuously seeking ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the IT systems at the toll plaza. This may involve researching and implementing new technologies or processes. Skills & Expertise CCTV Installation Electrical Installation and Maintenance Installation and Maintenance IT system support and maintenance Operation & Maintenance Server Maintenance Software Business Analysis Software Installation Other Relevant Skills Information technology LAN/ WAN CCTV Installation Maintenance and Troubleshooting Compensation & Other Benefits Performance bonus,Tour allowance Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Yearly salary increment. Fully subsidized lunch or accommodation. Outstanding working environment. On the Job Training and Development. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Mechanical Engineering, Textile Engineering
raw_source_fields.age: 22 to 27 years BSc in ME/TMDM/Textile Engineering or any related field. PGD in SCM will add value. Knowledge of relevant laws and regulations. Strong negotiation and communication skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1545093&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Mechanical Engineering, Textile Engineering Experience At most 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Garments, Garments Accessories, Textile, Washing Factory Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 22 to 27 years BSc in ME/TMDM/Textile Engineering or any related field. PGD in SCM will add value. Knowledge of relevant laws and regulations. Strong negotiation and communication skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Experience in the Garments & Textile industry. Fluency in a foreign language. Responsibilities & Context We are seeking an Officer for our Procurement Department for our Corporate Head Office who will oversee the purchase & sourcing of Dyes & Chemicals, Yarn and Raw Materials, Trims & Accessories, Machinery & Spare Parts. Job Responsibilities Check factory requirements & Inventory. Identify and qualify potential foreign suppliers. Negotiate and manage contracts with foreign suppliers. Ensure that all goods and services meet the companys quality and delivery requirements. Oversee the import and export of goods. Analyse data from shipping and delivering processes to find bottlenecks and other issues. Manage supplier relationships. Keep up-to-date with the latest trends and developments in international procurement. Comply with all relevant laws and regulations. Skills & Expertise Raw Materials Sourcing Supply Chain and Procurement Other Relevant Skills Procurement Compensation & Other Benefits Mobile bill,Insurance,Gratuity,Provident fund Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Pick & Drop within Dhaka city. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Tejgaon)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1545210&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Fresh graduates Additional Requirements Age 20 to 30 years Only Male Fresh graduates with excellent English communication and strong analytical abilities are encouraged to apply. Important Requirements Strong English proficiency is mandatory, including speaking, listening, reading, and writing. Candidates must be able to communicate ideas and explain their reasoning clearly in English. Excellent logical reasoning, critical thinking, and analytical skills are essential. Candidates must be comfortable working with detailed instructions and completing research-intensive tasks. Basic computer proficiency and familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini are preferred. Prior experience in AI training, data annotation, research, content evaluation, or quality assurance will be considered an advantage. Responsibilities & Context We are looking for highly motivated, analytical, and detail-oriented individuals to join our team as AI Research & Quality Analysts . The selected candidates will work on AI-related research, response evaluation, quality assurance, and problem-solving activities. This role requires excellent English communication skills, strong logical reasoning, critical thinking, and the ability to understand and evaluate complex information. Candidates from different educational backgrounds are welcome. Previous AI experience is not mandatory, but strong analytical abilities and a willingness to learn are essential. Key Responsibilities Evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy, relevance, clarity, completeness, and logical consistency. Analyze complex questions and identify reasoning errors, factual inaccuracies, and inconsistencies. Compare multiple AI-generated responses and provide clear, evidence-based evaluations. Conduct online research, verify information, and assess the reliability of sources. Follow detailed English instructions, project guidelines, and quality standards. Develop and review prompts, questions, and evaluation criteria for AI systems. Provide clear written explanations and constructive feedback on AI-generated content. Apply logical reasoning, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills to challenging tasks. Identify potential issues, document findings, and recommend improvements. Maintain accuracy, consistency, and attention to detail while working on assigned projects. Participate in English-language meetings, assessments, training sessions, and project discussions. Learn and adapt to new AI platforms, tools, workflows, and project requirements. Skills & Expertise Artificial intelligence (AI) Attention to details Critical Reasoning Critical Thinking Fluent in English Oral and written communications ProblemSolving and Analytical Skills Quality Assurance/ Quality Control Research Other Relevant Skills Quality Assurance Online Research Critical Thinking Workplace Work at office Employment Status Contractual Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka (DOHS Baridhara)

Responsibilities & Context About Executive Study Abroad Executive Study Abroad has guided students towards international education since 2001. We are an official representative of leading universities in Australia, Canada, Malaysia, the UK and the USA, and support students through every step from choosing a destination to securing an offer. Position Overview This is a hands-on role for a sharp, capable professional who will work closely with senior management. You will help turn plans and strategies into executed projects, work with business data, and prepare high-quality business documents. We are looking for someone who can think, take initiative and finish what they start. We will train the right person, and the role will grow with your performance. Department: Administration Reports to: Senior Management Location: Banani, Dhaka Employment type: Full-time, with a six-month Process Familiarization Period (PFP), then permanent Working schedule: Sunday to Thursday, plus alternate Saturdays. Friday is the weekly holiday. Office hours are 10:00 am to 6:30 pm. Key Responsibilities Project execution Break down project plans and strategies into action lists, timelines and assigned tasks. Track progress, deadlines and approvals daily, and follow up until each task is closed. Coordinate with the HR, accounts, operations and counselling teams, and raise delays or risks early. Prepare progress updates for management. Business data and reporting Collect, clean, organise and analyse business data from the CRM, spreadsheets and team reports. Build trackers, summaries and reports that help management make decisions. Check data for accuracy and keep it up to date. Business documents Draft, review, proofread and format letters, reports, proposals, presentations and internal documents to a professional standard. Maintain organised, confidential and easily retrievable files, contracts and records. Administration Handle correspondence, follow-ups and administrative tasks assigned by management. Maintain strict confidentiality over business and personnel information. Growth areas Take on additional responsibilities, including marketing and communication support, as your skills develop. Requirements Education হিসাববিজ্ঞান, ফিন্যান্স বা সংশ্লিষ্ট বিষয়ে স্নাতক ডিগ্রি। Additional Requirements Experience Requirements: অ্যাকাউন্টস ও ফাইন্যান্স বিভাগে পূর্ব অভিজ্ঞতা থাকা বাধ্যতামূলক। ফার্নিচার ব্যবসা, শোরুম বা ট্রেডিং প্রতিষ্ঠানে হিসাব পরিচালনার অভিজ্ঞতাসম্পন্ন প্রার্থীদের অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। Additional Requirements: MS Excel এবং হিসাবরক্ষণ সফটওয়্যারে দক্ষতা। আর্থিক হিসাব ও প্রতিবেদন তৈরিতে দক্ষতা। সততা, দায়িত্বশীলতা ও নির্ভুলভাবে কাজ করার সক্ষমতা। Responsibilities & Context Job Responsibilities: প্রতিষ্ঠানের দৈনিক হিসাব-নিকাশ ও আর্থিক লেনদেন পরিচালনা করা। বিক্রয়, ক্রয়, ক্যাশ, ব্যাংক লেনদেন ও খরচের হিসাব সংরক্ষণ করা। দৈনিক, মাসিক ও বার্ষিক আর্থিক প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত করা। ইনভয়েস, বিল, ভাউচার এবং অন্যান্য আর্থিক নথিপত্র যাচাই ও সংরক্ষণ করা। পাওনা ও দেনা হিসাব পর্যবেক্ষণ এবং সময়মতো হিসাব সমন্বয় করা। প্রতিষ্ঠানের আর্থিক নীতিমালা ও হিসাবরক্ষণ পদ্ধতি অনুসরণ নিশ্চিত করা। প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী ম্যানেজমেন্টকে আর্থিক প্রতিবেদন ও হিসাবসংক্রান্ত তথ্য প্রদান করা। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounting Software Financial Reporting MS Excel Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

এই চাকরির জন্য বিজ্ঞাপনদাতা ব্যাক্তি/প্রতিষ্ঠান আপনার কাছ থেকে কোন অর্থ চাইলে কিংবা নিয়োগ প্রক্রিয়া চলাকালীন কোন প্রকার হয়রানিমূলক (শারীরিক/মানসিক) আচরণ করলে অতিসত্ত্বর আমাদেরকে জানান অথবা জবটি রিপোর্ট করুন। চাকরি পাওয়ার জন্য কোন ব্যাক্তি/প্রতিষ্ঠানকে অর্থ প্রদান করবেন না। চাকরিকালীন কোন প্রকার হয়রানির (শারীরিক/মানসিক) সম্ভাবনা থাকলে সেখানে জয়েন করবেন না। কোন প্রকার অর্থ লেনদেন বা নিয়োগদাতা কর্তৃক হয়রানির দায়িত্ব বিডিজবস বহন করবে না।

raw_source_fields.age: 25 to 40 years Only Male Responsibilities & Context Develop and implement effective marketing and sales strategies to achieve the company’s business objectives. Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients and other relevant stakeholders. Identify new business opportunities and generate potential leads for real estate projects. Conduct regular client meetings, property/project visits, presentations, and follow-ups. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, customer preferences, and market conditions. Develop strategies for promoting residential and commercial projects. Lead negotiations with clients and ensure successful conversion of leads into sales. Prepare regular sales and marketing reports and present performance updates to senior management. Coordinate with other departments to ensure smooth execution of marketing and sales activities. Skills & Expertise Customer Relationship Motorcycle Driving Sales & Marketing Other Relevant Skills Marketing Strategy Customer Relationship Lead Generation Market Research Campaign Management

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Advertising Agency, Agro based firms (incl. Agro Processing/Seed/GM), Tea Garden Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 24 to 35 years Only Male All official report must be prepared in English. Responsibilities & Context Arkay Multimedia Limited invites applications from energetic and pro-active individuals for the position of Supervisor - Outdoor Beautification and Development Coordinator Work. · Plan, develop and care for all our beautification and landscaping projects. · Ensuring that the day-to-day activities of the gardeners are being carried out as per schedule, routine and plan and work is carried out efficiently · Recruiting quality Gardeners and training them · Monitoring that each gardener is performing their daily routine job · Monitoring efficiency level of each Gardener. · Distributing daily work of gardeners so that optimum efficiency of work is achieved · Ensuring regular maintenance of our sites and replacing dead or missing plants with new plants. · Ensuring that Gardeners are wearing their uniform and raincoats when required and keeping track of their uniforms. · Setting up quality standards and ensuring we are up to the standard required. · Ensure regular watering is done. Creating and maintaining a weekly watering schedule. · Arranging watering trucks to ensure smooth watering of our project sites. · Ensuring regular hedge cutting is done and creating a routine and plan for hedge cutting. · Ensuring that height and dimensions of hedge are being followed as per company guidelines. · Ensuring grass cutting is done and creating a routine and plan for grass cutting. · Any equipment not functioning must be immediately repaired or replaced. · Must have inventory of all gardening equipment and must ensure that they are stored safely at the end of the day’s work. · In case of absence of staff, must recruit daily labor to ensure that the work is carried out smoothly. · Must have a passion for plants and greenery. · Must have leadership and commanding Skills. · Must know how to get the job done effectively and efficiently within the shortest time possible · Must be able to assess the present quality of our landscaping sites and methods to improve it. · Must ensure regular removal of unwanted plants, shrubs and weeds. · Must ensure regular booming and removal of dirt or debris or unwanted materials from our landscaping projects. · Must ensure that gardening tools including watering tanks, pipes, nozzles, rickshaw vans are repaired regularly and all items are useable. · Must keep track of daily gardeners attendance. · Must keep track of their in time to work and their out time. · Must have time management skills to ensure the gardeners are working effectively & efficiently. · Must be able to work at site for long hours under hard conditions such as rain or direct sun. · Must be able to work at night if and when required. · Must ensure that all gardening equipment’s are available to the gardeners. · Must visit sites daily to provide example to team members on how to work efficiently. · Work in field and come to head office for daily meetings. · Assist in preparation of work schedule and job assignment. · Budget and sourcing plants for replacement of damaged plants. · Regularly replace all damaged plants. · Ensuring that the condition of grounds and gardens meet the standards and quality of our designs. · Make sure that the health of landscape is at its best condition. Consult with horticulturist if there is bacterial attack on plants. Skills & Expertise Gardener Compensation & Other Benefits T/A Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Responsibilities & Context
Arkay Multimedia Limited invites applications from energetic and pro-active individuals for the position of Supervisor - Outdoor Beautification and Development Coordinator Work.
· Plan, develop and care for all our beautification and landscaping projects.
· Ensuring that the day-to-day activities of the gardeners are being carried out as per schedule, routine and plan and work is carried out efficiently
· Recruiting quality Gardeners and training them
· Monitoring that each gardener is performing their daily routine job
· Monitoring efficiency level of each Gardener.
· Distributing daily work of gardeners so that optimum efficiency of work is achieved
· Ensuring regular maintenance of our sites and replacing dead or missing plants with new plants.
· Ensuring that Gardeners are wearing their uniform and raincoats when required and keeping track of their uniforms.
· Setting up quality standards and ensuring we are up to the standard required.
· Ensure regular watering is done. Creating and maintaining a weekly watering schedule.
· Arranging watering trucks to ensure smooth watering of our project sites.
· Ensuring regular hedge cutting is done and creating a routine and plan for hedge cutting.
· Ensuring that height and dimensions of hedge are being followed as per company guidelines.
· Ensuring grass cutting is done and creating a routine and plan for grass cutting.
· Any equipment not functioning must be immediately repaired or replaced.
· Must have inventory of all gardening equipment and must ensure that they are stored safely at the end of the day’s work.
· In case of absence of staff, must recruit daily labor to ensure that the work is carried out smoothly.
· Must have a passion for plants and greenery.
· Must have leadership and commanding Skills.
· Must know how to get the job done effectively and efficiently within the shortest time possible
· Must be able to assess the present quality of our landscaping sites and methods to improve it.
· Must ensure regular removal of unwanted plants, shrubs and weeds.
· Must ensure regular booming and removal of dirt or debris or unwanted materials from our landscaping projects.
· Must ensure that gardening tools including watering tanks, pipes, nozzles, rickshaw vans are repaired regularly and all items are useable.
· Must keep track of daily gardeners attendance.
· Must keep track of their in time to work and their out time.
· Must have time management skills to ensure the gardeners are working effectively & efficiently.
· Must be able to work at site for long hours under hard conditions such as rain or direct sun.
· Must be able to work at night if and when required.
· Must ensure that all gardening equipment’s are available to the gardeners.
· Must visit sites daily to provide example to team members on how to work efficiently.
· Work in field and come to head office for daily meetings.
· Assist in preparation of work schedule and job assignment.
· Budget and sourcing plants for replacement of damaged plants.
· Regularly replace all damaged plants.
· Ensuring that the condition of grounds and gardens meet the standards and quality of our designs.
· Make sure that the health of landscape is at its best condition. Consult with horticulturist if there is bacterial attack on plants.

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Accounting Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Accounting, Finance যেকোনো স্বীকৃত বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় থেকে হিসাববিজ্ঞানে বিসিএ (BBA in Accounting) বা এমবিএ (MBA in Accounting/Finance)। CIMA / CA Knowledge Level সম্পন্ন প্রার্থীদের অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে।
raw_source_fields.age: 25 to 35 years Additional Requirements টিমে কাজ করার মানসিকতা এবং যোগাযোগ দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে। Computer Skills: MS Excel (Advanced), MS Word এবং Accounting Software (Tally / QuickBooks / Custom ERP)-এ পারদর্শী হতে হবে। চাপ সামলে কাজ করার ক্ষমতা থাকতে হবে। অভিজ্ঞতা: ১ থেকে ৩ বছরের কাজের অভিজ্ঞতা (রিয়েল এস্টেট ডেভেলপমেন্ট কোম্পানিতে কাজের পূর্ব অভিজ্ঞতা থাকলে বিশেষ অগ্রাধিকার পাবেন)। Responsibilities & Context একটি উদীয়মান এবং সুনামধন্য রিয়েল এস্টেট ডেভেলপমেন্ট কোম্পানি কর্মস্থল: বগুড়া রোড, বরিশাল দায়িত্বসমূহ (Job Responsibilities): রিয়েল এস্টেট প্রজেক্টের দৈনিক আয়-ব্যয় এবং ক্যাশ ফ্লো (Cash Flow) সঠিকভাবে হিসাব ও লিপিবদ্ধ করা। কাস্টমারদের বুকিং মানি, ডাউন পেমেন্ট এবং কিস্তির (Installment) হিসাব সংরক্ষণ ও রসিদ প্রদান করা। প্রজেক্টভিত্তিক নির্মাণ সামগ্রী ক্রয়, ঠিকাদার (Contractor) এবং সাপ্লাইয়ারদের বিল যাচাই ও পরিশোধ করা। কোম্পানির ব্যাংক স্টেটমেন্ট রিকনসিলিয়েশন (Bank Reconciliation) করা। মাসিক আর্থিক বিবরণী (Monthly Financial Statements) এবং প্রফিট & লস রিপোর্ট প্রস্তুত করে উচ্চপদস্থ কর্মকর্তাদের নিকট পেশ করা। আয়কর (TAX/AIT) এবং ভ্যাট (VAT) সংক্রান্ত প্রাথমিক হিসাব বজায় রাখা। হিসাবরক্ষণ সফটওয়্যার (Accounting Software / Tally / ERP) নিয়মিত আপডেট রাখা।

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1545368&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Media, Business or a related field. Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Advertising Agency, Cultural Centre, Event Management, Film Production, Newspaper/Magazine, Online Newspaper/ News Portal, Telecommunication, Web Media/Blog Additional Requirements Age 22 to 28 years Requirements - 1 to 3 years of experience in social media management, content creation or digital marketing, preferably in music, entertainment or media. Hands-on experience with Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok, and a good understanding of current trends and platform algorithms. Basic skills in video editing and design tools such as CapCut, Canva, Premiere Pro or Photoshop. Ability to read and report on platform analytics. Strong written communication in Bangla and English. Deep passion for Bangladeshi music, drama and pop culture. Ability to work to deadlines and handle multiple posts and campaigns at once. Responsibilities & Context Reports to: Strategic Planner Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh Type: Full-time Working days: Saturday to Thursday Office hours: 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM Gaanchill is a leading music label, production house and mobile content provider in Bangladesh. Across our wings Gaanchill Music, Gaanchill Drama & Cinema and Gaanchill Folk, we produce original songs, drama soundtracks, films and mobile entertainment for audiences at home and abroad. We are looking for a Social Media Executive to run our daily presence across all Gaanchill channels and keep our audience engaged between releases. Responsibilities - Content calendar : Plan and publish daily posts across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok, aligned with the release calendar and festive peaks like Eid, Boishakh and Puja. Release campaigns : Execute social rollouts for songs, music videos, drama OSTs and folk projects, including teasers, countdowns, lyric snippets and behind the scenes content. Short-form content : Create and post Reels, Shorts and TikToks using strong hooks from our tracks, and support trends, challenges and creator collaborations. Copywriting : Write clear, catchy captions, titles and descriptions in Bangla and English that suit each platform and artist. Community management : Respond to comments and messages, monitor feedback and flag important issues to the team. Channel upkeep : Maintain YouTube channel health, including thumbnails, playlists, end screens, community posts and metadata. Reporting : Track reach, views, engagement and follower growth using Meta Business Suite, YouTube Studio and TikTok analytics, and share a weekly and monthly summary with insights. Old catalog content : Create posts that bring back older hit tracks, such as throwback posts, acoustic and lo-fi versions and best-of playlists. Brand and sponsor deliverables : Publish sponsored and partner content on time, following brand guidelines and approvals. Team coordination : Work with musicians, video directors, designers and the marketing team to collect assets and meet release targets. Skills & Expertise Content Creation Content writing Digital Marketing (Social Media Marketing) Facebook marketing Instagram Marketing Linkedin marketing Meta Marketing SEO and Digital Marketing YouTube Marketing YouTube SEO Other Relevant Skills Social Media Management Content Creation Copywriting Community management Compensation & Other Benefits Salary : Negotiable, plus two festival bonuses and an annual review. Type: Full-time
Working days: Saturday to Thursday
Office hours: 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM
Gaanchill is a leading music label, production house and mobile content provider in Bangladesh. Across our wings Gaanchill Music, Gaanchill Drama & Cinema and Gaanchill Folk, we produce original songs, drama soundtracks, films and mobile entertainment for audiences at home and abroad.
We are looking for a Social Media Executive to run our daily presence across all Gaanchill channels and keep our audience engaged between releases.
Responsibilities -
Content calendar : Plan and publish daily posts across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok, aligned with the release calendar and festive peaks like Eid, Boishakh and Puja.
Release campaigns : Execute social rollouts for songs, music videos, drama OSTs and folk projects, including teasers, countdowns, lyric snippets and behind the scenes content.
Short-form content : Create and post Reels, Shorts and TikToks using strong hooks from our tracks, and support trends, challenges and creator collaborations.
Copywriting : Write clear, catchy captions, titles and descriptions in Bangla and English that suit each platform and artist.
Community management : Respond to comments and messages, monitor feedback and flag important issues to the team.
Channel upkeep : Maintain YouTube channel health, including thumbnails, playlists, end screens, community posts and metadata.
Reporting : Track reach, views, engagement and follower growth using Meta Business Suite, YouTube Studio and TikTok analytics, and share a weekly and monthly summary with insights.
Old catalog content : Create posts that bring back older hit tracks, such as throwback posts, acoustic and lo-fi versions and best-of playlists.
Brand and sponsor deliverables : Publish sponsored and partner content on time, following brand guidelines and approvals.
Team coordination : Work with musicians, video directors, designers and the marketing team to collect assets and meet release targets.
Other Relevant Skills
Compensation & Other Benefits
Salary : Negotiable, plus two festival bonuses and an annual review.

Search Engine Optimisation (SEO): To lead our digital marketing strategy and improve our online visibility, organic traffic, and lead generation. Proven experience planning, managing, and optimising paid advertising campaigns across multiple digital platforms. Strong hands-on knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads . Demonstrated ability to generate qualified leads and improve campaign performance through data-driven optimisation. Strong understanding of key performance indicators, including CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, conversion rate, and ROAS. Experience using Google Analytics 4 and advertising platform analytics to monitor performance and generate actionable insights. Good understanding of audience targeting, retargeting, lead funnels, landing page performance, and conversion optimisation. Ability to manage advertising budgets effectively and allocate resources based on campaign performance. Experience conducting A/B tests and using performance data to make informed marketing decisions. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Excellent communication, organisation, and project management abilities. Ability to work independently, manage multiple campaigns, meet deadlines, and take ownership of measurable results. A proactive, commercially minded approach with a strong focus on continuous improvement and business growth. Preferred Experience Experience working with UK-based or international businesses and audiences. Experience with CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, lead tracking, and campaign attribution. Knowledge of email marketing, remarketing, audience segmentation, and customer lifecycle campaigns. Experience improving landing pages and marketing funnels to increase lead conversion. Familiarity with creative tools such as Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator for reviewing or supporting advertising creatives. Experience using AI-powered marketing tools to improve campaign planning, analysis, and execution. A portfolio or case studies demonstrating measurable improvements in lead generation, campaign efficiency, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, or revenue growth. Key Performance Expectations The successful candidate will be expected to contribute to measurable business growth through: Increased volume and quality of qualified leads. Improved paid advertising performance and return on ad spend. More efficient use of marketing budgets. Reduced cost per lead and customer acquisition cost. Improved landing page and lead funnel conversion rates. Stronger campaign performance through testing and optimisation. Improved audience engagement and campaign effectiveness. Clear, data-driven reporting and actionable growth recommendations. Consistent progress towards agreed marketing and business objectives. Position Overview PFEC Global is looking for an energetic and motivated Call Center Intern to engage with prospective students through outbound calls, understand their study abroad interests, and encourage them to visit our offices for counselling. The role focuses on converting phone conversations into student walk-ins. High-performing interns may be offered an internship extension or a full-time employment opportunity. Screen prospective students to understand their study interests, eligibility, and requirements. Encourage interested students to visit our offices for face-to-face counselling. Follow up with potential students to maximize office visits. Maintain accurate calling records and follow-up reports using Excel/Google Sheets. Achieve assigned calling and student walk-in conversion targets. Mobility & Flexibility: Comfortable with frequent local travel, field visits, outdoor activations, and flexible work schedules around events and seminars. Personality: High energy, strongly extroverted, approachable, and proactive with natural relationship-building skills. Meeting & Negotiation Skills: Confident in conducting high-level B2B and institutional meetings with school principals, headmasters, and administrative authorities. Experience in Student Counseling or the Education Management/Overseas Study Industry is highly encouraged. Responsibilities & Context Position Overview PFEC Global , a multinational education consultancy with 20 years of experience and operations across Australia, India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, and Indonesia, is seeking an energetic, outgoing, and results-driven Business Development Executive for its Chattogram team. The role focuses on building and maintaining strategic partnerships with schools, colleges, universities, and English-medium coaching centres to strengthen PFEC Global’s brand presence and generate student leads for overseas education. The selected candidate will also contribute to business development initiatives for Enhance English , a sister concern of PFEC Global. Key Responsibilities Institutional Networking & Relationship Management Conduct frequent field visits and direct outreach to schools, colleges, universities, O/A Level coaching centers, and English medium institutions across Chattogram. Build strong rapport and long-term partnerships with school administrators, counselors, faculty members, and student clubs. Position PFEC Global as the first choice for students seeking abroad education consulting and guidance. Events, Activations & Representation Represent PFEC Global at education expos, university seminars, school/college career fairs, and outdoor promotional activations. Coordinate, organize, and execute campus-level seminars, workshops, and student engagement activities. Lead corporate and institutional business meetings with confidence and professionalism. Business Development Support for Enhance English Cross-promote Enhance English services (IELTS, English language training, and skill development programs) during institutional visits and events. Identify potential collaboration opportunities for Enhance English with coaching centers and academic institutions. Lead Generation & Pipeline Growth Identify, engage, and capture prospective student leads interested in studying abroad. Collaborate closely with the internal student counseling team to ensure smooth handover and conversion of generated leads. Skills & Expertise Communication and interpersonal skill Business Development Relationship Management Knowledge of Educational Programs Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Chattogram
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Achieve assigned monthly and quarterly sales targets and provide regular sales reports and progress updates. TA/DA and mobile bill allowances as per company policy. Commission or sales incentives based on sales performance and achievements, in accordance with company policy. MacroHealthPlus Software Pty Ltd. is an Australian-based software company operating in Bangladesh. The company provides modern technology-driven software and digital healthcare management solutions for the healthcare sector.
To expand business operations, acquire new clients, increase software sales, and ensure successful software implementation at client organizations, we are looking for an experienced, energetic, self-motivated, and target-oriented Executive/Manager, Business Development.

Manage the marketing and sales of healthcare-related software solutions, including Hospital Management Systems (HMS), Clinic Management Systems, Laboratory Information Systems (LIS), Radiology Information Systems (RIS), Pharmacy Management Systems, and other related solutions.
Conduct software demonstrations, presentations, and proposal submissions to prospective clients, and follow up regularly to drive sales forward.
Coordinate with the Implementation, Technical, Software Development, and Customer Support teams to facilitate the successful implementation of software at client organizations.
Assist with onboarding new clients, software configuration, user training, and post-implementation follow-up activities.
Achieve assigned monthly and quarterly sales targets and provide regular sales reports and progress updates.

iSocial is an evidence-driven, for-profit social enterprise conducting impact business. iSocial specializes in data-driven insights, strategic policy advocacy, skills and entrepreneurship development and innovative solutions design.
DataSense is one of the three core strategic business units (SBUs) at iSocial for research and data intelligence. It offers services to corporates, non-profits, and development agencies in Bangladesh and abroad, as well as to the Government of Bangladesh. DataSense conducts systemic research, policy analysis, data collection, data curation, data analytics for operations management, and evidence-based insights to simplify executive and policy decision-making. This has enabled DataSense to grow into a multidisciplinary team of professionals, educated and trained in Bangladesh and abroad. The research team works out of Bangladesh, Australia, Canada, UK, and USA. DataSense client list includes Helvetas, ICT Division, ILO, UNCDF, UNESCAP, UNDP, UNWOMEN, BMZ and other national and international organizations. iSocial partnered with wide-range of national and international organizations including BILS, British Council, Cornell University USA, CSF Sri Lanka, Data and Society USA, Oxfam Bangladesh, Oxford Internet Institute, The Business Standard, University of Edinburgh and so on.

We are seeking an experienced, high-caliber, and forward-thinking research professional to join DataSense as Senior Research Associate (Digital Economy & Governance). This mid-level leadership role requires strong project ownership, advanced expertise in econometric modeling and quantitative/qualitative methodologies, and substantial experience leading research components on digital transformation, platform economy, digital public infrastructure (DPI), data governance, e-services, and technology policy.
