Full-time (Sunday through Thursday)
Hybrid modality (4 days in-office, 1 day remote weekly). This may be adjusted based on project requirements.
Field visit outside Dhaka may be required
SCOPE OF WORK
Lead the end-to-end design, conceptualization, and implementation of complex research projects covering digital transformation, e-governance, digital trade, platform economy, DPI, and AI policy frameworks.
Serve as lead or co-author for high-impact research publications, working papers, policy briefs, regulatory assessments, and peer-reviewed articles targeting executive, government, and donor audiences.
Spearhead business development initiatives by taking a lead role in designing research methodologies, technical frameworks, and financial proposals to win competitive grants and donor tenders.
Architect primary research frameworks, oversee CAPI survey instrument designs, build sampling strategies, and supervise quantitative data cleaning and econometric modeling pipelines.
Actively build and nurture high-level relationships with key stakeholders, including the ICT Division, government ministries, regulatory authorities, donor organizations (UN, donor agencies), and academic partners.
Provide direct technical supervision, quality control, and professional guidance to Research Associates, Junior Researchers, and field teams across research assignments.
Represent DataSense and iSocial as a speaker and domain specialist in national and international roundtables, policy dialogues, and academic conferences.
Contribute to cross-SBU strategic initiatives (with Junction Bangladesh and iSkill) to integrate data intelligence into broader social enterprise programs.

Requirements Education Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Applied Statistics and Data Science, Economics, Mass Communication & Journalism Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (FMCG), Group of Companies, Automobile Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Responsibilities & Context Market Research & Content Development (70%) Conduct market and competitor research to identify customer needs, emerging trends in the Bangladesh economy and potential business opportunities. Use modern AI tools to support research, content creation and digital learning product development. Develop, review and refine learning content to ensure accuracy, quality, clarity and a natural, engaging tone. Support the preparation of course materials, scripts, presentations and other digital learning assets. Maintain research databases, content documentation and project progress reports. Business Development & User Acquisition (30%) Support product launches, marketing initiatives and user acquisition activities. Assist in lead generation, sales outreach, customer engagement and prospect follow-up. Identify potential customers, distribution channels and business development opportunities. Support initiatives to convert prospects into registered and paying learners. Track relevant campaign and business development activities to support growth targets. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1546796&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Human Resource Management Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Group of Companies, Retail Store Additional Requirements Age At least 28 years Experience in Retail Fashion Industry will be an advantage. Excellent communication & Interpersonal Skill. People oriented and results driven. Self-driven to work under pressure and self-motivated to take new initiatives. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Responsibilities & Context Outlet: Conduct need analysis to identify skill gaps and future learning needs for Outlet staff. Designing, developing, and delivering training programs as per business needs. Stay abreast of the latest trends in learning and development and incorporate best practices into programs. Delivering new Joiner Induction Training. Package Employee Training Module prepare, co-ordinate, prepare training plan and delivering as per management decision. Training budget prepare and settle after training. Monthly Training Report prepare and share with management. Management: Conduct needs analysis to identify skill gaps and future learning needs for management staff. Assist to Develop engaging and effective learning programs, both in-person and online. Implement a variety of learning methods (e.g., coaching, mentoring, e-learning, workshops) to address diverse learning needs. Coordinate with external training providers and manage training logistics. Align training programs with career development and succession planning. Maintain all training documentation & share the report with stakeholder for further plan & Improvement. Performance Management System: Periodical information collection from outlet, analysis, review with stakeholder, take approval from management and declare the winner of Reward & Recognition program. Develop Employee Profile time to time for review & assist for PMS documentation. Introduce Career development program of outlet staffs. SOP and policy development for smooth operation process. (If needed) People Engagement: Support the implementation of employee engagement activities and programs. Assist in organizing team-building activities, company events, and employee recognition programs. Collect and analyze employee feedback to improve engagement initiatives. Conduct periodical HR related survey, compile, share with team and stakeholder and take corrective action plan. Work on welfare & wellness activities to entire Sailor. Recruitment & Selection : Participate in the recruitment process, including job posting, screening, and onboarding process for new employees both Outlet and Management. Onboard Recruitment Source or recruitment platform for best people selection both outlet & Management. New initiative for developing outlet people recruitment process. Assist in developing job descriptions and specifications. Support the maintenance of a talent pipeline for future hiring needs. Assist in competency framework & KPI based JD preparation. Documentation & Reporting: Maintain accurate and up-to-date HR records and documentation. Assist & prepare regular HR reports like headcount, recruitment status, training completion, and performance metrics etc. Ensure compliance with all HR policies and legal regulations. Skills & Expertise Employee Engagement Human Resource Management Learning and Development Performance Management System Recruitment & Selection Other Relevant Skills Recruitment & Selection Training & Development Training Needs Assessment Compensation & Other Benefits Mobile bill,Medical allowance,Insurance,Gratuity Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Tejgaon)

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1546813&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Master of Development Studies (MDS) Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Preferred Experience, Knowledge and/or other Qualifications: Two years’ prior professional experience in international development or a related field. Two years’ prior experience in business development, including bid capture, live bid management, and proposal development and/or project implementation for USAID, DFID, DFAT, EU and/or other major donors, preferably within a World Vision context. Experience in implementing development programmes in one or more of WVB’s core sectors (health, livelihoods and education). Excellent interpersonal skills and high emotional intelligence (EQ). Skills in monitoring and the development of logframes. A sense of humour and the ability to thrive in fast-paced, stressful situations. Competence in using MS Word, MS Excel and PowerPoint. Understanding of USAID, DFID, DFAT and EU policies, priorities and proposal processes. Broad understanding of principled humanitarian action, emergency relief and resilience objectives, and sectors such as shelter and settlements, WASH, food security and livelihoods, humanitarian protection, and health and nutrition. Proven capacity-building, facilitation and training skills. Strong decision-making and conflict-resolution skills. Experience working in a cross-cultural environment, preferably within a South Asian context. Responsibilities & Context Job Purpose The purpose of this position is to work collaboratively with all departments to advance the acquisition of grant revenue by: developing and managing opportunity capture plans; developing bid action plans and managing live bids; coordinating go/no-go assessments; coordinating after-action reviews following submission to improve the bidding process and ability to compete generally; leading teaming strategies and processes (for both prime and sub opportunities) in close collaboration with Programme Development and Quality Assurance (PDQA), Support offices (SOs), South Asia Pacific office (SAPO) and other World Vision (WV) partners; ensuring the production of best-in-class capability statements, and updating the same on a quarterly basis; assisting in the identification of grant funding opportunities; writing key sections of proposals as necessary, including management, executive summary and other non-technical sections; developing and managing compliance matrices for all submissions; leading preparation for bi-weekly Resource Development Unit meetings with the National Director (ND) and Department Leads; and undertaking other responsibilities as required. Key Deliverables: Prepare and manage capture activities for all opportunities. Support resource acquisition and the implementation of Capture Plans, development of Bid Implementation Plans, and execution of live bids. Lead all live bids, ensuring seamless collaboration with SOs and NO partners (PDQA, Finance, People & Culture, etc.). Lead partnering for all opportunities, in close collaboration with PDQA, Finance and SOs. Knowledge management, including but not limited to: preparation and updating of capability statements; critical review of pipeline data accuracy. Key Responsibilities: Capture Oversee direct reports in the development and implementation of capture plans, bid action plans, and the execution of live bids. Prepare capture plans for all opportunities in excess of USD 5,000,000. Ensure capture plans are reviewed and endorsed by all internal partners and SOs. Manage capture plans and update them on a weekly basis for presentation at the weekly BD meeting. Resolve any complications or delays experienced during the capture process. Report on the progress of capture plans at all bi-weekly BD meetings with the ND, SDO, and other Department Leads. Bid Management Lead Go/No-Go process, launched within 24 hours of solicitation drop date, working alongside where appropriate with Business Development Managers. Develop Bid Action Plans (BAPs) for all live opportunities. Manage BAPs to ensure seamless collaboration among SOs, the NO, partners, and external bid partners (subs and primes). Required Skills and Competencies Practical knowledge of accounting software such as Tally, QuickBooks, Xero, or equivalent applications. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and other Microsoft Office applications. Accurate Bangla and English typing skills. Ability to prepare financial reports and maintain computerized accounting records. Sound understanding of bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, cash management, and financial documentation. Ability to work independently, maintain accuracy, and meet deadlines. Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. Honesty, trustworthiness, punctuality, attention to detail, and a high sense of responsibility. Ability to maintain strict confidentiality of company accounts and financial information. Additional Advantages Experience with travel-agency accounting, airline transactions, ticket refunds, commissions, and service charges. Familiarity with visa processing, hotel reservations, tour packages, and Hajj and Umrah services. Basic graphic-design skills using Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, or similar tools. Ability to create simple social-media posts, promotional banners, advertisements, and marketing materials. Willingness to support routine administrative, documentation, and marketing activities when required. Responsibilities & Context About SSarah Travels BD SSarah Travels BD is a travel and tourism company providing air ticketing, visa processing, hotel reservations, tour packages, Hajj and Umrah services, and education consultancy. We are seeking a sincere, organized, and accountable Accountant to maintain accurate financial records, manage day-to-day accounting activities, and support the company’s administrative and operational requirements. Key Responsibilities Maintain daily accounts, cash books, bank transactions, and financial records accurately. Prepare and maintain vouchers, invoices, bills, receipts, payment statements, and other accounting documents. Record and monitor air-ticket sales and purchases, refunds, commissions, service charges, and other travel-agency transactions. Maintain accounts payable and receivable, client ledgers, supplier accounts, and payment records. Perform bank and cash reconciliations and verify financial transactions regularly. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly financial statements and management reports. Monitor office expenses, petty cash, salaries, and other operating costs. Maintain records of customer and supplier payments, advances, and outstanding balances. Assist in preparing VAT, tax, and other statutory financial documents, as required. Use accounting software and maintain organized computerized financial records. Prepare official letters, reports, spreadsheets, and business documents in both Bangla and English. Support routine administrative tasks and maintain orderly financial documentation. Provide basic graphic-design and promotional-material support to the marketing team when required. Perform other relevant accounting and administrative duties assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounting Financial Reporting Financial Analysis Invoicing Compensation & Other Benefits Salary will be negotiated based on qualifications, experience, and practical skills. Requirements Education B.Com / M.Com in Accounting / BBA in Accounting & Finance. Diploma in Accounting with Tally expertise will also be considered. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Plastic/ Polymer Industry Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Responsibilities & Context Industry: Plastic Recycling & Manufacturing (Plastic Dana) Job Location: Factory - Amtola, Kathgora, Ashulia, Dhaka About Us: A1 Plastics OPC is a growing plastic recycling and manufacturing company. We are looking for an honest, skilled and experienced Accounts Officer for our factory accounts management. Our Certifications GRS (Global Recycled Standard 4.0) Certified – ensures traceable recycled content in rPE granules through Intertek. Maintain bank transactions and bank reconciliation. Preserve all documents and files properly for audit. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounting Financial Reporting Financial Analysis Tally Software Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Review: Yearly Salary: Negotiable / BDT 20,000 - 28,000 (Based on Experience & Skills) As per company policy. A1 Plastics OPC is a growing plastic recycling and manufacturing company. We are committed to international standards, environmental stewardship, and safe, traceable recycling practices. We are looking for an honest, skilled and experienced Accounts Officer for our factory accounts management.

GRS (Global Recycled Standard 4.0) Certified – ensures traceable recycled content in rPE granules through Intertek.

Maintain daily factory expenses and daily production report (Input vs Output).

Check and verify all bills of Washing, Dana Machine and Sorting section.
Maintain bank transactions and bank reconciliation.
Preserve all documents and files properly for audit.

As per company policy.
Festival Bonus, etc.

Requirements Additional Requirements Only Male Responsibilities & Context A reputed group of companies is looking for a competent, proactive, and experienced Senior Executive/ Assistant Manager – HR & Admin to manage day-to-day HR and administrative operations. The ideal candidate should have substantial hands-on experience in core HR functions, employee management, office administration, and labour law compliance. The candidate must be capable of working independently, ensuring smooth operations, and effectively implementing company policies and procedures. Key Responsibilities Manage recruitment, selection, onboarding, separation, confirmation, transfer, promotion, resignation, and HR documentation. Maintain employee records, personal files, HR databases, attendance, and leave records. Coordinate payroll inputs, performance appraisals, training, and employee development. Implement HR policies, service rules, and disciplinary procedures; resolve employee grievances and ensure labour law compliance. Oversee office administration, maintenance, housekeeping, security, and facility management. Manage office supplies, assets, vehicles, logistics, and administrative expenses. Supervise support staff and coordinate with vendors, service providers, and relevant authorities. Arrange meetings, official events, and travel; maintain administrative records and ensure workplace safety, discipline, and cleanliness. Prepare HR & Admin reports and perform other duties assigned by management. Candidate Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field is required; a master’s degree will be considered an additional advantage. Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in HR & general Administration. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Candidates holding professional certifications in HRM, Bangladesh Labour Law, Payroll Management, or relevant HR & Administration fields will be given preference. Strong organizational, coordination, and multitasking abilities. Ability to identify solutions, work independently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple responsibilities effectively. Important Note: Candidates must have substantial, hands-on experience across core HR and Administrative functions. Applicants with only academic qualifications or limited exposure without practical, in-depth HR & Admin experience are strongly discouraged from applying. Skills & Expertise Factory HR Administration Factory Administration Factory Operation Human Resources Administration Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Narayanganj

Requirements Education Applicants must have a relevant degree in one of the following disciplines: BBA/MBA in Finance, Accounting or a relevant discipline. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO, Trading or Export/Import Additional Requirements Age 25 to 32 years 2–3 years of progressive professional experience in financial modeling, credit portfolio analytics, risk analytics or fintech corporate finance. Experience in one or more of the following sectors will be preferred: o	Fintech and digital financial services o	Digital lending and consumer finance o	Banking and non-bank financial institutions o	Credit rating agencies o	Other technology-driven or credit-based businesses Candidates with hands-on experience in loan-level data analysis, portfolio performance monitoring, financial forecasting, and management reporting will receive preference. Required Skills & Competencies Credit Portfolio Analytics: Default curves, vintage/cohort analysis, roll rates, delinquency monitoring, and loss forecasting. Financial Planning & Analysis: Budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, unit economics, and cash flow modeling. Financial Modeling: Revenue projections, profitability analysis, scenario planning, and sensitivity analysis. Data Analytics: Advanced Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and financial dashboard development. Risk & Underwriting: Credit policy evaluation, portfolio risk assessment, and repayment performance analysis. Management Reporting: Preparation of executive-level financial reports and strategic recommendations. Communication & Leadership: Strong analytical thinking, stakeholder management, presentation, and team leadership skills. Responsibilities & Context Job Location: House 67, Block – KA, Pici-culture Housing Society, Shyamoli, Dhaka - 1207 About Ambala Fintech Limited Ambala Fintech Limited is a technology-driven financial services company focused on delivering innovative, accessible, and sustainable financial solutions through digital platforms. By combining technology, financial expertise, and operational excellence, the company aims to expand financial inclusion, strengthen digital financial services, and create long-term value for customers and business partners across Bangladesh. Role Overview Ambala Fintech Limited is looking for a highly analytical and strategically minded Credit Analyst to lead financial planning, portfolio performance analysis, financial modeling, and strategic decision support. This is a strategic finance role that goes beyond traditional accounting and bookkeeping. The successful candidate will translate financial and operational data into actionable insights to support business growth, credit risk management, pricing decisions, capital allocation, and profitability. The role will work closely with management, business operations, and credit/risk teams to strengthen financial performance, improve portfolio quality, and support sustainable business expansion. Key Responsibilities Credit Portfolio & Financial Analytics Develop and maintain default curves and credit loss forecasts. Monitor delinquency, default rates, recoveries, write-offs, and portfolio profitability. Analyze loan-level and customer-level data to identify portfolio risks, performance trends, and opportunities for improvement. Recommend data-driven strategies to improve portfolio quality, collection efficiency, and risk-adjusted returns. Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Lead annual budgeting, roll forecasts, financial planning, and variance analysis. Develop and maintain integrated financial models covering revenue, operating costs, unit economics, cash flow, and profitability. Prepare financial projections and scenario analyses to support business planning and management decisions. Evaluate the financial feasibility of new products, business channels, strategic partnerships, and market expansion initiatives. Credit Risk & Underwriting Support Collaborate with credit and operations teams to assess and improve underwriting policies, credit limits, and customer eligibility criteria. Conduct sensitivity and scenario analyses to evaluate the financial impact of credit policy changes. Monitor portfolio performance against approved risk policies and recommend corrective actions. Assess the relationship between customer acquisition, repayment behavior, default risk, and overall profitability. Capital Planning & Management Reporting Forecast capital requirements based on business growth, financing needs, and portfolio origination plans. Prepare financial and portfolio performance reports for senior management, the Board of Directors, lenders, and investors. Support fundraising initiatives, financing arrangements, financial due diligence, and covenant monitoring where applicable. Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks to improve financial transparency and decision-making. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Financial Reporting Capital Management Risk Management Underwriting (Insurance) Cash Management Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Range: 30000 - 35000 BDT per Month Festival Bonus: 02 Weekly Holidays: Friday An opportunity to contribute to the strategic growth of a technology-driven financial services business. Direct involvement in financial strategy, portfolio performance, and business decision-making. A collaborative and performance-oriented working environment. Competitive compensation and benefits based on qualifications and experience. Professional development and career growth opportunities. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Shyamoli)

About Ambala Fintech Limited
Ambala Fintech Limited is a technology-driven financial services company focused on delivering innovative, accessible, and sustainable financial solutions through digital platforms. By combining technology, financial expertise, and operational excellence, the company aims to expand financial inclusion, strengthen digital financial services, and create long-term value for customers and business partners across Bangladesh.
Role Overview
Ambala Fintech Limited is looking for a highly analytical and strategically minded Credit Analyst to lead financial planning, portfolio performance analysis, financial modeling, and strategic decision support.
This is a strategic finance role that goes beyond traditional accounting and bookkeeping. The successful candidate will translate financial and operational data into actionable insights to support business growth, credit risk management, pricing decisions, capital allocation, and profitability.
The role will work closely with management, business operations, and credit/risk teams to strengthen financial performance, improve portfolio quality, and support sustainable business expansion.
Key Responsibilities
Credit Portfolio & Financial Analytics
Develop and maintain default curves and credit loss forecasts.
Monitor delinquency, default rates, recoveries, write-offs, and portfolio profitability.

Prepare financial and portfolio performance reports for senior management, the Board of Directors, lenders, and investors.
Support fundraising initiatives, financing arrangements, financial due diligence, and covenant monitoring where applicable.
Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks to improve financial transparency and decision-making.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1546932&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Relevant professional certifications in performance marketing, digital advertising, marketing analytics, AI content production, or marketing automation will be an advantage. Formal academic qualifications are secondary to demonstrable hands-on expertise, a strong portfolio, and verifiable business results. Candidates with exceptional practical skills and proven experience may be considered regardless of their academic background. Experience At most 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (Light Engineering and Heavy Industry) Additional Requirements Minimum 0-1 years of hardcore hands-on experience in performance marketing, social media scaling, and funnel building (experience in Healthcare, Medical Devices, Pharmaceuticals, or B2B Tech is a massive advantage). No "Boost Post" Marketers: If your idea of Facebook marketing is clicking the "Boost" button from the page, do not apply. You must live and breathe Meta Ads Manager, Custom Audiences, Pixel/CAPI tracking, and A/B testing. AI-Native Workflow: Must have advanced proficiency in leveraging AI tools (Midjourney, Claude, Gemini, Runway/Kling, ElevenLabs) to produce ultra-high-resolution product visuals, 3D-style medical animations, and persuasive technical copy at 10x speed. Ability to understand and translate complex medical/surgical specifications (e.g., orthopedic casting tapes, surgical antiseptics, OT equipment, diagnostic machines) into clear, high-converting visual stories for doctors, procurement officers, and hospital management. Paid Media Mastery: Meta Ads Manager (Pixel, Conversion API, Lookalike Audiences, Lead Forms, Catalog Sales), TikTok Ads, Google Search/Display Ads, and LinkedIn B2B Outreach. Visual & Video Engineering: Advanced command over Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro / CapCut Pro, Canva Pro, and AI Image/Video generation prompting for studio-grade product rendering. Content & Hook Psychology: Deep understanding of 3-second video hooks, educational storytelling, clinical demonstration framing, and B2B trust-building architectures. Automation & Operations: Meta Business Suite bulk workflows, Google Sheets data organization, WhatsApp Business automation, and basic landing page/funnel optimization. Responsibilities & Context About the Role M/S Ocean Enterprise is a leading supplier of specialized medical equipment and surgical consumables. We are looking for a one-person digital powerhouse to take complete ownership of our digital ecosystem across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube Shorts. Your mission is simple but demanding: transform our social channels from basic product catalogs into high-authority lead-generation engines within 6 months. You will bridge the gap between technical medical superiority and aggressive digital distribution. Responsibilities Omnichannel Ecosystem Management: Build, optimize, and scale M/S Ocean Enterprise’s presence across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn with platform-specific content strategies. High-Converting Content Production: Script, design, and edit scroll-stopping static graphics, carousels, and short-form video reels/TikToks showcasing product mechanisms, clinical benefits, and usage demonstrations of our medical machines and surgical consumables. Bulk Automation & Scheduling: Architect a streamlined content pipeline using Google Sheets, Canva/Adobe Suite, and Meta Business Suite to bulk-create and schedule 30 to 60 days of strategic content in advance without sacrificing quality. Precision B2B & Doctor-Targeted Paid Ads: Set up and scale advanced Meta & TikTok ad campaigns focusing on Lead Generation, WhatsApp/Messenger conversion, and Retargeting. Build hyper-targeted funnels specifically aimed at surgeons, medical college procurement heads, clinic owners, and wholesale distributors across Bangladesh. Technical Copywriting & Localization: Write authoritative, medically accurate, yet commercially persuasive copy in both English and Bengali that addresses the pain points of healthcare professionals (durability, patient safety, cost-efficiency, certification). Lead Funnel & CRM Integration: Design automated response workflows (ManyChat / WhatsApp Business API) so that every comment, inbox query, or lead form submission from a doctor or hospital is instantly captured, qualified, and routed to our Sales & Service Engineers. Data Analytics & Competitors' Spying: Track weekly KPIs (Cost Per Lead, ROAS, Hook Rate, Hold Rate, Engagement Rate), monitor competitor ad libraries, and pivot strategies aggressively to dominate market share within 180 days. Accountant Intern
Application Deadline: Nov 20, 2026
Vacancy: 1

Location: Kishoreganj (Bhairab)
Experience: 0 to 1 years
Published: Oct 22, 2026
Requirements
Education
Educational Requirements
BBA or BCom in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
Final-year students and recent graduates may apply.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Job Summary
Jabbar Jute Mills is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Accounts Intern to support daily accounting and finance operations. The selected candidate will gain practical experience in bookkeeping, financial documentation, payment processing, reporting and manufacturing accounts.
We are looking for someone comfortable with digital tools, familiar with basic AI-assisted productivity, and eager to learn.
Key Responsibilities
Assist with daily accounting entries and maintain accurate financial records.
Prepare and organize payment vouchers, receipts, invoices and supporting documents.
Assist with accounts payable, accounts receivable and cashbook maintenance.
Help reconcile bank statements, cash balances and ledger entries.
Assist in preparing daily, weekly and monthly financial reports.
Maintain bills, invoices, expense records and accounting documents.
Verify supplier bills, purchase records and payment requests.
Assist with inventory accounting and raw material purchase documentation.
Use Microsoft Excel and accounting software to maintain financial data.
Use AI tools to assist with documentation, spreadsheet tasks, data organization and report drafting.
Verify AI-generated information and calculations against original records.
Coordinate with the Accounts, Purchase, Store and Administration departments.
Perform other tasks assigned by the Accounts Department.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 23 years
Only Male
Experience
Freshers are encouraged to apply.
Previous accounting or internship experience is an advantage.
Additional Requirements
Basic understanding of accounting principles and bookkeeping.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office.
Basic AI literacy, including familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude.
Ability to use AI tools for research, documentation, spreadsheet assistance and routine administrative tasks.
Ability to evaluate AI-generated information critically and verify accuracy before use.
Understanding of data privacy and the importance of protecting confidential financial information.
Strong numerical accuracy, analytical thinking and attention to detail.
Honest, disciplined, punctual and willing to learn.
Ability to work full-time at the factory office in Bhairab, Kishoreganj.
Skills: Accounting, Accounting Data Entry, Accounts and Finance, Accounts Payable Receivable, Bank Reconciliation, Bookkeeping, Financial analysis and reporting, Financial Reporting, Microsoft Excel, Reporting and Documentation
Company Address: Bhairab Bazar
Company Business
History: Jabbar Jute Mills Ltd. prides itself for being one of the oldest jute producers in the country. Established in 1965 by JB M. Nasir, under the jurisdiction of the government of Pakistan at the time, it, along with all other jute mills in the country, was converted into a public limited company by the newly formed government of Bangladesh in 1971. Jabbar Jute Mills Ltd was privatized again in 1984. Since then, new leadership has resulted in a flourishing mill, producing various types of finished jute products for the local and international markets. The Mill Based just outside the capital of Bangladesh in Bhairab, the Jabbar Jute Mill spans over 45 acres of land and currently employs over a 1000 people. Capable of producing various types of finished jute products including Hessian and Sacking products, new machinery and improved techniques allow the production of 5,500 MT of product annually, many of which are exported to various parts of the world. Products 2 Inch Heavy Cees, Standard Binola, Standard B. Twill, Hessian Cloth

Business Development Representative - International Markets

Full Time
Application

Job Description
Are you good at English and confident talking to people? Then we’d like to meet you.
We are growing our Dhaka team and looking for smart, confident people who want to start or grow their career in international business development. You don’t need to come from a particular industry. You could be a fresh graduate or at the beginning of your career. If you communicate well, are curious, and are willing to learn, we will train you.
What will you actually do?
You’ll work with international campaigns across the US, UK, Australia and APAC and speak directly with businesses and decision-makers in these markets.
Your day will involve:
Starting conversations with businesses overseas
Speaking with managers, business owners and decision-makers
Understanding their business needs
Introducing the product or service you are representing
Finding genuine business opportunities
Booking qualified meetings
Following up with people you have already spoken with
You won’t be expected to know everything when you join. Training, campaign knowledge and regular coaching will be provided.
You might be a good fit if…
Your spoken English is strong
You enjoy talking to people
You can have a natural conversation without simply reading a script
You are confident enough to speak with someone you’ve never met
You are curious and learn quickly
You can take feedback and improve
You are comfortable working towards targets
You want exposure to an international working environment
Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply. We care more about how you communicate and your potential than what your previous job title was.
What do you get from the role?
Exposure to international markets and businesses
Practical experience in B2B sales and business development
Experience speaking directly with international business professionals
Hands-on training and coaching
Performance-based incentives
Opportunity to grow into Senior BDR and leadership positions
What will success look like?
Once you are trained, your core targets will be:
100 outbound calls per day
5 meaningful business conversations per day
15 attended meetings per month
Working Details
Location: Baridhara DOHS, Dhaka
Work Mode: Office-based
Working Days: Monday–Friday
Markets: US / UK / Australia / APAC
Shift: Based on the international market you are assigned to
Our Selection Process
The first thing we want to understand is simple:
Can you communicate well?
Shortlisted candidates will have an initial conversation with our team. If selected, you will then be invited to our Dhaka office for a face-to-face interview.
Think you could be good at this?
Apply even if you’ve never considered a career in business development before.
If you have strong English, confidence and the willingness to learn, we want to hear from you.Gre

Age 18 to 45 years
Skills: Conversation, Fluent in English
Company Address: Singapore, RBF Road
Company Business
Step into the world of outbound sales and revenue generation. KonSalesHire connects ambitious professionals with high growth sales programs across global technology markets. If you thrive in performance driven environments and want to work with structured outbound teams, explore the opportunities available today.

Job Description
Based on the information received from the all running program preparing daily demand letter, issuing fund demands and sending any additional amounts to the head office.
Record and receive the money collected from all programs in the daily cash register.
Collecting money through internal transaction register from the cashier.
Verifying all bills for approval, ensure timely payment, and make sure they are entered into the software.
Ensuring reconciliation of daily cash register totals with the cash-bank book at the end of the day.
After collecting daily funds (loans, savings and others) and settling all the debts and other expenses of the day, depositing the extra money in the bank with the help of the branch manager, withdrawing it if necessary.
Checking and maintaining all bill vouchers, loan applications, contracts and daily used registers.
Purchasing office supplies with purchase committee following purchase policy and keeping stock updated properly.
Ensuring the use of applicable revenue stamps and proper deduction of VAT/TAX as per government regulation and depositing in government treasury within specified time.

.

digital marketing, lead generation, performance marketing, content marketing, B2B/B2C marketing, SaaS, software, technology, or service businesses

LinkedIn
Email marketing
SEO
Content marketing
Organic social media

Advertising copy
Email campaigns
Landing pages
Website content
Blog articles
Case studies
Promotional materials

Cost per lead

Cost per acquisition
Website traffic
Engagement

.
Experience targeting the

Experience targeting the

Understanding of different customer behaviors and target audiences.
Strong research and analytical skills.

SEO tools

Salesforce

AI-assisted marketing tools

US-market lead generation
Cost per lead
Lead quality
Conversion rates
Website traffic

Job Description
Job Context
We are looking for a curious, detail-oriented Researcher who can find relevant opportunities for our business, check eligibility requirements, and prepare accurate, tailored applications.
Opportunities may include grants, funding programmes, startup competitions, accelerators, tenders, contracts, and partnerships.
Students and recent graduates are welcome. Academic research, freelance work, volunteering, and personal projects can demonstrate relevant skills.
Job Responsibilities
Research official portals and credible sources to identify opportunities relevant to the company’s profile and business needs.
Read full guidelines and check eligibility, including entity type, location, business stage, exclusions, required documents, deadlines, time zones, costs, and submission requirements.
Prepare clear opportunity summaries covering benefits, requirements, official links, and a justified recommendation on whether to apply.
Draft tailored application answers, proposals, and supporting documents using verified company information.
Request missing information rather than inventing claims, achievements, figures, or other details.
Coordinate application reviews and submit applications once authorised. Refer fees, declarations, and commitments to the manager before proceeding.
Maintain a Google Sheets or Excel tracker covering opportunities, eligibility, deadlines, application status, required documents, next actions, and follow-up dates.
Retain submission confirmations, monitor updates, and follow up where appropriate.
Provide concise progress reports and protect confidential company information.
Use AI tools to support research and drafting while checking facts and requirements against original sources.
What Success Looks Like
Finding relevant, verified opportunities.
Making accurate eligibility checks and clear apply/do-not-apply recommendations.
Preparing complete, tailored applications.
Meeting deadlines and maintaining reliable records and follow-up.
Quality, accuracy, and relevance matter more than the number of links collected.

Ability to work independently in a remote environment and communicate progress clearly.
Availability for an agreed part-time schedule and willingness to start soon.

EXPERIENCE GROUP
Senior Accounts Officer
Application Deadline: Nov 21, 2026
Vacancy: 01
Age: At least 18 years
Location: Anywhere in Bangladesh
Salary: Tk. 30000 - 35000 (Monthly)
Published: Oct 22, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a relevant discipline.
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Job Responsibilities
Sales Auditing: Reconcile daily POS sales, cash receipts, card settlements, and online payment transactions with bank deposits.
Transaction Recording: Record daily sales, cash receipts, and supplier invoices in Tally or other accounting software.
Petty Cash Management: Monitor store petty cash, verify expense receipts, and ensure timely replenishment.
Accounts Payable (AP): Verify supplier invoices against purchase orders and delivery records, maintain payment schedules, and ensure timely payments.
Accounts Receivable (AR): Manage customer credit accounts, wholesale transactions, and corporate billing, where applicable.
Inventory Reconciliation: Reconcile physical stock with book inventory and investigate discrepancies affecting the cost of goods sold (COGS).
Bank Reconciliation: Reconcile bank statements and payment gateway settlements with internal accounting records.
Payroll Processing: Calculate salaries, overtime, and commissions, and ensure accurate payroll deductions and compliance with applicable tax regulations.
Financial Reporting: Prepare monthly Profit and Loss (P&L) statements, balance sheets, and budget variance reports.
VAT & Tax Compliance: Ensure accurate VAT calculations, timely submissions, and compliance with applicable VAT, income tax, and other statutory requirements in Bangladesh.
Budgeting & Forecasting: Assist in preparing operational budgets, cash flow forecasts, and profitability analyses.
Cost & Variance Analysis: Monitor operating expenses, analyze product profit margins, and identify inventory discrepancies and potential financial irregularities.
Audit Support: Maintain accounting records, supporting documents, and financial reports for internal, external, and statutory audits.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 18 years
CA (CC), CMA, or other relevant professional qualifications will be considered an advantage.
Experience Requirements
3–5 years of relevant experience in Accounts & Finance.
Practical experience in VAT and Tax compliance in Bangladesh is mandatory.
Experience in retail businesses or multi-outlet operations will be preferred.
Required Skills & Competencies
Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software, particularly Tally.
Sound knowledge of accounting principles, VAT, and taxation.
Strong analytical and numerical skills.
High attention to detail, accuracy, and integrity.
Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple tasks effectively.
Company Address: Uttara Office : Road 13, House 1, Sector 1, Dhaka Square Building (6th Floor) Jashimuddin, Uttara 1230
Company Business
Experience Group is one of Bangladesh’s fastest-growing and most diversified apparel, textiles, and accessories manufacturers, with leadership based in Dhaka and London. Our companies include Experience Design Limited (AMIRÁ), Harry Fashion Limited, Experience Clothing Company Limited, Experience Accessories Company Limited, and Experience Textile Limited. We partner with leading global fashion brands and produce high-quality garments, fabrics, and packaging across multiple categories. With modern facilities, strong technical teams, and a culture built on trust, innovation, and performance, we are shaping the next generation of Bangladesh’s export industry. At Experience Group, people grow fast. We provide a collaborative workplace, real responsibility, and opportunities to learn directly from industry leaders. If you want to build a long-term career in a dynamic and forward-thinking organization, you’ll feel at home here.

Excellent communication, coordination, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
High integrity, attention to detail, confidentiality, and the ability to work under pressure.

bdjobs.com/h/details/1546941?ln=1.source_content:
Standard Islami Bank PLC.
Sales & Recovery Manager-Cards (upto VP)
Application Deadline: Nov 5, 2026
Age: 25 to 45 years
Location: Anywhere in Bangladesh
Salary: Negotiable
Experience: At least 2 years
Published: Oct 19, 2026
Requirements
Education
Masters
Bachelor/Honors
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
A. Card Sales:
Achieve individual and team sales targets for Islamic Credit Cards and Prepaid Cards, as set by management.
Plan and schedule the monthly sales target and visit calendar and track progress against it.
Visit individual and corporate customers to promote and sell Islamic card products.
Identify prospective customers through regular field visits, corporate tie-ups, and the bank’s existing customer base.
Arrange meetings with prospective clients, explain product features, Shariah-compliant structure, and applicable fees, and collect the required documents.
Verify the completeness of applications and documents (KYC, income proof, etc.) before submission and follow up with the processing unit until the card is issued.
Brief and train sales executives on products and services so they have adequate product knowledge.
Develop short- and long-term sales forecasts to support the marketing plan.
Plan strategies for acquiring new business, including campaigns, merchant offers, and corporate partnerships.
Maintain strong relationships with customers and provide excellent after-sales service, such as card activation, limit queries, and complaint resolution.
Prepare field visit and sales reports and present them to management.
B. Card Recovery:
Lead the card recovery team and ensure the collection of monthly installments and overdue amounts from cardholders.
Monitor accounts regularly to identify overdue and long-outstanding dues and classify them by aging.
Review the history of each delinquent card file, including usage, payment pattern, and past contact records.
Contact cardholders by phone, SMS, letter, and personal visit to secure repayment.
Visit defaulting cardholders at their residence or workplace to recover dues.
Negotiate repayment arrangements, such as rescheduling or settlement, within the bank’s policy and Shariah guidelines.
Ensure any late payment charge is handled as per Shariah-approved policy (charity, not bank income), and avoid conventional interest-based terms.
Coordinate with the legal and credit administration units on legal notices and further action for non-responsive accounts.
Prepare a daily time-wise work plan, weekly collection plan, and monthly tour plan, and submit them to the supervisor.
Achieve the collection and delinquency-reduction targets set by management.
Prepare regular recovery reports (collection status, NPL/delinquency ratio, aging analysis) for the manager.
Maintain good relationships with existing and potential customers while carrying out recovery in a professional and ethical manner.
C. Compliance & General:
Follow the bank’s policies, Shariah guidelines, central bank regulations, and anti-money laundering (AML/KYC) requirements.
Keep customer information confidential and use it only for authorized purposes.
Maintain accurate records of all customer interactions, visits, and collections in the system.
Ensure fair, respectful, and ethical dealing with customers, with no harassment or pressure tactics.
Coordinate with the Marketing, Operations, Credit, and Customer Service departments.
Perform any other duties assigned by management.
Additional Requirements
Age 25 to 45 years
No third class/division in any academic record.
Minimum 2 years of experience in card sales and card recovery in any reputed bank or financial institution.
Working knowledge of credit card and prepaid card products, sales processes, and recovery procedures.
Proven ability to meet individual sales and collection targets.
Strong communication and negotiation skills for dealing with customers.
Basic analytical skills, with the ability to read and interpret collection, aging, and delinquency data.
Good relationship-building and customer service skills.
Willingness to do regular field visits for sales and recovery.
Awareness of Shariah principles in Islamic banking, and of AML/KYC and central bank guidelines.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for reports and tracking.
Skills: Bank Card Sales, Client Acquisition, Client Service/ Marketing, Credit card reconsilations, Customer Relationship, Recovery, Sales & Marketing
Compensation & Other Benefits
Provident fund,Mobile bill,Credit card,Gratuity
Festival Bonus: 2
Boishakhi Bonus
Furniture Allowance
Company Address: Metropolitan Chamber Building (3rd Floor), 122-124 Motijheel CA, Dhaka - 1000
Company Business
Bank

Officer, Purchase – Agri Business(Rice)
Application Deadline: Nov 23, 2026
Vacancy: 2
Location: Anywhere in Bangladesh
Salary: Negotiable
Experience: 1 to 3 years
Published: Oct 24, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Agriculture or a related subject.
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Confidence Infrastructure PLC is starting a new Agri Business that buys processed rice from external millers and distributes it to customers. We are hiring Purchase Officers to handle day-to-day buying under the direction of the Purchase Lead. The work covers talking to suppliers, collecting quotations, issuing purchase orders, following up deliveries and keeping procurement records. The role is based in North Bengal and involves regular visits to millers and suppliers.
Job Responsibilities
Collect quotations and daily price offers from millers and suppliers, and prepare comparative statements.
Visit millers and suppliers in North Bengal to check their stock, capacity and rice quality.
Collect samples before purchase for QC review when needed.
Prepare purchase requisitions and purchase orders for approval, and send approved orders to suppliers.
Follow up with suppliers on delivery schedules, and coordinate transport, lifting and receipt with Logistics, Store and QC.
Check supplier bills, challans and weighment slips, and send them to Accounts for payment.
Follow shortage and quality claims with suppliers until they are settled.
Keep a complete procurement file for every purchase, in line with company procurement policy.
Keep the supplier database and documents up to date, such as the trade licence, food-grain licence, TIN and BIN/VAT certificates.
Share supplier price data with the Purchase Lead and Market Intelligence.
Additional Requirements
Procurement or supply chain work in food, agro or FMCG businesses.
Basic knowledge of rice varieties and quality parameters (moisture, broken percentage, grain size, colour and purity).
Experienced in collecting quotations, preparing comparative statements and processing purchase orders.
Good at following up deliveries and keeping supplier documents in order.
Comfortable with an ERP procurement module, MS Excel and MS Word.
Honest and detail-oriented, follows through on tasks, and communicates and works well with others.
Willing to be based anywhere in North Bengal and to travel often to millers and suppliers.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Provident Fund
Gratuity
Festival Bonus
Earned Leave Encashment
Mobile Bill Allowance
Health Insurance and Life Insurance
Employee Assistance Program (confidential counselling)
Wellness and self-development resources (company library)
Weekly holiday: 1 day (6-day work week)

Job Description
KNOWLEDGE HUB INSTITUTE TRUST (KHI Trust)
POLICY•INFO•INTEL•DECEN
Program Associate (Finance & Accounts)
Reports To:
Deputy Director, Finance
The Knowledge Hub Institute Trust (KHIT) is a results-oriented think and do tank that turns complex policy challenges into practical, evidence-based solutions, working across its six core thematic Research Units — Energy & Climate, Fiscal Justice, Business & Human Rights, Business Climate, Social Justice, and AI & Digitization — to strengthen institutions and drive inclusive impact in Bangladesh. KHI invites applications from accomplished finance and account professionals for the position of Program Associate (Finance & Accounts) to support the Institute’s financial management, accounting, administrative, and compliance functions.
Key Responsibilities
Assist in day-to-day financial operations, including voucher preparation, data entry, bookkeeping, and maintenance of accurate financial records.
Support the preparation of monthly financial statements, expenditure reports, and other financial information.
Assist in budget preparation, budget monitoring, and expenditure tracking for organizational activities and donor-funded programmes.
Process payments, maintain cash and bank records, and assist with bank reconciliations.
Support payroll processing, staff reimbursement, and other employee-related financial transactions.
Assist in preparing donor financial reports and maintaining supporting documents in accordance with grant agreements and donor requirements.
Maintain financial files, vouchers, bills, receipts, and other supporting documents for audit and compliance purposes.
Assist in VAT, income tax, and other statutory compliance activities, as required.
Support procurement documentation, asset registers, inventory records, and related financial administration.
Coordinate with programme and administrative teams to collect financial information and ensure timely processing of transactions.
Assist in internal and external audits by providing relevant financial records and supporting documents.
Perform any other duties assigned by the Deputy Director, Finance or the Executive Director.
Additional Requirements
Qualifications & Experience:
Minimum 1–3 years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, or financial administration, preferably in an NGO, nonprofit, or development organization.
Good knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, budgeting, bank reconciliation, and MS Excel. Experience with accounting software will be an advantage.
Basic understanding of donor-funded project financial management and reporting requirements will be an advantage.
Familiarity with Bangladesh’s VAT, income tax, and applicable financial compliance requirements.
Strong numerical and analytical skills, attention to detail, integrity, organizational ability, and effective communication skills.
Candidates with experience in NGO/CSO financial management and donor-funded projects will receive preference.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Compensation: An attractive remuneration package, negotiable and commensurate with the candidate`s qualifications and experience, will be offered along with other admissible benefits.

ই-কমার্স প্রতিষ্ঠানে কাজের অভিজ্ঞতা অগ্রাধিকার পাবে।

Microsoft Excel ও Google Sheets ব্যবহারে পারদর্শী হতে হবে।
নেতৃত্ব প্রদান, সমস্যা সমাধান ও সিদ্ধান্ত গ্রহণে দক্ষ হতে হবে।

যোগ্যতা ও অভিজ্ঞতা অনুযায়ী আলোচনা সাপেক্ষে
লাভের উপর আলোচনার ভিত্তিতে কমিশন।
যোগ্যতা ও অভিজ্ঞতা অনুযায়ী আকর্ষণীয় বেতন।
প্রতিষ্ঠানের নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী অন্যান্য সুযোগ-সুবিধা।
প্রতিষ্ঠানের সঙ্গে দীর্ঘমেয়াদে কাজ করে ক্যারিয়ার গড়ার সুযোগ।

Employment Status
Contractual
Job Description
Join Us at Plan International Bangladesh: Make a Lasting Impact!
Plan International is an independent development and humanitarian organisation that advances children’s rights and equality for girls. We believe in the power and potential of every child. But this is often suppressed by poverty, violence, exclusion and discrimination. And its girls who are most affected and mostly during crisis. Working together with children, young people, our supporters and partners, we strive for a just world, tackling the root causes of the challenges facing girls and all vulnerable children. For over 85 years, we have rallied other determined optimists to transform the lives of all children in more than 80 countries.
Over the 30 years journey in Bangladesh, we envision a 2030 where children and youth, particularly girls and young women, are recognized as leaders of change in gender norms and can make decisions about their lives.
Since 24 September 2017, Plan International has been responding to the Rohingya refugee influx in Cox’s Bazar with special focus on protecting girls and boys from violence, abuse, neglect, and exploitation; improving hygiene and sanitation; and restoring access to safe, quality, and inclusive education for refugee children and adolescents. Guided by our core values, we remain unwavering in our commitment to advancing children’s rights and equality for girls so that children, especially girls, and their communities can learn, lead, decide, and thrive.
For the past three decades, our work in Bangladesh has made a significant impact, and we are now looking for a Monitoring, Evaluation, Research and Learning (MERL) Specialist.
The Role:
Monitoring, Evaluation, Research and Learning (MERL) Specialist will be responsible for designing and leading the monitoring, evaluation, research and learning (MERL) activities and ensuring result-based management in program and project areas as defined in the country strategy. The position holder will develop the theory of change (TOC), result framework, and indicators to measure success in respective projects & programmes through regular monitoring and evaluation activities. In line with PQI team the Specialist will track output delivery and assess outcomes to understand projects & programmes progress towards achieving objectives, conduct regular process monitoring, compile information, capture learning and produce quarterly reports for the projects & programme team and country management team to support decision-making. Data quality assurance is one of the key responsibilities of this role. The MERL Specialist will also contribute to capacity building of staff at Plan and partner organizations to enhance skills in programme monitoring. The role requires continuous support to resource mobilization initiatives for the Cox’s Bazar Programme. This position provides intensive support to different projects in Cox’s Bazar and other geographic locations and addresses donor requirements in the areas of MERL. Another major responsibility will be supporting the implementation of AAP (accountability to affected population) in different projects.
Additional Requirements
Proven M&E Practitioner with Emergency Expertise: At least 3 years of progressively responsible experience leading M&E systems in development or humanitarian settings, including a minimum of 1 year of emergency response projects in Cox’s Bazar.
Strategic Framework Architect: Demonstrated mastery in designing, operationalizing, and tracking Theories of Change (ToC), results frameworks, logframes, and indicator matrices to measure project and programme success systematically.
Advanced Data & Analytics Specialist: Strong quantitative and qualitative expertise—from managing digital data collection tools and quality assurance to conducting rigorous analysis using MS Excel and statistical packages (SPSS, STATA, or R) to drive evidence-based decisions.
Evaluation & Consultant Coordinator: Proven track record in executing Annual Outcome Monitoring, formulating clear Terms of Reference (ToRs), and managing external consultants and project evaluations to secure high-impact, timely deliverables.
Safeguarding Champion & Agile Field Responder: Deep commitment to child safeguarding, "Do No Harm" ethics, and donor compliance, paired with the readiness to deploy and deliver quality results during rapid-onset disasters or emergency responses.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Salary Package for this role is monthly CTC 128,566 BDT which includes contributory provident fund, gratuity, festival bonus, along with other benefits, i.e., hospitalization benefit for spouse and children, leave, group insurance, yearly medical check-up for employee, and day care facilities.
Company Address: House # CWN (B) 14, Road 35, Gulshan-2, Dhaka-1212
Company Business
Founded 80 years ago, Plan International is one of the oldest and largest childrens development organisations in the world. We work in 52 countries across Africa, Asia and the Americas to promote child rights and lift millions of children out of poverty. In 2015, Plan International worked with 100 million children in 85,282 communities. Plan International is independent, with no religious, political or governmental affiliations but having a vision of a world in which all children realize their full potential in societies that respect peoples rights and dignity. Plan International has been operating in Bangladesh since 1994. Plan International seeks to ensure the rights of children to education, health, safe water and sanitation, protection, youth social and economic empowerment and climate change, environmental degradation and natural or man-made disaster hazards throughout the country.

We are seeking highly motivated, energetic, and professional individuals to join our Administration & Finance Department. Our organization provides premium corporate support, relocation, housing, and administrative services to foreign embassies, multinational corporations (MNCs), and expatriate professionals.

Corporate Administration:

Job Description
Job Summary
Responsible for multi-outlet sales reporting, cash handling, accounting entries, digital payment and bank reconciliation, supplier payments, collections, and financial documentation, ensuring accuracy, timely reporting, and compliance with company policies.
Key Responsibilities
Sales & Accounting:
Prepare daily outlet-wise sales sheets and summaries; verify POS reports, supporting documents, payment channels (cash, cards, bKash, Foodpanda, Pathao, Foodi, etc.), discounts, promotions, refunds, voids, and complimentary meals; identify discrepancies and post accurate, timely Sales Journal Vouchers (JV), Cash Vouchers (CV), receipts, deposits, supplier payments, petty cash, and other approved transactions in Accounts Care, maintaining correct ledgers, cost centres, references, and audit trails.
Cash & Fund Management:
Collect, count, verify, record, and safeguard outlet cash; reconcile collections with sales, deposit funds on time, and report shortages or excesses. Collect and maintain separate records of tips, excess money, scrap-sale proceeds, birthday contributions, and other designated funds; deposit within approved timelines and submit collection summaries and supporting documents.
Reconciliation & Banking:
Reconcile monthly bKash, card, cash, POS, merchant, accounting, and bank records; investigate charges, refunds, failed or delayed settlements, missing deposits, incorrect credits, and discrepancies. Follow up with banks, payment providers, and outlets; monitor outstanding settlements; prepare reconciliation statements and maintain deposit slips, bank statements, cheque records, transfer confirmations, payment advice, and related documents.

কোম্পানির ক্যাম্পেইন পিকআপের মাধ্যমে ঢাকা শহরের বিভিন্ন এলাকায় সরাসরি মার্কেটিং কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করা।
কোম্পানির পণ্য (দুধ, ঘি, সরিষার তেলসহ অন্যান্য পণ্য) প্রচার, ব্র্যান্ড পরিচিতি বৃদ্ধি এবং বিক্রয় সম্প্রসারণে কাজ করা।
নতুন গ্রাহক সংগ্রহ করা এবং বিদ্যমান গ্রাহকদের সাথে সুসম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা।
নতুন গ্রাহকদের নাম, মোবাইল নম্বর, ঠিকানা ও প্রয়োজনীয় তথ্য সংগ্রহ করে নির্ধারিত খাতা/রেজিস্টারে সঠিকভাবে এন্ট্রি করা এবং নিয়মিত আপডেট রাখা।
নির্ধারিত মাসিক ও দৈনিক বিক্রয় লক্ষ্যমাত্রা (Sales Target) অর্জন করা।
বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধি ও কর্মদক্ষতার ভিত্তিতে অতিরিক্ত ইনসেনটিভ ও ইনক্রিমেন্ট অর্জনের সুযোগ গ্রহণ করা।
নিয়মিত বাজার সমীক্ষা (Market Survey) পরিচালনা করা এবং প্রতিযোগী প্রতিষ্ঠানের পণ্য, মূল্য ও বিপণন কার্যক্রম সম্পর্কিত তথ্য সংগ্রহ ও প্রতিবেদন প্রদান করা।
ডিস্ট্রিবিউটর, হোলসেলার, রিটেইলার এবং কর্পোরেট গ্রাহকদের সাথে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা।
বিভিন্ন প্রচারণামূলক কার্যক্রম (Promotional Activities), পণ্য প্রদর্শনী (Product Display), টেস্টিং ক্যাম্পেইন এবং বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধিমূলক কার্যক্রম বাস্তবায়ন করা।
দৈনিক কার্যক্রম, নতুন গ্রাহক সংগ্রহের তথ্য এবং বিক্রয় প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত করে কর্তৃপক্ষের নিকট জমা দেওয়া।
কোম্পানির ব্র্যান্ড ইমেজ ও সুনাম অক্ষুণ্ণ রেখে দায়িত্ব পালন করা।
কর্মস্থল:
ঢাকা মহানগরীর বিভিন্ন এলাকা (ক্যাম্পেইন পিকআপের মাধ্যমে ফিল্ড মার্কেটিং)।
কর্মঘণ্টা (দুই শিফটে):
প্রথম শিফট: সকাল ৬:০০টা থেকে সকাল ১১:০০টা পর্যন্ত।
দ্বিতীয় শিফট: বিকাল ৩:৩০টা থেকে রাত ৮:৩০টা পর্যন্ত।
মোট কর্মঘণ্টা: দৈনিক ১০ ঘণ্টা।
বিশেষ শর্ত: প্রতিষ্ঠানের কাজের প্রয়োজনে নির্ধারিত সময়ের অতিরিক্ত কাজ করতে হতে পারে।

বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধি ও কর্মদক্ষতার ভিত্তিতে অতিরিক্ত ইনসেনটিভ ও ইনক্রিমেন্ট অর্জনের সুযোগ গ্রহণ করা।
নিয়মিত বাজার সমীক্ষা (Market Survey) পরিচালনা করা এবং প্রতিযোগী প্রতিষ্ঠানের পণ্য, মূল্য ও বিপণন কার্যক্রম সম্পর্কিত তথ্য সংগ্রহ ও প্রতিবেদন প্রদান করা।
ডিস্ট্রিবিউটর, হোলসেলার, রিটেইলার এবং কর্পোরেট গ্রাহকদের সাথে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা।
বিভিন্ন প্রচারণামূলক কার্যক্রম (Promotional Activities), পণ্য প্রদর্শনী (Product Display), টেস্টিং ক্যাম্পেইন এবং বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধিমূলক কার্যক্রম বাস্তবায়ন করা।
দৈনিক কার্যক্রম, নতুন গ্রাহক সংগ্রহের তথ্য এবং বিক্রয় প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত করে কর্তৃপক্ষের নিকট জমা দেওয়া।
কোম্পানির ব্র্যান্ড ইমেজ ও সুনাম অক্ষুণ্ণ রেখে দায়িত্ব পালন করা।
কর্মস্থল:
ঢাকা মহানগরীর বিভিন্ন এলাকা (ক্যাম্পেইন পিকআপের মাধ্যমে ফিল্ড মার্কেটিং)।
কর্মঘণ্টা (দুই শিফটে):
প্রথম শিফট: সকাল ৬:০০টা থেকে সকাল ১১:০০টা পর্যন্ত।
দ্বিতীয় শিফট: বিকাল ৩:৩০টা থেকে রাত ৮:৩০টা পর্যন্ত।
মোট কর্মঘণ্টা: দৈনিক ১০ ঘণ্টা।
বিশেষ শর্ত: প্রতিষ্ঠানের কাজের প্রয়োজনে নির্ধারিত সময়ের অতিরিক্ত কাজ করতে হতে পারে।
বিশেষ দ্রষ্টব্য :   ১ লা নভেম্বর থেকে জয়নিং দেওয়া হবে
Additional Requirements
Age 22 to 40 years
Only Male
Skills: Dairy Product Sales, Sales & Marketing, Marketing, Market/ Consumer Research

Performance Marketing Expert / Digital Ads Specialist

Location: Anywhere in Bangladesh

Experience: At least 1 years
Published: Oct 24, 2026
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
চাকরির ধরন: ফুল-টাইম, ইন-হাউস (অফিসে উপস্থিত থেকে কাজ)
🎯 কাজের দায়িত্ব
১. Facebook/Meta Ads পরিচালনা, অপটিমাইজ ও স্কেল করা।
২. Google Ads ও TikTok Ads পরিচালনা করা।
৩. Ad Campaign Planning, Budget Management ও Performance Analysis করা।
৪. Content Research, Market Research ও Competitor Analysis করা।
৫. বিজ্ঞাপনের জন্য কার্যকর Ad Copy, Creative ও Video Content-এর আইডিয়া দেওয়া।
৬. Meta Pixel, CAPI ও Conversion Tracking সম্পর্কে ভালো ধারণা থাকা।
৭. ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM ও Conversion Rate বিশ্লেষণ করা।
৮. বিজ্ঞাপনের খরচ নিয়ন্ত্রণ করে বিক্রয় ও লাভ বাড়ানোর কৌশল তৈরি করা।
৯. নিয়মিত বিজ্ঞাপনের ফলাফল বিশ্লেষণ ও রিপোর্ট তৈরি করা।
১০. নতুন মার্কেটিং স্ট্র্যাটেজি তৈরি করে ব্যবসার বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধিতে কাজ করা।
Additional Requirements
যোগ্যতা ও অভিজ্ঞতা
ডিজিটাল মার্কেটিংয়ে ন্যূনতম ১ বছরের বাস্তব ও সাম্প্রতিক কাজের অভিজ্ঞতা থাকতে হবে।
গত এক বছরের মধ্যে Facebook/Meta Ads পরিচালনার বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতা থাকতে হবে।
Facebook/Meta Ads-এ বিশেষ দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে।
Google Ads ও TikTok Ads পরিচালনার অভিজ্ঞতা থাকতে হবে।
Content Research, Market Research ও Competitor Analysis সম্পর্কে ভালো ধারণা থাকতে হবে।
E-commerce ব্যবসার বিজ্ঞাপন পরিচালনা ও বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধির অভিজ্ঞতা থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে।
ডেটা বিশ্লেষণ করে সঠিক সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়ার সক্ষমতা থাকতে হবে।
Ad Budget পরিচালনার অভিজ্ঞতা
দৈনিক ন্যূনতম $200–$500 বা তার বেশি Ad Budget পরিচালনার বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতা থাকতে হবে।
বড় বাজেটের Ad Campaign পরিচালনা, অপটিমাইজ ও স্কেল করার দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে।
বিজ্ঞাপনের বাজেট বাড়ানোর সঙ্গে সঙ্গে ROAS ও লাভজনকতা বজায় রাখার সক্ষমতা থাকতে হবে।
পারফরম্যান্স ও ব্যবসার লক্ষ্য অনুযায়ী দৈনিক $500+ Ad Spend পরিচালনা ও স্কেল করার আত্মবিশ্বাস এবং বাস্তব দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে।
Compensation & Other Benefits
বেতন: ৩০,০০০–৬০,০০০ টাকা
বেতন নির্ধারণ: অভিজ্ঞতা, দক্ষতা ও পারফরম্যান্স অনুযায়ী।
মাসিক বেতন ৩০,০০০–৬০,০০০ টাকা। প্রার্থীর অভিজ্ঞতা, বিজ্ঞাপন পরিচালনার সক্ষমতা, বাজেট ব্যবস্থাপনা এবং পূর্ববর্তী কাজের ফলাফলের ভিত্তিতে বেতন নির্ধারণ করা হবে।
Company Address: Staff Quarter, Demra, Dhaka, Bangladesh

Job Description
Company Description
Curl Ware is a web agency that specializes in WordPress and Laravel development, app development, web design, and UX/UI design. The team focuses on delivering high-quality digital solutions that help businesses and individuals strengthen their online presence. By combining technical expertise with thoughtful design and optimization, Curl Ware supports clients in achieving measurable results. The agency is committed to exceeding client expectations and providing tailored solutions that drive growth and success. Professionals joining Curl Ware can expect a collaborative environment that values innovation and client-focused outcomes.
Role Description
The Executive (Sales) – Software Marketing role is a full-time, on-site position based in Dhaka. This role is responsible for identifying and pursuing new business opportunities for web development, app development, SEO, and design services, as well as nurturing relationships with existing clients. Daily tasks include prospecting, scheduling and conducting client meetings, preparing and delivering sales presentations, and drafting proposals and quotations. The Executive will collaborate closely with technical and design teams to understand service offerings, align solutions with client needs, and ensure accurate communication of project requirements. Additional responsibilities include monitoring market trends, maintaining a sales pipeline and CRM records, achieving sales targets, and providing regular reports and feedback to leadership.Need to sell ERP also
Qualifications
Proven experience in software or IT services sales, with the ability to understand and promote web development, app development, and digital solutions.
Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills to engage prospects, build trust, and close business deals.
Ability to manage a sales pipeline, prioritize opportunities, and meet or exceed defined sales targets.
Comfort working in an on-site, collaborative environment in Dhaka, with strong interpersonal skills and a client-centric mindset.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, IT, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proficiency with common office and CRM tools for tracking leads, preparing proposals, and reporting on sales activities.
Previous experience in a web agency, software company, or tech-focused environment is an advantage.
Additional Requirements
Age 22 to 30 years
Has to be smart and communicative. Should have thirst of faster growth.

bdjobs.com/h/details/1548482?ln=1.source_content:
A Reputed Restaurant Chain in Chattogram
Executive Sr. Executive -HR & Admin
Application Deadline: Oct 31, 2026
Vacancy: 02
Age: 24 to 26 years
Location: Chattogram (Chattogram Sadar)
Salary: Negotiable
Experience: At least 2 years
Published: Oct 24, 2026
Requirements
Education
Master of Commerce (MCom) in Human Resource Management, Management
PGD In HRM (BIM)
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
1. Recruitment & Selection: Coordinate manpower requisitions, job postings, CV screening, interview scheduling, candidate communication, and joining formalities.
2. Joining & Onboarding: Prepare offer and appointment letters, collect employee documents, complete joining formalities, and facilitate employee orientation.
3. Attendance & Leave Management: Monitor daily attendance, late arrivals, absenteeism, overtime, weekly holidays, and leave records; coordinate corrections with relevant departments.
4. Employee Records & HRIS: Maintain accurate and confidential employee files, personnel databases, employee ID records, and HR system updates.
5. Payroll Coordination: Verify attendance, leave, overtime, and other approved payroll inputs; coordinate salary processing with Accounts & Finance.
6. Policy Implementation: Communicate HR policies, rules, procedures, and management instructions and support consistent implementation across departments.
7. Employee Relations: Address routine employee queries, assist in grievance handling, maintain communication with employees, and escalate sensitive matters to the Head of HR.
8. Performance Management: Coordinate probation reviews, confirmation assessments, KPI-based appraisals, and performance documentation.

Job Description
We are hiring one Customer Service Executive to handle all customer calls for both Jompesh and Lal Jhal. You will be the voice of both brands: confirming orders, solving delivery problems with Pathao, and collecting customer feedback that helps our marketing.
Key responsibilities
1. Manage all customer calls
Receive and return calls from customers of both brands: product questions, prices, order status, complaints.
Answer politely and clearly; solve the problem on the call where possible, or pass it to the right person and call the customer back.
Return every missed call the same day.
2. Order confirmation calls
Call each new customer to confirm the order: name, phone, full address, products, quantity and total amount.
Correct wrong or incomplete details in the order system before the order is sent for delivery.
Flag suspicious, fake or duplicate orders, and note when a customer asks for a later delivery date.
3. courier related calls
Handle calls from courier riders and hubs: customer not reachable, address problem, delivery reschedule.
Follow up with customers on failed, delayed or returned deliveries and try to save the order.
Track orders that are stuck or on hold and push them to completion.
4. Marketing and customer feedback calls
Call customers after delivery to collect feedback on product quality, taste, packaging and delivery.
Call past customers to inform them of new products and offers, and encourage repeat orders.
Share a short weekly summary of common complaints, requests and feedback with the management.
5. Record keeping
Log every call outcome (confirmed, cancelled, rescheduled, complaint, feedback) in our order system.
Keep customer information accurate and confidential.
Requirements
Minimum HSC; graduates preferred.
Clear, polite spoken Bangla and a friendly phone manner.
Patience with angry or confused customers, and the ability to stay calm.
Basic smartphone and computer skills: WhatsApp, Google Sheets or similar, typing in Bangla and English.
Organised and reliable: follows up on every call and keeps accurate records.
Preferred
1 year or more in a call centre, customer service or e-commerce role.
Familiarity with Pathao or other courier services, and with online order processes.
Interest in food products and talking to people.
Working hours, salary and how to apply
Office time:
11:00 AM – 8:00 PM, 6 days a week.
Holiday:
1 day off every week (day fixed with the management).
Location:
Mirpur, Dhaka
Salary:
Negotiable based on experience.
Benefits:
mobile/call allowance for work calls; festival bonus as per company policy.
Additional Requirements
Age 22 to 35 years
Skills: Customer Service
Compensation & Other Benefits
T/A,Mobile bill,Performance bonus
Festival Bonus: 2
Company Address: Online and Offline food Retail company

The teachers are selected on the basis of merit and competence through a transparent and fair recruiting process. The classroom ambiance, student-teacher interaction, and teaching methods are all carefully designed for students to develop a lifelong desire to learn. Our digitally equipped and spacious classrooms enable students to be more than spectators. They are encouraged to actively participate in class activities. Each of the classrooms is neatly designed to accommodate about 30 students. In addition, there are three large digital classrooms equipped with multi-media projectors and smart boards to facilitate PowerPoint presentations. The Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and ICT labs are well-equipped and well-utilized for practical-oriented learning. We focus not only on grades and results but also on the critical and analytical thinking capability of the students. The institution has a rich Library and all students have a weekly Library Class. The aim is to inculcate broad-based reading habits in our students. Since its inception, the institution has striven to maintain a measured but steady pace of growth in the number of students. This policy has, so far, paid rich dividends in terms of institutional development. We are now confident that this conservative rate of growth has enabled us to assess, reflect upon and design our future course, thus avoiding the risks of unplanned hasty expansion. It has also resulted in a comprehensive, systematic, and structured evolution of such school facilities as Wi-Fi to cope with the requirement of online classes during the Covid-19 pandemic. It can safely and proudly be said that it is one of the very few educational institutions which had effectively and regularly conducted online classes during the pandemic. The adoption of a gradual but carefully defined expansion policy has helped KCMSC to build a healthy relationship among its workforce, its student body, and the guardians at large. Today, KCMSC looks forward to a future of constant and uninterrupted growth and hopes to set an example of an institution that is able to endure the test of trying times in the coming years. We firmly believe that to create a prosperous nation, there is no alternative to building a generation of well-educated citizens who will lead the nation forward.
