Company Business
WELCOME TO K C MODEL SCHOOL & COLLEGE K C Model School and College (KCMSC) is a renowned educational institution near Uttara, at 275, Prembagan, Dakshinkhan, Dhaka-1230. Brig Gen Mushfiqur Rahman SPP, psc (retd) was involved with this institution as its Chief Advisor from its very outset. In addition, very efficient and experienced educationists were appointed as principals and Vice Principals to build up a strong senior management team. Senior Brand Executive/Assistant Brand Manager
Application Deadline: Nov 5, 2026
Age: At most 32 years
Location: Dhaka
Salary: Negotiable
Experience: At least 3 years
Published: Oct 25, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Marketing
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Develop and execute brand strategies and marketing plans to drive brand equity, market share, and business growth.
Plan and execute integrated 360-degree marketing campaigns across ATL, BTL, digital, social media, influencer marketing, and consumer activation.
Strengthen brand positioning, awareness, preference, and loyalty through consistent brand communication and consumer engagement.
Analyze consumer insights, market trends, competitor activities, and channel opportunities to identify growth drivers.
Develop marketing and category plans covering product innovation, renovation, pricing, and portfolio optimization.
Prepare sales budgets, Consolidated Marketing Plans (CMP), and Profit & Loss (P&L) statements for the assigned portfolio.
Monitor national and zonal sales performance against budgets and recommend corrective actions.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams and external agencies to ensure effective campaign development and execution.
Plan and execute new product launches, including positioning, pricing, go-to-market strategy, and post-launch evaluation.
Monitor brand performance, marketing expenditure, and campaign effectiveness; present monthly Brand Performance Reviews (BPR) and recommend improvements.
Conduct market and household visits to generate consumer insights and identify emerging trends and business opportunities.
Maintain marketing reports, sales tracking, budgeting dashboards, and income statements in coordination with relevant departments.
Additional Requirements
Age At most 32 years
Company Address: ACI Centre, 245 Tejgaon Industrial Area, Dhaka-1208.
Company Business
Pharmaceuticals; Agribusiness; Consumer Brands.

৪৮.০০.০০০০.০০২.১০.২৬২৪.২০১৭-৭৭২ নম্বর পমরপদত্রর মনদে মশনা অনু ায়ী প্রার্থীদক মনদম্নাি কাগজপত্র/তথ্যামে অনুদেে-৯ এ বমণ মত কাগজপত্রামে/তথ্যামেসে োমিল করদত েদব;  
 
২.২.১    মুমিদ াদ্ধার নার্ সাংবমলত “লাল মুমিবাতমা” অর্থবা “ভারতীয় তামলকা”র সতযাময়ত কমপ এবাং মুমিযুদ্ধ মবষয়ক র্ন্ত্রণালদয়র website এ প্রকামশত সাংমিষ্ট মুমিদ াদ্ধার নার্ মপতার নার্ ও ঠিকানা    
           সাংবমলত তামলকা মবমপএসমস িরর্-5A (Applicant’s Copy) এর সাদর্থ জর্া মেদত েদব। আদবেদন উমিমিত মুমিদ াদ্ধার নার্, মপতার নার্ ও ঠিকানার সাদর্থ প্রার্থীর উপস্থামপত “লাল মুমিবাতমা”     
          মকাংবা “ভারতীয় তামলকা” অর্থবা উপস্থামপত উভয় তামলকার সাদর্থ মুমিযুদ্ধ মবষয়ক র্ন্ত্রণালদয়র website এ প্রকামশত মুমিদ াদ্ধার নার্, মপতার নার্ ও ঠিকানা এক ও অমভন্ন েদত েদব।  
 
২.২.১.১ শকাদনা মুমিদ াদ্ধার নার্ “লাল মুমিবাতমা” মকাংবা “ভারতীয় তামলকায়” না র্থাকদল প্রার্থীদক মুমিদ াদ্ধার নার্, মপতার নার্ ও ঠিকানা সাংবমলত শগদজট ও সার্ময়ক সনে অর্থবা 
 
       ২.২.১.২ শগদজট ও র্াননীয় প্রিানর্ন্ত্রী প্রমতস্বাক্ষমরত বাাংলাদেশ মুমিদ াদ্ধা সাংসে (বামুস) কর্তমক প্রেত্ত সনে অর্থবা 
 
   ২.২.১.৩ শগদজট, সার্ময়ক সনে, ও বামুস সনে এর কমপ Applicant’s Copy (BPSC Form-5A) এর সাদর্থ জর্া মেদত েদব। Applicant’s Copy (BPSC Form-5A) শত প্রার্থীর উমিমিত  
              মুমিদ াদ্ধার নার্, মপতার নার্ ও ঠিকানার সাদর্থ প্রার্থীর উপস্থামপত শগদজট ও সার্ময়ক সনে/দগদজট ও বামুস সনে/দগদজট ও সার্ময়ক সনে ও বামুস সনে এর সাদর্থ মুমিযুদ্ধ মবষয়ক র্ন্ত্রণালদয়র     
                 website-এ প্রকামশত মুমিদ াদ্ধার নার্, মপতার নার্ ও ঠিকানা এক ও অমভন্ন েদত েদব।  
         ২.২.২      ক্ষুদ্র নৃ-শগাষ্ঠী প্রার্থীদের প্রর্াণক মেদসদব সাংমিষ্ট শজলা প্রশাসক কর্তমক প্রেত্ত সনে সতযাময়ত। 
          ২.২.৩     র্ততীয় মলদঙ্গর প্রার্থীদের শক্ষদত্র প্রর্াণক মেদসদব মসমভল সাজমন কর্তমক প্রেত্ত সনে। 
          ২.২.৪     প্রমতবন্ধ্ী প্রার্থীদের শক্ষদত্র উপপমরিালক সর্াজদসবা অমিেির কর্তমক প্রমতবন্ধ্ী সনে/পমরিয়পদত্রর সতযাময়ত কমপ।

Admit Card পাওয়ার পর একামিকবার অনলাইন আদবেন ফরর্ জর্া মেদত পারদবন না। শকান প্রার্থী অনলাইদন আদবেন ফরর্ পূরণ কদর মফ জর্াোন সিন্ন করদল তার আদবেন চূড়ান্তভাদব গৃেীত 
েদয়দে বদল গণ্য েদব। প্রার্থী মর্থ্যা/মভন্ন/ভুল তথ্য মেদয় একামিকবার ফরর্ পূরণ কদর একামিক Admit Card েেণ করদল, মবজ্ঞমির মবষয় শকাদডর কলাদর্ উমিমিত সাংমিষ্ট মবষয় শকাড ব্যতীত মভন্ন মবষয় 
শকাড িারা শরমজদেশন সিন্ন করদল এবাং প্রমক্রয়ায়দণর শ দকান স্তদর জামলয়ামত প্রর্ামণত েদল এরূপ প্রার্থীর সার্মেক প্রা মর্থমতা বামতল েদব। উক্ত প্রার্থী  ভমবষ্যদত মবমপএসমস কর্তমক মবজ্ঞামপত সকল পদে 
আদবেদনর জন্য অদ াগ্য শঘামষত েদবন এবাং এ িরদনর প্রার্থীর মবরুদি আইনানুগ ব্যবস্থা েেণ করা েদব।

We focus not only on grades and results but also on the critical and analytical thinking capability of the students. The institution has a rich Library and all students have a weekly Library Class. The aim is to inculcate broad-based reading habits in our students. Since its inception, the institution has striven to maintain a measured but steady pace of growth in the number of students. This policy has, so far, paid rich dividends in terms of institutional development. It has also resulted in a comprehensive, systematic, and structured evolution of such school facilities as Wi-Fi to cope with the requirement of online classes during the Covid-19 pandemic. It can safely and proudly be said that it is one of the very few educational institutions which had effectively and regularly conducted online classes during the pandemic. The adoption of a gradual but carefully defined expansion policy has helped KCMSC to build a healthy relationship among its workforce, its student body, and the guardians at large. Today, KCMSC looks forward to a future of constant and uninterrupted growth and hopes to set an example of an institution that is able to endure the test of trying times in the coming years. We firmly believe that to create a prosperous nation, there is no alternative to building a generation of well-educated citizens who will lead the nation forward.

Job Description
Bengal Airlift Limited
, a leading General Sales Agent (GSA) representing several international airlines, is seeking potential candidates for its Reservation & Ticketing Department under different Airline Divisions. The opportunity includes working with
FitsAir
, Sri Lanka’s first private airline, connecting Dhaka with Colombo and other key destinations. We welcome enthusiastic, service-oriented professionals who are passionate about aviation and committed to delivering excellent customer service.
Role Purpose:
To drive passenger sales and revenue growth for FitsAir by developing and maintaining relationships with travel agents, corporate clients, and other sales channels, while promoting the airline’s routes, fares, and services in the Bangladesh market.
Key Responsibilities:
Sales & Revenue Generation
: Achieve assigned passenger sales targets by promoting FitsAir’s routes, fares, and travel products to generate bookings and revenue.
Travel Agent Relationship Management
: Develop and maintain strong relationships with travel agencies, consolidators, and other distribution partners to increase passenger bookings.
Corporate Sales & Business Development:
Identify and approach potential corporate clients, business travelers, and new market segments to expand the airline’s customer base.
Market Research & Competitor Analysis:
Monitor market trends, competitor fares, route performance, and customer demand to identify sales opportunities and recommend appropriate strategies.
Booking & Ticketing Coordination:
Coordinate with reservations and ticketing teams to support booking inquiries, fare quotations, ticket issuance, and other passenger sales-related requirements.
Promotional Activities
: Communicate airline offers, fare promotions, route updates, and new services to travel agents and prospective customers to stimulate demand.
Sales Performance Monitoring:
Track sales performance against assigned targets, analyze booking trends, and prepare regular sales reports for management.
Customer Relationship Management:
Maintain positive relationships with travel partners and customers, address sales-related concerns, and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve issues promptly.
Revenue & Payment Follow-up:
Follow up on outstanding payments from sales partners, where applicable, and coordinate with Finance to support timely settlement and compliance with approved credit policies.
Internal Coordination:
Work closely with reservations, ticketing, finance, marketing, and airline operations teams to ensure smooth execution of passenger sales activities.
Sales Network Expansion: Identify new travel agents and distribution opportunities, conduct sales visits, and strengthen FitsAir’s market presence in Bangladesh.
Compliance & Reporting:
Ensure that sales activities comply with company policies, airline commercial guidelines, approved fare structures, and applicable industry requirements.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 28 years
Skills: Airline Market Knowledge
Compensation & Other Benefits
T/A,Provident fund,Tour allowance,Mobile bill,Weekly 2 holidays,Over time allowance,Performance bonus,Insurance,Gratuity
Salary Review: Yearly
Festival Bonus: 2
Company Address: Landmark Building, 12-14 Gulshan North C/A, Dhaka-1212.
Company Business
Airline passenger, cargo sales and services,Ocean freight

Job Context
We are looking for a proactive, organized, and responsible
Executive – HR & Admin
to manage day-to-day Human Resources and administrative activities of our growing organization.
The selected candidate will be responsible for recruitment, employee documentation, attendance and leave management, onboarding and separation, HR policies, payroll coordination, office administration, and maintaining a professional working environment.
We are looking for someone who is sincere, detail-oriented, comfortable working in a growing organization, and capable of independently handling routine HR activities.

Manage the complete recruitment process including job posting, CV screening, candidate shortlisting, interview scheduling, initial interviews, reference checks, and recruitment documentation.

Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information.

An International Business Group
Manager - Travel Agency Business
Application Deadline: Oct 31, 2026
Location: Chattogram, Dhaka
Salary: Tk. 70000 (Monthly)
Experience: At least 3 years
Published: Oct 25, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Tourism & Hospitality Management, Travel & Tourism or a relevant discipline.
Relevant professional qualifications or industry training will be an advantage.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Key Responsibilities
Business Establishment & Regulatory Compliance
Lead the complete process of establishing the travel agency business from initial planning to operational launch.
Identify and obtain all applicable registrations, licences, certificates, permissions and regulatory approvals.
Coordinate with the Ministry of Civil Aviation and Tourism, relevant government departments, regulatory authorities and other concerned institutions.
Handle travel agency registration, renewals, official documentation and compliance requirements.
Identify applicable requirements relating to trade licences, company registration, TIN, VAT/BIN, business banking and other regulatory matters.
Advise management on applicable laws, government policies, compliance obligations and regulatory changes.
Prepare a business establishment roadmap covering documentation, estimated costs, timelines and compliance requirements.
Business Development & Strategic Planning
Develop a comprehensive business plan, operational strategy and revenue-generation model.
Explore opportunities in domestic and international air ticketing, hotel reservations, holiday packages and corporate travel management.
Establish relationships with airlines, ticketing consolidators, GDS providers, hotels, tour operators and other relevant partners.
Explore IATA accreditation and other industry partnerships where required.
Develop corporate client networks, negotiate commercial terms and implement sales strategies.
Prepare budgets, financial forecasts, business proposals and growth plans for management approval.
Operations & Administration
Establish standard operating procedures, internal controls and customer service systems.
Recommend staffing requirements and develop an organisational structure.
Supervise ticketing, reservations, customer service, supplier coordination, refunds and cancellations.
Establish proper financial procedures and recordkeeping systems.
Ensure compliance with applicable regulations and the proper handling of customer information.
Monitor operational performance and report progress directly to the CEO.
Government Liaison & Management Support
Coordinate with relevant government offices, regulatory bodies, industry associations and business partners.
Attend official meetings and business discussions when authorised by management.
Identify legal, financial, operational and compliance risks and recommend appropriate solutions.
Provide regular updates to management on registration progress, pending approvals, expenditure and business development.
Handle other relevant responsibilities assigned by the CEO concerning the establishment and growth of the business.
Additional Requirements
Experience & Skills
Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience in a travel agency, travel management company or the travel and tourism industry.
Practical knowledge of travel agency registration, licensing, documentation and regulatory compliance in Bangladesh.
Familiarity with air ticketing, reservation systems, GDS platforms, airline consolidators and international travel services.
Knowledge of government procedures, business documentation, tax and VAT compliance, and financial administration.
Strong leadership, negotiation, business development and problem-solving skills.
Ability to independently manage business establishment and coordinate with government offices and private-sector organisations.
Good written and spoken English.- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, online business tools and digital documentation systems.
Reporting & Accountability:
The Manager will report directly to the CEO and will be responsible for the successful establishment, regulatory compliance, operational readiness and business growth of the travel agency.

দৈনিক লেনদেন, ক্যাশবুক, লেজার ও ভাউচার প্রস্তুত এবং সংরক্ষণ করা।
বিল, ভাউচার, রসিদ ও অন্যান্য আর্থিক নথিপত্র যাচাই করা।
প্রকল্পের বাজেট অনুযায়ী ব্যয় পর্যবেক্ষণ এবং বাজেট বাস্তবায়নে সহায়তা করা।
ব্যাংক লেনদেন, ব্যাংক স্টেটমেন্ট ও ব্যাংক সমন্বয় (Bank Reconciliation) কার্যক্রমে সহায়তা করা।
কর্মীদের ভ্রমণ বিল, সম্মানী ও অন্যান্য অনুমোদিত ব্যয়ের হিসাব প্রস্তুত করা।
মাসিক আর্থিক প্রতিবেদন ও প্রয়োজনীয় হিসাব বিবরণী তৈরিতে সহায়তা করা।
প্রকল্পের আর্থিক নীতিমালা, প্রতিষ্ঠানের নিয়মাবলি এবং দাতা সংস্থার নির্দেশনা অনুসরণ করা।
অডিটের জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় আর্থিক নথি ও প্রমাণপত্র প্রস্তুত এবং সংরক্ষণ করা।
ঊর্ধ্বতন কর্তৃপক্ষের নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী অন্যান্য আর্থিক ও প্রশাসনিক দায়িত্ব পালন করা।
Additional Requirements
Age At most 35 years
হিসাবরক্ষণ ও আর্থিক নথিপত্র সংরক্ষণে দক্ষতা।
MS Word, MS Excel ও কম্পিউটার পরিচালনায় দক্ষতা।
আর্থিক প্রতিবেদন তৈরি ও তথ্য সংরক্ষণের সক্ষমতা।
সততা, দায়িত্বশীলতা এবং সময়ানুবর্তিতা।
দলগতভাবে কাজ করার মানসিকতা ও যোগাযোগ দক্ষতা।
Compensation & Other Benefits
Salary Review: Yearly
Festival Bonus: 2
Company Address: Abjaler Mor,kalaroa, Satkhira

Job Description
প্রধান দ্বায়িত্বসমূহ:
ফোন, Facebook, WhatsApp ও অন্যান্য অনলাইন মাধ্যমে গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে যোগাযোগ করে পণ্য বিক্রয় নিশ্চিত করা।
গ্রাহকের প্রয়োজন বুঝে উপযুক্ত পণ্য সম্পর্কে সঠিক তথ্য প্রদান করা।
নতুন গ্রাহক তৈরি এবং বিদ্যমান গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে সুসম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা।
Sales Target অর্জনের জন্য নিয়মিত ও পরিকল্পিতভাবে কাজ করা।
অর্ডার গ্রহণ, অর্ডারের তথ্য যাচাই এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের কাছে সঠিকভাবে হস্তান্তর করা।
গ্রাহকের প্রশ্ন, অভিযোগ ও সমস্যার দ্রুত এবং ভদ্রতার সঙ্গে সমাধান করা।
পণ্যের বৈশিষ্ট্য, মূল্য, অফার ও সুবিধা সম্পর্কে আপডেট থাকা।
Follow-up Call/Message-এর মাধ্যমে সম্ভাব্য গ্রাহকদের অর্ডারে রূপান্তর করা।
দৈনিক ও মাসিক Sales Report প্রস্তুত করা।
প্রতিষ্ঠানের বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধি ও নতুন বিক্রয় কৌশল বাস্তবায়নে সক্রিয়ভাবে সহযোগিতা করা।
Additional Requirements
Age 20 to 32 years
অভিজ্ঞতা :০-১ বছর।
প্রয়োজনীয় যোগ্যতা ও পরিশ্রম করার মানসিকতা থাকলে ফ্রেশারদের ও অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে।
Company Address: Rampura,Banasree,Dhaka-1219
Company Business
Shahin E-Mart is a Bangladeshi e-commerce platform that sells organic food, gadgets, and lifestyle items. Founded by Shahin Alam, it aims to deliver natural, chemical-free products directly to customers.

Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Conduct regular financial, operational, and process audits.
Review accounting records, vouchers, bills, invoices, payments, receipts, and supporting documents.
Audit cash, bank transactions, inventory, procurement, fixed assets, payroll and operational expenses.
Review and verify transactions recorded in the company's ERP system.
Check compliance with company policies, SOPs, management instructions, and applicable laws and regulations.
Conduct physical verification of inventory, fixed assets, and other company assets.
Identify financial irregularities, control weaknesses, process gaps, wastage, and potential fraud risks.
Conduct surprise audits and special investigations as instructed by the management.
Prepare audit working papers, audit observations, and comprehensive Internal Audit Reports.
Recommend corrective and preventive actions to improve internal control and operational efficiency.
Follow up on previous audit findings and monitor implementation of corrective actions.
Coordinate with Accounts, Finance, HR, Commercial, Procurement, Store, IT and other departments during audit activities.
Maintain strict confidentiality of all financial, operational, and management information.
Perform any other duties assigned by the, Management.
Additional Requirements
Age 25 to 30 years
Only Male
Practical experience with ERP-based accounting and auditing will be highly preferred.
Good understanding of Internal Control, Risk Management, Compliance and Corporate Governance.
Strong proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, and ERP software.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good report-writing and communication skills.
Ability to identify irregularities and analyze financial and operational data.
High level of integrity, confidentiality, and professional ethics.
Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
Willingness to visit business locations when required.
Company Address: Mirpur-1, telecom bhaban, level- 06

সাক্ষাৎকার ও তথ্য ব্যবস্থাপনা:
অতিথি ও ক্লায়েন্টদের সাক্ষাৎকার গ্রহণ এবং প্রয়োজনীয় ক্ষেত্রে বাহিরে কাজ করা (যেমন, হোম ভিজিট বা বিয়ের দেখাদেখি)।
সাক্ষাৎকার ও কথোপকথনের তথ্য সংরক্ষণ ও বিশ্লেষণ করা।
বিক্রয় ও লক্ষ্যমাত্রা:
আগ্রহী প্রার্থীদের সদস্যতা লাভের লক্ষ্যমাত্রা পূরণে প্রয়োজনীয় পদক্ষেপ নেওয়া।
নির্ধারিত সেলস টার্গেট পূরণ করা।
বিক্রয় কৌশল বাস্তবায়নে মার্কেটিং টিমের সাথে সমন্বয় করা।
Additional Requirements
Age 35 to 45 years
প্রার্থীর একাডেমিক মেধা/ যোগ্যতা আমাদের কাছে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ নয়।
প্রার্থীকে অবশ্যই কর্পোরেট বা সার্ভিস সেলস বিষয়ে অভিজ্ঞ ও পারদর্শী হতে হবে। Sales বুঝতে হবে।
দীর্ঘদিন কাজ করার মানসিকতা থাকতে হবে। বিবাহিতদের অগ্রাধিকার দেয়া হবে।
সেলস বিষয়ে সেল্ফ এডুকেটেড ও উচ্চতর ট্রেনিং করেছেন, অভিজ্ঞতা সম্পন্ন এমন হলে অগ্রাধিকার পাবেন।
Skills: Direct Sales, Project proposal writing, Research Design/ Analysis, Sales, sales calling, Sales Target Achievement, Selling skills and strategies
Compensation & Other Benefits
Performance bonus
Salary Review: Yearly
Lunch Facilities: Full Subsidize
Festival Bonus: 2
Sales Commission-based as per company policy
Other Benefits: প্রার্থীকে অফিস কর্তৃক দুপুরের খাবার সরবরাহ করা হবে। প্রার্থী কর্মস্থলে অবস্থাকালিন মসজিদের গিয়ে সালাত আদায় করতে পারবেন।
বেতনের পাশাপাশি প্রতিটি প্রজেক্ট সফলতার বিপরীতে আকর্ষনীয় বোনাস দেয়া হয়।
বছরে ২টি উৎসব বোনাস (বেতনের ৫০%) দেয়া হয়।
Company Address: Kha-48/B (1st Floor), Opposite of Cambrian College, Bashtola Bus Stop, Bir Uttam Rafiqul Islam Ave, Shahjadpur, Gulshan, Dhaka-1212.
Company Business
We help those who are practicing Muslim, who pray Salah five times, Who don?t support any kind of dowry, who earn halal, who do not support visiting any shrine, so called peer, does not use Tabeej, who follows Shaheeh Sunnah of prophet Muhammad (may peace be upon him) and who wants to marry in accordance to the Islamic Sharya. We also work for divorced, separated, aged brothers and sisters. Another concern of our is the pre and post marriage counseling. At first we take a certain amount of service charge and collect bio data from the interested brothers/sisters. Then we interview them about their deen, Akeeda and personal necessary information?s. After that if any brother shows interest in any certain sister?s bio data we contact with the sister?s Wali and arrange a face to face meeting following Islamic guidelines. After collecting the service charge we go forward with our work by sorting out specific bio-data?s for our clients. We also fix a succession charge if we are successful in finding them what they want by discussing the amount with our clients prior to the marriage. We do not charge any other payments except the service charges mentioned above. We also consider discounts for the needy brothers and sisters. Marriage is from Allah and fully dependent on the destiny (Kadr). We only can help you in that process of finding the right practicing muslim/muslimah by trying our best. Till now we have more than 86 success stories Ma sha Allah. So we do not guarantee any success rather we can guarantee our dedication in helping you. In sha Allah. We are a small organization and we need funds to run our services. That is the purpose of charging fees. And no, we are not doing business by using the name of Islam rather we are doing business in accordance to the Islamic guidelines. An-Nur Islamic Marriage Media is a nonpolitical organization and we try to follow proper Islamic Sharya laws. Our main goal is to help find practicing muslim/muslimah the right partner to fulfill his or her Deen. We do work for brothers and sisters of Deen who: ?	Who are not follower/ mureed of any Peer. ?	Who does not visit any kind of shrine or place of Bida?ah. ?	Who does not use any amulet/ Tameemah/ Taweez. ?	Who are regular in their Salaah. ?	Who don?t support/ take any kind of dowry. ?	Who earn their livelihood in halal way. ?	Who follows Shaheeh Sunnah of Prophet Muhammad (May peace be upon him) who wants to marry in accordance to the Islamic Shariah. ?	Who wants to avoid wedding arrangements those are against Islamic culture.

BRAC Enterprises
Officer, Accounts (BRAC Fisheries Enterprise)
Application Deadline: Nov 8, 2026
Location: Anywhere in Bangladesh
Salary: Negotiable
Experience: At least 1 years
Published: Oct 26, 2026
Requirements
Education
The candidate must possess a BBA in Accounting with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 or the equivalent of a second class/division, or comparable academic standing in all examinations from a Govt. approved recognized university.
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Diligently prepare comprehensive monthly and annual financial reports, leveraging proficiency in ERP systems or equivalent accounting software to ensure accuracy and compliance.
Process all types of billing vouchers, maintain daily cash records, ledgers, and stock books, ensuring meticulous attention to detail and adherence to accounting principles
Oversee daily sales tracking and ensure prompt bank deposits, implementing effective fund management strategies to maintain optimal liquidity
Formulate and submit weekly cash/fund requisitions to the Head Office, aligning with organizational budgeting and financial planning protocols
Review and authorize payment documents in strict accordance with organizational financial policies, ensuring integrity and accountability in all transactions
Manage the issuance of cheques and vouchers, guaranteeing timely disbursement to employees, partners, and vendors, while maintaining comprehensive records
Ensure all payments, purchase authorizations, and financial transactions comply with staff regulations, financial rules, and delegated authorities
Execute precise VAT and tax deductions from supplier bills, ensuring timely remittance to the bank in compliance with statutory requirements
Prepare monthly bank reconciliation statements, incorporating Head Office adjustments, and accurately record debit/credit notes to maintain financial integrity
Prepare and issue delivery challans, money receipts, and gate passes for clients, ensuring proper documentation and record-keeping
Maintain office premises, guest accommodations, dining facilities, and oversee other administrative tasks to ensure a conducive working environment
Participate in all aspects of product sales, delivery, and receipt; maintain up-to-date stock books and asset registers with date-wise entries for accurate inventory tracking
Prepare necessary reports and coordinate collections through designated personnel, ensuring timely submission and follow-up
Ensure the safety of team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation to achieve the programme’s goals on safeguarding implementation. Act as a key source of support, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment
Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action.
Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place, encourage others to do so
Perform any other jobs as assigned by the management
Additional Requirements
Age, academic credentials, and professional experience requirements may be waived for candidates demonstrating extraordinary qualifications and a proven record of excellence
Comprehensive understanding of fundamental accounting principles, including but not limited to inventory management, financial oversight, profit and loss analysis, and income statement preparation
Demonstrated expertise in utilizing Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems or equivalent accounting software to streamline financial operations
Ability to dissect complex financial data
Aptitude for identifying issues and implementing effective solutions promptly
Proficiency in compiling comprehensive reports that accurately reflect financial standings and projections
Excellent verbal and written communication capabilities to convey financial information clearly and concisely to stakeholders
Advanced skills in computer applications pertinent to financial management, including spreadsheets, databases, and financial modeling tools
Hands-on experience with financial, accounting, and Management Information Systems (MIS) to ensure accurate and efficient data processing
Demonstrated ability to maintain high performance levels and meet critical deadlines in high-pressure environments, ensuring organizational objectives are consistently achieved
Compensation & Other Benefits
Health and Life Insurance, Festival Bonuses, Contributory
Provident Fund and Gratuity
Company Address: BRAC Centre, 75 Mohakhali, Dhaka 1212
Company Business
BRAC Enterprises, the social enterprise and investment division of BRAC were initiated as intervention to serve a need or create market access for the marginal producers. BRAC Enterprises strives to strike the right balance between financial surplus and social returns in order to achieve the targeted double/ triple bottom lines. By operating as a surplus generating enterprises that aims to alleviate poverty through its business operations and supply chain, BRAC succeeds in implementing its vision to serve the society in a profitable manner. Now, these socially profitable enterprises, across crafts, agriculture, livestock, poultry, fisheries, health and retail sector are making a significant contribution to the local economy through the creation of market linkage, entrepreneurs and employment opportunities.

BRAC
Case Worker/ Field Facilitator, Early Childhood Development, HCMP
Application Deadline: Nov 2, 2026
Location: Coxs Bazar (Teknaf, Ukhia)
Salary: Negotiable
Experience: At least 1 years
Published: Oct 26, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor/Honors
Bachelor’s in any discipline from any UGC approved reputed university
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Contractual
Application
Online
Job Description
BRAC is an international development organisation founded in Bangladesh in 1972 that partners globally with over 100 million people living with inequality and poverty to create opportunities to realise their potential.
Working at brac is not like any other job. It is a platform where you can bring about real change for people who need it the most. We are not just dreaming of a better world, we are building it. Join us to find the way.
Job Purpose:
This position will be responsible for supporting the implementation of the Humanitarian Play Lab (HPL) and to
identify cases, assess, refer, and follow up on child protection concerns involving children and families connected activities and to HPL activities in Rohingya camps
at the camps. He/she will mobilize FDMN volunteers likes Play Leaders, CBCPC members, Para counsellors, monitoring daily activities, and assisting in child-cantered learning sessions. The role involves direct interaction with children, caregivers, play leaders, and community stakeholders to promote inclusive, safe and playful learning for children affected by emergencies. This position will also conduct daily supervisory visits of HPL to evaluate adherence to minimum standards for operation
.
Key Responsibilities:
Engage community leaders, parents, caregivers and other stakeholders to build awareness in the Humanitarian Play Lab model
Conduct survey for 0-3 & 3-5 cohorts and select learners for the enrolment
Mobilize and enroll eligible children into the Play Lab and Learning Centre activities
Encourage father and mother engagement along with community participation in the HPL through regular visits, CBCPC meeting, monthly parents meeting, feedback sessions and collaborative planning
Assist Play Leaders, Father & Mother Volunteers in organizing sessions through play-based activities.
Ensure play materials, tools, and low and no cost materials are available and properly use.
Monitor children’s attendance, active participation and wellbeing on a daily basis.
Receive referrals from HPL Field Facilitators, Play Leaders, community volunteers, caregivers, and other authorized sources.
Identify and respond to child protection concerns, including abuse, neglect, exploitation, violence, separation, and other risks affecting children.
Assess the child's safety, protection risks, psychosocial needs, family circumstances, and available support systems.
Review case plans regularly and update them when circumstances or protection risks change.
Recommend case closure when the established criteria have been met, subject to the required supervisory review and approval.
Establish clear referral and communication mechanisms with HPL Field Facilitators and relevant programme staff.
Refer children and caregivers to appropriate service providers based on assessed needs and established referral pathways
Submit case management reports and anonymized statistics within the required deadlines.
Comply with organizational data protection and information-sharing protocols.
Explain available services, confidentiality limits, and consent requirements to children and caregivers in an age-appropriate manner.
Promote a safe, non-discriminatory and nurturing for all children, regardless of background or ability.
Safeguarding Responsibilities:
Ensure the safety of Programme Participants, people who come into contact with the organisation and team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation including sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) to achieve the programme`s goals of safeguarding implementation. Act as a key source of support, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment.
Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action.
Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place and encourage others to do so
Additional Requirements
KNOWLEDGE
:
- Development sector
- Global development scenario to identify funding trends,
- Financial and grants management
- Donor agencies
- Child protection
- Knowledge on global & national Educational Policies
SKILLS:
- Have excellent writing, reporting, and analytical skills.
- Have excellent knowledge and skill in Office applications (MS Word, MS PowerPoint, MS Excel).
- Have excellent typing skill both in Bengali and English.
COMPETENCIES
: English language and Computer proficiencies.
Skills: Early Childhood Development (ECD), Child Education, Humanitarian Response, Child Protection
Compensation & Other Benefits
Mobile bill
Weekly 2 holidays
Festival Bonus
Health & Life Insurance
Paternity/ Maternity leave
others as per Organisation policy.
Company Address: BRAC 75 Mohakhali, Dhaka-1212, Bangladesh
Company Business
BRAC believes that everyone we work with—including our staff, programme participants, partners, and the communities we serve—has the right to be protected from all forms of harm, abuse, neglect, harassment, and exploitation, including sexual exploitation and abuse. We uphold human dignity and inclusion for all, regardless of age, race, religion, gender, disability, ethnic origin, or socio-economic background. We are an equal opportunity employer. We especially encourage those who have shown resilience—who have faced personal struggles, bounced back, and continued to move forward—to apply. Selected candidates will have to go through a rigorous reference and background checking process which may include police verification.

Job Description
BRAC is an international development organisation founded in Bangladesh in 1972 that partners globally with over 100 million people living with inequality and poverty to create opportunities to realise their potential.
Working at brac is not like any other job. It is a platform where you can bring about real change for people who need it the most. We are not just dreaming of a better world, we are building it. Join us to find the way.
Job Purpose:
The Senior Project Officer – English Language will be responsible for delivering and supervising English language instruction in English and Digital Literacy Labs across camps and host community locations. The role focuses on curriculum-based training that supports language development, IELTS preparation, and digital integration. S/he will guide learners toward achieving proficiency, manage daily classroom activities, ensure quality teaching materials are used effectively, and contribute to learners' preparedness for employment or further education.
Key Responsibilities:
Training Delivery and Learner Engagement
Design and deliver engaging, level-appropriate English language lessons focusing on speaking, listening, reading, and writing.
Tailor instruction for diverse learners using visual, auditory, and tech-integrated teaching methods.
Facilitate regular formative and summative assessments to evaluate learner progress.
Offer individual feedback and learning support based on learner performance and goals.
Support learners preparing for the IELTS examination, ensuring exposure to test formats and practice tools.
Flexibility, adaptability, and creativity in designing and delivering language lessons.
Learning Environment Management and Resource Use
Ensure proper setup and functioning of lab learning environments, including usage of digital learning tools.
Maintain, track, and replenish educational materials, teaching aids, and learning kits.
Create a culturally respectful and inclusive classroom environment to promote attendance and motivation.
Monitor classroom attendance and identify absenteeism trends for early intervention.
Ensure that safeguarding, gender inclusion, and disability-sensitive practices are implemented in the learning space.
Coordination, Reporting, and Capacity Support
Coordinate with other Senior Project Officers and trainers to standardize delivery across locations.
Maintain up-to-date records on learners, attendance, progress reports, and assessments.
Prepare weekly and monthly activity reports, lesson summaries, and incident documentation.
Support training-of-trainers (ToT) sessions and refresher courses as required.
Participate in coordination meetings and contribute feedback for curriculum adaptation and program enhancement.
Safeguarding Responsibilities:
Ensure the safety of Programme Participants, people who come into contact with the organisation and team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation including sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) to achieve the programme`s goals of safeguarding implementation. Act as a key source of support, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment.
Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action.
Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place and encourage others to do so
Additional Requirements
KNOWLEDGE:
•	English language teaching methodologies, particularly in humanitarian and low-resource settings.
•	Familiarity with IELTS content and exam structure.
•	Basic understanding of adult learning principles and digital education tools.
SKILLS:
•	Lesson planning and effective delivery in both physical and digital classrooms.
•	Classroom management, learner support, and individualized instruction.
•	Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
•	Proficient in using multimedia and digital tools for learning.
•	Report writing and documentation in English and Bangla.
COMPETENCIES:
•	Empathy, patience, and learner-centered mindset.
•	Adaptability to changing class conditions and participant needs.
•	Proactive problem-solving in teaching environments.
•	Professional integrity, time management, and attention to detail.
•	Commitment to continuous learning and reflective practice.
Skills: IELTS, Teaching/ Training

Mobile bill

Health & Life Insurance
Paternity/ Maternity leave

Job Description
Context:
We are hiring a Senior Executive – Accounts to record all of the business`s transactions accurately and on time: purchases, sales, collections, payments, expenses and inventory. The role also covers reconciliations and financial reports that help control margin and working capital.
Job Responsibilities
Check invoices against the purchase order, goods receipt
Record purchase, sales, collection and expense transactions accurately and on time.
Prepare supplier payment schedules in line with the agreed terms and approvals, together with Finance & Accounts.
Reconcile supplier ledgers and resolve any differences.
Do bank, cash, customer and supplier reconciliations.
Prepare monthly reports on sales, gross margin, receivables, payables and expenses against budget, and help with month-end closing.
Deduct TDS and VDS at the time of payments and maintain proper documentation Vat and Tax
Keep complete documentation and support internal and external audits.
Maintain petty cash and voucher and records all day-to-day transaction and perform any others assigned by the management.
Additional Requirements
Accounting work in trading, FMCG organizations.
Hands-on experience with ERP-based accounting
Sound knowledge of accounting principles, bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, and inventory accounting.
Good working knowledge of VAT and Tax rules.
Advanced MS Excel, MS Word.
Understands internal controls and audit requirements.
Assist in preparing Financial Statement and Bank Reconciliation.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Two Festival Bonus
Mobile Bill Allowance
Full subsidize lunch
Weekly holiday: 1 day (6-day work week)

লিড জেনারেশন ও প্রজেক্ট পাইপলাইন:
নতুন ব্যবসার সুযোগ খোঁজা। এর জন্য নিয়মিতভাবে সরকারি ও বেসরকারি কনস্ট্রাকশন প্রজেক্ট সাইট, কর্পোরেট অফিস এবং রেডি-মিক্স কনক্রিট (RMC) প্ল্যান্ট পরিদর্শন করা।
ডিলার ও স্টেকহোল্ডার ম্যানেজমেন্ট:

BRAC
Senior Project Officer, Vocational Training-Solar, Humanitarian Development Coexistence Nexus, HCMP
Application Deadline: Nov 2, 2026
Location: Coxs Bazar (Teknaf, Ukhia)
Salary: Negotiable
Experience: At least 1 years
Published: Oct 26, 2026
Requirements
Education
Diploma
Bachelor/Honors
Diploma in Electrical or Electronic
Bachelor's in Electrical/ Electronic Engineering
National Skills Certification of Solar, Level 1-2 (NSDA/BTEB)
National Skills Certification of Electrical, Level 1-2 (NSDA/BTEB)
CBT&A Methodology Level 4 (NSDA/BTEB)
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Contractual
Application
Online
Job Description
BRAC is an international development organisation founded in Bangladesh in 1972 that partners globally with over 100 million people living with inequality and poverty to create opportunities to realise their potential.
Working at brac is not like any other job. It is a platform where you can bring about real change for people who need it the most. We are not just dreaming of a better world, we are building it. Join us to find the way.
Job Purpose:
Ensuring Skills training delivery and support to the Specialist, Vocational Training-Solar in center based vocational training on electrical and electronics skill trade. The position contributes to increasing the quality of the skill training activities according to plan & proposal. This position will work cooperatively with the Deputy Manager (Training Coordination) and Project Manager, LSD in effective training session organize and facilitation of the vocational training.
Key Responsibilities:
Community Engagement and Learner Enrollment:
Lead community mobilization efforts to promote customized Electrical and Electronics training opportunities.
Conduct surveys, participant data collection and select eligible learners, ensuring proper enrollment in the training program.
Training Center Management:
Ensure the proper maintenance and functionality of training centers and facilities.
Oversee the safe use and maintenance of all training equipment.
Training Delivery and Facilitation:
Deliver competency-based customize Solar and Electrical theoretical and practical training through demonstrations, hands-on exercises, and technical assessments.
Facilitate training sessions according to the approved competency standard & session plan and ensure effective delivery of technical content.
Provide technical assistance and expertise to enhance the learning experience of vocational training participants.
Curriculum Development and Improvement:
Support to Specialist, Vocational Training and Collaborate for the development and refinement of training resource materials, Session plan, Unit delivery plan, Training Calendar and modules.
Suggest and implement necessary modifications to training content based on feedback and emerging industry standards.
Learner Support and Follow-Up:
Maintain learner attendance, trainee record book, progress report and conduct door-to-door visits for follow-up when necessary.
Support to learners, ensuring their progress and addressing any issues that arise.
Quality Assurance and Monitoring:
Coordinate with the Specialist- Vocational Training and Deputy Manager-Training Coordination to ensure the quality of training provided to learners.
Regular reporting and problem-solving to ensure the successful implementation of training activities.
To Maintain, update and preserve all program documentation and registers including participant profiles, training resource materials, assessment tools and other relevant records.
Ensure Regularly update and maintain the participant database.
Assessments and Evaluation:
Regular conduct both formative assessment and non-formal conduct summative assessment as per UNHCR/NSDA guideline.
Conduct summative assessment as per UNHCR/NSDA guideline to evaluate learner progress timely and training effectiveness.
Offer technical guidance to Specialist, Vocational Training in conducting assessments.
Manage all necessary activities to conduct assessments under UNHCR/NSDA for participant certification upon completion of the training
Coordination and Collaboration:
Work closely with project support services to ensure the smooth execution of project activities.
Attend meetings, provide reports, ensure training quality, timely learner evaluation and monitor the performance of field staff.
Reporting and Documentation:
Prepare and submit internal and external reports as required by the supervisor.
Support the organization and facilitation of seminars, workshops, and training events related to the vocational training program.
Safeguarding Responsibilities:
Ensure the safety of Programme Participants, people who come into contact with the organisation and team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation including sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) to achieve the programme`s goals of safeguarding implementation. Act as a key source of support, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment.
Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action.
Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place and encourage others to do so
Additional Requirements
Knowledge:
Knowledge of relevant vocational trade, livelihood, coordination, monitoring, report writing, presentation preparation, and safeguarding.
Knowledge of people management.
Skills:
Ability to establish and maintain good working relationships with stakeholders in a sensitive environment.
Must have proven practical expertise in general electrical and electronics works, including troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance.
Effective communication and presentation skills.
Have computer skills with all Microsoft Office programs (MS Word, Power Point, and Excel).
Excellent influencing, negotiating and communication skills.
Excellent organization, and coordination skills.
Competencies:
Demonstrated ability to think technically, prioritize and meet deadlines in a challenging environment; must be culturally sensitive.
Ability to operate in a multipurpose organization, across functions and work on own initiative and collaboratively as part of diverse teams.
Skills: Electric Maintaining, Electrical/ Electronics, Electronics
Compensation & Other Benefits
Mobile bill
Weekly 2 holidays
Festival Bonus
Health & Life Insurance
Paternity/ Maternity leave
Others as per Organisation policy
Company Address: BRAC 75 Mohakhali, Dhaka-1212, Bangladesh
Company Business
BRAC believes that everyone we work with—including our staff, programme participants, partners, and the communities we serve—has the right to be protected from all forms of harm, abuse, neglect, harassment, and exploitation, including sexual exploitation and abuse. We uphold human dignity and inclusion for all, regardless of age, race, religion, gender, disability, ethnic origin, or socio-economic background. We are an equal opportunity employer. We especially encourage those who have shown resilience—who have faced personal struggles, bounced back, and continued to move forward—to apply. Selected candidates will have to go through a rigorous reference and background checking process which may include police verification.

Work at office

Full Time
Application

Job Description
Website Maintenance & Development
Maintain, update, and optimize corporate website applications (Frontend: Next.js/React; Backend: Python/Wagtail/Django).
Implement functional improvements, fix technical bugs, and handle regular frontend/backend updates.
Ensure cross-browser compatibility, mobile responsiveness, and optimal website load speeds.
Manage codebases and version control using Git and repository management tools (GitHub/GitLab).
Cloud Hosting & Linux Server Administration
Administer and monitor production environments hosted on DigitalOcean (Ubuntu Linux).
Manage containerized services using Docker & Docker Compose.
Perform server maintenance, manage SSL certificates (Let’s Encrypt), configure DNS records, and maintain web servers (Nginx).
Conduct regular database backups (PostgreSQL/MySQL), monitor server health, and implement emergency disaster recovery procedures.
Ensure server-level security hardening, user permission management (SSH keys), and firewall configurations.
CMS & Content Management
Manage corporate web content using CMS admin dashboards (Wagtail/Django).
Upload and publish new projects, press releases, company news, and media assets in a timely manner.
Ensure data integrity, conduct routine system health checks, and optimize database storage.
Graphic Design & Corporate Branding
Design professional marketing and corporate collateral, including website banners, flyers, announcements, and digital media assets.
Utilize design tools such as Canva, Adobe Photoshop, or Adobe Illustrator while maintaining corporate brand guidelines.
Social Media & Digital Operations
Manage corporate social media channels (LinkedIn Company Page, Facebook Page, Meta Business Suite).
Plan, schedule, and publish regular corporate updates, achievements, and industry news.
Track engagement metrics, audit SEO performance, and monitor traffic analytics using Google Analytics and Google Search Console.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 25 years
Core Technical Competencies
Frontend:
Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and responsive web design. Hands-on experience with React.js or Next.js.
Backend:
Practical knowledge of Python (Django/Wagtail CMS). Familiarity with PHP/Laravel or Node.js is a plus.
Containers & Linux Server Management:
Working experience with DigitalOcean, Linux (Ubuntu), Docker / Docker Compose, SSH, Nginx, SSL, and DNS management.
Database Administration:
Proficiency in PostgreSQL or MySQL management, queries, and backup/restore workflows.
Version Control:
Active experience using Git (GitHub / GitLab) for code deployment and collaboration.
Website Security:
Understanding of website security best practices, access control, vulnerability patching, and backup management.
Graphic Design:
Intermediate skills in Canva, Adobe Photoshop, or Illustrator for creating digital banners and social posts.
Digital Media & SEO:
Hands-on experience managing LinkedIn and Meta Business Suite, alongside basic knowledge of SEO, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics.
Skills: Website Management
Compensation & Other Benefits
Provident fund,Mobile bill
Lunch Facilities: Full Subsidize
Salary Review: Yearly
Festival Bonus: 2
Service Benefit
Health Insurance
Group life Insurance
Earned Leave Encashment
Hajj Leave up to 35 days
Umrah Leave up to 15 days
Fully subsidized breakfast
Company Address: Plot : 36 - 39 DEPZ, Ganakbari, Savar, Dhaka

Swapnojatra Sources
is a dynamic trading company specializing in importing diverse products from China and distributing them through both B2B and B2C channels in Bangladesh. We are expanding our operations and looking for a driven, energetic professional to lead our market expansion, liaison with our sourcing teams, and manage our sales channels. Job member working underneath. Summary We are looking for a young, energetic, and market-survey Marketing & Supply Chain Executive who will spearhead our field marketing, product sourcing coordination, and sales operations. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between local market demands in Bangladesh and our sourcing team in China. This role requires active field movement to showcase product samples, gather market intelligence, manage B2B trader relationships, and oversee digital platforms (F-commerce and E- commerce) with the help of a junior staff
Key Responsibilities & Duties
1. Market Exploration & Demand Collection
• Regularly visit local markets to showcase product samples, assess market trends, and collect comprehensive data on market demand for various products imported from China.
• Identify potential B2B traders, retailers, and bulk buyers, and build strong business relationships.
2. Supply Chain & China Team Coordination
• Relay detailed market feedback, demand forecasts, and product specifications to the China sourcing team Ningbo Amin Trading and Swapnojatra Sources management.
• Coordinate with the supply chain network to gather necessary feedback, pricing insights, and logistics information for products sourced from China.
3. Pricing & Import Management
• Compile collected market and supply chain information to formulate competitive price offers for traders.
• Manage import workflows from China to Bangladesh based on confirmed trader demands and orders.
4. Team Leadership & Digital Operations
• Form, guide, and lead a high-performing marketing team, supervising one direct reporting staff member who will assist with field-level order collection.
• Oversee and manage the companyʼs F-commerce and E-commerce platforms to drive digital sales alongside offline channels.
Office Address:
PC Garden (3rd Floor), 20-21 Kawranbazar, Dhaka, Bangladesh.

Age 22 to 32 years
Experience:

Excellent active communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

High level of time-boundness, punctuality, and target-driven attitude. Field mobility is a core requirement of this role.
English and Bengali typing in computer. English Language understanding.

Excellent career growth opportunities in a fast-expanding trading enterprise.

Job Description
About Investit
Investit Asset Management Limited is a BSEC-licensed asset management company focused on disciplined investment management and long-term wealth creation.
We are looking for a capable, detail-oriented and responsible professional to join our Accounts & Fund Operations team. The position offers practical exposure to investment fund operations, financial reporting, regulatory processes and coordination with stake holders.
Key Responsibilities
Maintain company and mutual fund accounts, including journal entries, ledgers, reconciliations and financial records.
Handle day-to-day mutual fund operations, including investor transactions, unit subscriptions and redemptions.
Prepare and verify NAV calculations, operational reports and supporting schedules.
Assist with financial statements, audits, tax and VAT matters, and periodic regulatory reporting.
Coordinate with trustees, custodians, auditors, regulators and other stakeholders.
Maintain accurate documentation, meet reporting deadlines and follow established internal controls.
Support improvements in accounting systems, operational procedures and reporting processes.
Additional Requirements
Preferably 1–3 years of relevant experience in accounting, audit, financial services or fund operations.
Exceptional fresh graduates with strong accounting knowledge and analytical ability are also encouraged to apply.
Prior experience in asset management or the capital market is an advantage.

Strong understanding of accounting principles, reconciliations and financial reporting.
Good command of Microsoft Excel and confidence in learning new software.
Strong analytical ability, attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
Ability to organize multiple responsibilities, prioritize deadlines and work accurately.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
High standards of integrity, accountability and confidentiality.
Genuine interest in developing a long-term career in finance and operations.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Competitive compensation based on skills and experience.
Practical exposure to mutual fund accounting, investment operations and regulatory processes.
Opportunity to work closely with senior management in a professional environment.
Training, professional development and performance-based compensation reviews.
Scope to take on greater responsibilities as the organization grows.

Master's degree in any discipline.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Tekvision (BD) Limited is an IT organization, and we are looking for an energetic, well-organized Assistant Officer to join our Corporate Services department. The selected candidate will support the Administration team in running our corporate office smoothly, covering office facilities, transport, procurement, vendors, security and day-to-day office support.
Job Responsibilities
Supervise day-to-day office administration activities.
Keep the office, workstations, meeting rooms and common areas clean and presentable.
Keep trade licenses, permits and certificates up to date.
Manage company transport and keep vehicle papers updated (route permit, fitness, tax token, blue book).
Oversee office security, access control and visitor management.
Work as a purchase committee member: collect quotations, find new suppliers, maintain the vendor list and help negotiate prices.
Procure stationery, office supplies and furniture from enlisted suppliers and the local market.
Maintain inventory records of office supplies and assets.
Ensure timely payment of utility and service bills (electricity, water, internet, rent, fuel, food, cleaning).
Keep office equipment, ACs, generators and UPS units in good working order and arrange repairs when needed.
Coordinate with cleaning, food, courier, security and maintenance service providers.
Arrange workstations and seating for new joiners.
Arrange hospitality for management, guests and clients.
Provide logistics support for meetings, training sessions and company events.
Support local and international travel arrangements, including tickets, hotels and visa documents.
Prepare office orders, notices and circulars.
Maintain administrative files and records.
Maintain liaison with government and non-government offices.
Follow cost control measures in all administrative activities.
Maintain petty cash when required.
Carry out any other tasks assigned by management.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 24 years
Good knowledge of office compliance and audit processes.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in Bangla and English.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and email communication.
Good planning, problem-solving and report-writing skills.
Able to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure.
Willing to do outside-office work when needed.
Honest, punctual, well-presented and a good team player.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Provident fund
Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize
Salary Review: Yearly
Festival Bonus: 2
Company Address: Plot - 25, Block - A Korean EPZ, Karnaphuli Chattogram, Bangladesh
Company Business
Tekvision (BD) Limited, commonly known as Tekvision or TVL, is a future-ready technology company offering a comprehensive range of services across the technology sector. We specialize in delivering end-to-end solutions that drive operational excellence, enable digital transformation and foster technological innovation for businesses of all sizes. At Tekvision, we combine deep domain expertise with a bold vision for innovation. We deliver trusted, future-focused technology solutions that drive sustainable growth and digital leadership.

Full Time

Online
Job Description
We are a skincare and cosmetics company. We are hiring a capable, empathetic, and organized Customer Service Manager to lead our customer and agent support team and ensure every customer and partner has a reliable experience.
Lead, train, and manage the customer service team and set daily priorities and response standards.
Handle escalated customer and agent complaints and resolve them fairly and quickly.
Apply the after-sales service policy consistently, including damaged or missing product verification and replacement.
Coordinate with the logistics, order fulfilment, and product teams to track deliveries and resolve issues.
Make sure customer and agent inquiries about orders, products, commissions, and policies are answered accurately and promptly.
Monitor service quality through response time, resolution rate, and customer satisfaction, and submit weekly reports to management.
Maintain complaint and order records in Excel or the company system.
Identify recurring complaints and share feedback and improvement suggestions with the product, marketing, and operations teams.
Prepare and update customer service scripts, FAQs, and policy guides for staff.
Follow company-approved information and rules in all communication.
Additional Requirements
Age 23 to 45 years
Must have at least 2 years of experience leading or supervising a customer service team.
Must be fluent in spoken and written Bangla, with good business English to read agreements, policies, and communicate with head office.
Must be skilled in handling customer and agent complaints calmly and professionally by phone, Messenger, and WhatsApp.
Must be able to apply the after-sales service policy accurately, including verifying damaged or missing product claims and arranging replacements within the policy timeline.
Must be able to use Excel and WhatsApp Business, and maintain complaint logs, order records, and weekly performance reports.
Must understand e-commerce order flow: order confirmation, delivery follow-up, returns, and replacement.
Must communicate product information only as approved by the company.
Must not make exaggerated or unapproved claims about results (for example, “spots removed in 10 days”), and must be aware of BSTI regulations.
Must be able to train, schedule, and monitor customer service staff and keep response quality consistent.
Must be organized, patient, accountable, and result-oriented, with the ability to stay calm under pressure.
Must be based in Dhaka and able to work full time at the office in Uttara.
Skills: After Sales Service, Complaint handling, Customer Service, Order Management, Team management
Compensation & Other Benefits
Performance bonus
Company training on products and policies
Staff discount on company products
Opportunity to grow skills and advance your career over time
Company Address: Quantum Mustafa Tower, Plot No. 18, Flat No. 6/A, Gaus Ul Azam Avenue,Sector-14, Uttara , Dhaka
Company Business
We are engaged in the import, distribution, wholesale, and retail sale of all kinds of cosmetics and skincare products.

About EvoiceBD Limited
EvoiceBD Limited is an international wholesale telecommunications company providing voice and SMS termination services to customers and partners worldwide. We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded, and detail-oriented
A2P SMS Sales & Billing Manager
to expand our A2P SMS business, develop strong relationships with international customers and suppliers, and manage billing and account reconciliation activities.
The ideal candidate should have experience in international telecom sales, A2P SMS wholesale, carrier relations, or telecom billing, along with strong communication, negotiation, and analytical skills.
Job Responsibilities
A. A2P SMS Sales & Carrier Relations
Identify, approach, and develop relationships with potential international A2P SMS customers, suppliers, aggregators, and telecom operators.
Generate new business opportunities through LinkedIn, email, industry events, professional networks, and other communication channels.
Negotiate SMS termination rates, commercial terms, credit limits, payment conditions, and traffic commitments with customers and suppliers.
Manage the complete interconnection process, including commercial negotiations, contract execution, account creation, route configuration, and testing in coordination with the technical team.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers and suppliers to increase traffic volume and business profitability.
Monitor route performance, delivery quality, pricing competitiveness, and traffic trends, coordinating with relevant teams and partners to resolve issues.
Prepare quotations, negotiate deals, follow up on business opportunities, and achieve sales and revenue targets.
B. Billing & Account Management
Manage the daily and monthly billing process for A2P SMS customers and suppliers.
Prepare, verify, and issue invoices, credit notes, statements of account (SOAs), and other billing documents accurately and on time.
Reconcile traffic records, billing reports, invoices, and SOAs to identify and resolve discrepancies.
Monitor customer outstanding balances, payment due dates, credit limits, and supplier payables.
Follow up with customers regarding overdue invoices and coordinate with suppliers to resolve billing disputes.
Maintain accurate customer and supplier account records, ensuring that all billing transactions are properly documented.
Coordinate with the sales, technical, and finance teams to resolve traffic, invoicing, and payment-related issues.
C. Reporting & Business Development
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales, traffic, billing, collection, and profitability reports.
Analyse traffic volumes, revenue, costs, margins, and customer performance to identify opportunities for business growth.
Provide regular updates to management on sales activities, new interconnections, outstanding payments, route performance, and business development progress.
Work collaboratively with internal teams to improve operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and overall business profitability.
Educational Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
Experience Requirements
At least 2 years of relevant experience in A2P SMS, wholesale telecommunications, carrier relations, telecom sales, billing, or account management.
Candidates with experience in both A2P SMS sales and telecom billing will be given preference.
Additional Requirements
Good understanding of A2P SMS wholesale business, SMS routing, international telecom interconnections, and commercial negotiations.
Strong sales, negotiation, communication, and relationship-management skills.
Practical experience with telecom billing, invoice preparation, SOA reconciliation, and payment follow-ups.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for reporting, analysis, and reconciliation.
Ability to analyse business data, identify discrepancies, and resolve problems efficiently.
Self-motivated, target-oriented, organised, and capable of working independently in a remote environment.
Good written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate professionally with international customers and suppliers.
Ability to manage multiple accounts, prioritise tasks, and meet deadlines across different time zones.
Job Location
Remote / Work from Home.
Salary & Benefits
Attractive salary based on experience, skills, and industry standards.
Other benefits as per company policy.
Opportunity to work with an international wholesale telecommunications business and develop expertise in the global A2P SMS market.
Apply Now
If you have the relevant experience and are interested in developing your career in international A2P SMS sales, carrier relations, and telecom billing, we invite you to apply.
Please submit your updated CV highlighting your relevant experience in A2P SMS, telecom sales, carrier relations, and billing operations.
Additional Requirements
Age 20 to 50 years
Skills: Bulk SMS, Telecommunication, Billing, Admin and Accounts, Sales & Marketing
Company Address: 308 A, Block C, Bashundhara, Dhaka, Bangladesh

Bank Asia PLC
Sr. Analyst/Analyst –Structured Finance (Up to SEO)
Application Deadline: Nov 8, 2026
Location: Dhaka
Salary: Negotiable
Experience: At least 2 years
Published: Oct 28, 2026
Requirements
Education
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.
MBA or Master's degree in Finance will be an advantage.
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Transaction Origination & Execution
•        Support the origination and execution of structured finance and syndicated lending transactions.
•        Assist in preparing indicative term sheets, financing proposals, teasers, and transaction presentations.
•        Conduct preliminary feasibility assessments of financing opportunities.
•        Assist in transaction structuring considering commercial, financial, legal, regulatory, and risk perspectives.
•        Coordinate due diligence with internal teams and external advisors.
Financial Analysis & Modeling
•        Develop and maintain integrated financial models for:
o   Project Finance
o   Corporate Finance
o   Acquisition Finance
o   Leveraged Finance
o   Refinancing transactions
•        Perform sensitivity, scenario, and stress testing.
•        Evaluate debt servicing capacity and cash flow adequacy.
•        Prepare valuation analyses using appropriate methodologies where applicable.
Credit & Risk Analysis
•        Analyze financial statements, business performance, industry outlook, and sponsor strength.
•        Assess project risks and mitigation measures.
•        Review security structures and collateral coverage.
•        Prepare comprehensive credit analysis supporting financing recommendations.
Documentation & Approval Process
•        Assist in preparing:
o   Credit Memorandum
o   Investment Memorandum
o   Board Papers
o   Executive Committee Papers
o   Syndication Information Memorandum
•        Coordinate internal approval processes.
•        Liaise with Legal, Risk Management, Compliance, Treasury, Operations, and Relationship Teams.
Syndication & Agency Support
•        Support lender identification and syndication activities.
•        Coordinate information sharing with participating financial institutions.
•        Assist in organizing lender meetings and management presentations.
•        Support financial close and post-closing documentation.
Market Research
•        Monitor:
o   Banking sector developments
o   Interest rate movements
o   Capital markets
o   Infrastructure and project finance opportunities
o   Regulatory changes
•        Prepare sector research and market intelligence reports.
Portfolio Monitoring
•        Monitor performance of completed transactions.
•        Track covenant compliance and financial performance.
•        Prepare periodic portfolio review reports.
•        Identify early warning signals and recommend corrective actions.
Stakeholder Management
•        Maintain effective communication with:
o   Clients
o   Sponsors
o   Consultants
o   Lawyers
o   Technical Advisors
o   Development Finance Institutions (DFIs)
o   Multilateral Agencies
o   Participating Banks
Additional Requirements
Experience:
2–3 years of experience in one or more of the following:
o   Structured Finance
o   Corporate Banking
o   Credit Risk
o   Investment Banking
o   Project Finance
o   Syndicated Finance
o   Financial Advisory
Fresh graduates with exceptional academic records and strong financial modeling skills may also be considered.
Technical Competencies:
Strong financial statement analysis.
Financial modeling using Microsoft Excel.
Credit risk assessment.
Corporate valuation techniques.
Cash flow forecasting.
Project finance analysis.
Knowledge of Bangladesh Bank regulations.
Understanding of syndicated lending documentation.
Excellent Microsoft Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
Behavioral Competencies
:
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
High attention to detail.
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
Team-oriented with a proactive mindset.
High ethical standards and professional integrity.
Skills: Credit Risk Analysis, Market Research, Portfolio Management, Stakeholder Management
Company Address: Bank Asia Tower, 32 & 34, Kazi Nazrul Islam Avenue, Karwan Bazar, Dhaka
Company Business
Bank

Job Description
OMC HEALTHCARE (PVT.) LTD
., a concern of OMC Group, is a cGMP certified world class standard manufacturer of medical device for local and international market. OMCH has vast experience in medical device market with effective partnership with globally renowned multinational companies. OMCH provides the highest standards of corporate environment to build up your career. We are looking for an organised and detail-oriented Executive – Sales Admin & MIS to support our Sales Administration Department. The role involves preparing sales reports, monitoring sales team activities, handling incoming calls, and coordinating with relevant departments to ensure timely resolution of customer complaints and sales returns.
Job Responsibilities
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports, target-versus-achievement reports, and management summaries.
Maintain accurate sales databases, customer records, and departmental documents.
Monitor sales representatives’ attendance, customer visits, daily activities, and report submissions according to company procedures.
Collect sales updates and follow up on missing reports, pending tasks, and incomplete information.
Receive incoming phone calls, respond professionally to inquiries, and communicate issues to the relevant persons.
Record customer complaints and sales return requests, including supporting documents and expected resolution dates.
Coordinate with Sales, Accounts, Warehouse, Delivery, and other relevant departments to resolve complaints, returns, and operational issues.
Follow up on return approvals, collection of returned goods, receipt confirmation, and related account adjustments, where applicable.
Track each complaint and return request until resolution, maintain updated status records, and escalate overdue cases.
Communicate progress to customers or sales representatives and confirm resolution before closing cases.
Check and reconcile sales data, identify discrepancies, and report issues to the supervisor.
Perform other relevant duties assigned by management.
Additional Requirements
Age 25 to 35 years
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, and charts.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, email, and office applications.
Familiarity with ERP, CRM, or sales management software will be an added advantage.
Good verbal and written communication skills in Bangla and English.
Professional telephone etiquette and customer-handling skills.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and accuracy in data entry and reporting.
Ability to prioritize work, meet deadlines, and follow up consistently.
Ability to work with multiple departments and escalate unresolved matters promptly.
Responsible, proactive, and able to maintain confidentiality.
At least 2 years of experience in Sales Administration, MIS, Sales Coordination, or a similar role.
Experience in preparing sales reports and coordinating with multiple departments is required.
Experience handling customer complaints and sales returns will be preferred.
Compensation & Other Benefits
T/A,Tour allowance
Salary Review: Yearly
Festival Bonus: 2
Additional Allowances. Long Term Benefits- Provident Fund and Gratuity. Earned leave encashment. Phone allowance.
Result oriented, self-motivated candidate with strong interpersonal skills to lead & manage the team will be offered attractive compensation package.
Other benefits as per company policy.

Youngone Materials
Assistant Officer/Officer - Internal Audit
Application Deadline: Nov 5, 2026
Age: At least 24 years
Location: Dhaka (Savar EPZ)
Salary: Negotiable
Experience: At least 2 years
Published: Oct 28, 2026
Requirements
Education
Postgraduate in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
CA Course Completed (CC) / Articled students, or ACCA/CIA/CMA/CPA/CIMA Partly Qualified candidates will get preference.
Strong academic foundation with consistent academic performance.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Participate in risk-based operational, process, and financial audits at factory and field level under the guidance of senior auditors, including process walkthroughs and preparation of Risk and Control Matrices (RCM).
Perform control testing, vouching, and substantive procedures on transactions and supporting documents; assist in data analysis to identify risk areas and control gaps.
Conduct physical verification of inventory, fixed assets, and cash, and take part in stock counts at warehouses and production floors.
Check compliance with company policies, SOPs, and factory financial transactions, including material consumption, wastage, and variance tracking.
Prepare clear audit working papers, document findings with evidence, and assist in drafting audit reports and practical recommendations.
Support the investigation team in reviewing cases arising from various sources.
Assist in preparing investigation plans and carry out assigned fieldwork with quality and timeliness.
Take part in interviews with witnesses and relevant personnel while maintaining strict confidentiality.
Collect, preserve, and organise evidence from documents, systems (SAP S/4 HANA), and site visits.
Analyse datasets using MS Excel/ERP reports to spot irregularities, unusual patterns, and root causes.
Assist in preparing factual investigation reports with practical recommendations for corrective action.
Coordinate with HR, Legal, Compliance, and other departments during audits and investigations.
Help identify fraud risks in day-to-day operations and suggest preventive controls.
Maintain organised and secure audit and case documentation with professionalism and confidentiality.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 24 years
High level of integrity and professional ethics; good communication skills in Bangla and English.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Basic knowledge of internal control and audit procedures.
Position may be upper/lower based on skills, competencies, experience and ability to work.
Basic knowledge of VAT, Tax, Accounting Standards (IFRS/IAS) and Auditing Standards.
Good command of MS Excel and MS Office; knowledge of ERP/SAP will be an added advantage.
Willingness to do frequent field visits to factories, warehouses, and sites, and to work on the production floor as required.
Eagerness to learn, ability to work in a team and independently, and to meet deadlines.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Provident fund,Mobile bill,Insurance
Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize
Festival Bonus: 2
Salary Review: Yearly
Company Address: Plot 4.5 - 8 & 12.5-16, DEPZ , Ashulia, Savar, Dhaka
Company Business
Backward linkage of Textile/ Garments.
